bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul sa/tsam ma yin par kha dan tshig la gnas te sems gting nas rgyab skyor dang / khyim gzhis las ka'i steng yang pho khyo ga tshad ldan zhig gi 'gan 'khur thub na ni/ mo rang la grub 'bras mi dman pa zhig thob par dogs pa gang yang med do zhes bshad spobs/bud med cig gnyen bsgrigs rjes khyim tshang la zhabs tog dang khyo ga'i g.yog mo/ bu phrug gi ma ma byed dgos pas/ gser las dkon pa'i dus tshod rnams nyin thog nyin brtsegs dang zla thog zla brtsegs kyis rdzogs rgyu med pa'i las ka'i nang zad gi yod pa red/ ji 'dra'i yon tan can dang 'tshol snyeg gis phyug pa'i bud med cig yin rung / tshar rgyu med pa'i khyim las dang go ba med pa'i khyo ga'i mdun rang gshis brtan srung dang dga' phyogs rgyun sring byed thub mkhan ni ga tshod yod/dper na/ brgya lo sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang bod kyi rtsom stegs steng grags 'gul mi chung ba bzo mkhan gyi bud med rtsom pa po phul byung can g.yang 'tsho skyid kyi steng nas kyang shes thub/ de bzhin bud med rnams spyi tshogs kyi glud rdzas dang khyim tshang gi khol mo/ skyes pa'i 'dzad rdzas lta bur gyur pa'ang khag mi 'dug snyam/ de ltar gyur don gtso bo/ bud med rnams sger sems las gzhan sems che ba/rang nyid las khyo ga'i las don la do snang byed pa/ rang gi byis pa'i pho ba ltogs pa dang lwa ba btsog por song ba dag mthong tshe snang med du skyur ge 53 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/dka' bas khyim tshang gi lci 'gan ma bskul dang len byed dgos song ba red/ bod kyi skyes pa mang po zhig la khyim tshang gi 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes zhan pas mi tshad/ skyes pa pho yis khyim las byas na pho ngan gras su brtsi ba'i bag chags rnying pa de sel thub kyin med pa red/ srol rgyun 'di'i mdun du skyes pa nus med sha stag cig yin rung bud med nus pa can la zhabs zhu bsgrubs na mtshang du 'gro nges red/ de ni nga tsho'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i lo rgyus red la/ 'tsho ba rol stangs dang 'du shes 'dzin stangs 'dis bud med kyi 'phel rgyas la 'gog gcun byed pa'i dus mtshungs su mi rigs 'phel rgyas kyi lam kha'i bkag rdo ru gyur yod pa'ang smos ma dgos so/ /bcu gnyis/rgyal yu/ma chen mo'i rang rnam las gsung don/ nga btsas pa'i rjes nas bzung / bu mo zhig gi lus rten thob yod pa'i grib yor gyis nga'i sems khong lci lteg ger mnan yod/ nga tsho chung chung yin skabs nas pho mo'i dbye ba dang re ba 'dzin stangs kyi he bag khyim tshang nang gi gnas bab kyi mtho dma'i bar khyad bcas lhags gi yod pas/ skyes pa dang skyes ma'i 'jig rten la byang sne dang lho sne nang bzhin gyi rgyang thag ring zhing / phru gu rnams 'tshar longs byung ba'i brgyud rim khrod 'dra — 54 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul sa/mnyam ma yin pa'i nges shes gsal lam mer rnyed thub kyi yod/ ga'an bza' zla byed kyin pa'i bud med kun gyis ha cang dka' ngal che ba'i 'tsho ba rol gyi yod cing / ha lam g.yog po zhig gam khyim tshang nang gi rgyu nor zhig gi go bab las yod pa ma red/ 'dra mnyam mtshoyin pa'i sdug po ga tshad myangs na'ang / 'khang ra byed pa dang tshig lan slog pa sogs gcig kyang chog gi med pa'i khar/ khyo ga'i khyim tshang nang kha bral nas 'gro yang mi chog par las dbang kho nar gzhi bcol yod la/ de las ldog nas khyo gar nam zhig bza' zlar yid ma tshims pa byung tshe/ga dus kyang logs ka'am kha bral chog gi yod pa dang khyo gas zla mor btang ba'i kha bral ba'i bka' rgyar gdam ga yod pa ma red/ gal te bud med la 'os mthun min pa'i sdug sbyong tshad med btang yod pa yin na/ bud med de'i khyim tshang gis khrims khang la zhu gtug byed chog gi yod na'ang / sems phangs pa zhig la skabs de'i khrims khang gis nam rgyun bden kha skyes par ster gyi yod pa red/ dus skabs de dag ring bza' tshang bar 'dra mnyam zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis rtsa ba nas med cing / bud med kyis nam yang khyo ga'i khar nyan dgos pa dang kho mo'i 'jon thang khyo ga las che ba yod na'ang / nges par du khyo ga'i khar nyan dgos kyi yod pa red ces gsungs 'dugaskabs de nas da lta'i bar phal cher dus rabs phyed lhag 'gor — 55 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/'dug na'ang 'u tsho'i spyi tshogs su bud med kyi las dbang thad la 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod med so so'i sems la gsal nges red/ zhing 'brog bud med rnams la slob gso thob med pas khrims lugs kyi 'du shes dben zhing / khyo ga'i gcar rdung dang mnar gcod thebs na'ang /las dbang dang rnam smin la gzhi bcol rgyu las khrims la sbyor ba'i nges shes da phan skye thub gi med pas mi tshe bzod bsran dang mnar gcod khrod skyel gyin yod pa red/ 'u cag zhing 'brog gi khyo shug 'brel ba de phal cher bdag po dang g.yog po'i 'brel ba nang bzhin yin pa dang /bod khyim phal mo che ru 'dra mnyam zhes pa'i ming tshig de da snga da dung bkol spyod byed sa med par lhag ma tsam du lus 'dugabacu gsum/bod btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi chun ma ste lo rgyus kyi mi sna gal chen tshe spong bza' me tog sgron la sku zhabs klu rgyal lags kyis phyogs zhen dang dungs zhen gang yang ma yin par bden drang dang rgyu 'bras blo mig gis dpyad pa rob tsam btang 'dug pa ha cang lta ri bas dum tshan zhig drangs te spun zla rnam pa'i spyan lam du phul ba gsham gsal ltar/btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i dus ni/ tag tag bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis chos ma — 56 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul sa/gtogs srid la do snang cher mi byed par/ ‘rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi thub pa'i bstan pa rgyu nor longs spyod gang la'ang bltos pa med par shugs chen pos6‘bod mtha' 'khob yul du 'dren bzhin pa dang / rgya gar yul du mu stegs chos lugs kyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la 'jigs skul bzhin yod pa/ a tsar+ya rnams kyis kyang go skabs de dam 'dzin byas nas bod du yong ste gdams ngag gser la brje bzhin pa/ lhag par du bsam yas sogs lha rten mang du bzhengs pa dang / rab byung gi sde btsugs pa bcas rgyal rabs sngon ma rnams su byung ma myong ba'i don dag gsar pa de dag gis/ bod mi dmangs bar la 'gal ba je mang dang khur po je lcir song nas spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor la phog thug gtong bzhin pa'i skabs yin gshis/ bod spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab rnyog 'dzing de 'dra che ba'i nang du btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron gyis rang gi langs phyogs brtan po dang lta tshul drang mor bzung nas/mi rigs rang gces kyi blo spobs che ba'i blon po rnams dang mnyam du/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab la 'brel ba sngar mus su bzung zhing / de'i sngon thon gyi rig gnas sogs nang 'dren byed pa dang / mtha' mi rnams bod la yong nas rgyal por brnyas bcos dang nang srid la the gtogs byed par 'gog rgol byed pa/ gzhi chos dang phyi chos gnyis kar 'dra mnyam gnyis phan dang mnyam gnas mnyam 'phel gyi srid byus spyod pa bcas — 57 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/yab mes gong ma'i srol ltar/ srid gtso bo dang chos phal par 'dzin pa'i rgyal srid skyong thabs gnang ba de dag gis/ thad kar du rgya gar gyi zla ba bod kyi zla ba las sgor sgor yin snyam pa'i blon 'bangs gsum khag cig la khab gtsags 'bigs gtsags byas pa lta bu'i snang ba sbyin par ma zad/ mtha' mar rang nyid lo rgyus smra ba kun gyi ldog phyogs kyi mi sna'i mtshon byed cig tu gyur nas/ ‘'dod chags chu ltar 'khol ba dang / ‘zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba 6‘gti mug mun ltar 'thibs pa zhes ngan smras sna dgu byed pa'i nyer len du grub/ zhib tu bsams na/skabs der btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron gtso byas pa'i blo 'bangs phyogs khag la lo rgyus kyi rgyal kha ma thob pa'i dbang gis/ de ltar gyur pa zhig las/ gal te kho tsho'i rgyal srid skyong mus bzhin song yod tshe/rjes kyi lha sras dar ma'i bstan pa bsnub rkyen 'byung mi srid la/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo bzung ba nas grub mtha' je mang dang phyogs 'dzin je thur 'gro ba'i gnas tshul yang 'byung mi srid par/ bod mi rigs 'di rgyal po srid la mkhas shing / blon po rnams gros la mthun pa/'bangs rnams 'khos la 'jon pa bcas su 'gyur na'ang srid mod/'on kyang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis rgya gar yul nas thub pa'i bstan pa bod la tshod bzung med par spel ba dang / rab byung gi sde je mang du song ba sogs kyis/ bod btsan po'i rgyal srid gnam las mtho zhing — 58 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha sa/rmog las btsan pa de yang ba tshwas zin pa'i mkhar gyang ltar 'gyel mgo tshugs zhes smra bar spobs/ des na nga tshos chos lugs kyi phyogs zhen spangs te skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs dang / dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen/ mi'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs bcas la ngos 'dzin yang dag sgos lo rgyus la dbye zhib dang mi snar gdeng 'jog byed pa'i langs phyogs nas bltas na/ btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog spron ni nyon mongs dug lnga rgyas pa'i bdud mo zhig ga la yin te/ mo ni chos srid zung rgi rnam bzhag la blo ma rmongs shing / rang rigs kyi pha chos la rtsis mthong che ba/mi rigs kyi la rgya che zhing ma 'ongs pa'i mthong rgya yangs pa/ gal la thug tshe rgyal blon 'bangs gsum la blo 'don gyi nus pa bskyed thub pa bcas kyi skye lus mdzes shing thugs dkyel yangs pa'i mdzangs ma zhig si snang brnyan 'char 'ongs zhes bris 'dugam zad btsan por rang gshis med par thub pa'i bstan la sbyong mkhan gang zhig yin tshe de'i zhabs spyi bor len pa dang / 'bangs mi ser gyis rang gi rig gnas las gzhan gyi rig gnas gtsigs su 'dzin pa'i ngo bo 'gyur bzhin pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs sogs btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron gyis tshor rig byung / de'i 'byung rkyen gtso bo rgya gar gyi chos lugs spel mkhan mi sger gyi khe phan la 'brel ba yo da pa shes/ kho mos mes po btsan po dag gis srol rgyun ltar srid gtso bo — 59 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/dang chos phal pa'i langs phyogs srung 'dzin byas te/ blon chen kha shas dang kho mo sdeb gros kyis snang tshul mi legs pa de 'gog par thabs jus btings pa red/ phyis su rgyal khab kyi dbang thang mar ngo'i zla bzhin 'grib ste nyams rgud du 'gro dus/ mos der sngon 'gog byed ched bud med kyi mtshon cha'am spyang grung gis be+e ro tsa na dang khyod shi nga gson gyi bsam sbyor mdzad de ming chag byung bar thabs bkod kyang 'then pa red/de bzhin mos rgyal khab cig dang mi rigs shig gi don du rang nyid blos btang ba red/ yin na'ang mo'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes 'dir gong bkur byed pa phar zhog rgyu 'bras kyi blo mig dang bden drang gi mi gshis kyis dbul ba'i lo rgyus dpyad brjod mkhan dag gis dmod mo dang zur za'i 'ben du gyur yod par ma zad/ kho mo'i bya spyod dang mdzad rjes rnams lo rgyus smra ba dag gis gad snyigs su ded 'dug pa red/mdzad rjes dang 'jon thang la brtsi 'jog dang rtsis mthong gtan nas mi byed pa'i mi rigs shig la mi 'jon thang can 'byung khag pa red/de yang lo rgyus steng rgyal yum khri ma lod dang / tshe spong bza' me tog sgron/ myang tsha dkar rgyan/ sad ma dkar lta bu'i bud med 'jon thang can byung ba nyung zhing / deng skabs kyang mdzub mos bstan chog chog gi bud med snying stobs can tshe ring 'od zer lags lta bu ha cang — 60 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul kha sa/dkon pa'ang srol rgyun de'i rkyen los yin 'dod/bcu bzhi/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyi 'dod pa'i bstan bcos nang bkod don/ bud med rnams ni mi brtan g.yem ma es/ /bshad pa 'di yang shin tu mi bden te/ /byi bo'i las la pho mo khyad med cing / /zhib tu bsam na da dung skyes pa thu/ /rgyal po zhig gis btsun mo stong blangs pa/ / da dung yon tan tshul du sgrog par byed/ / bud med gcig la mag pa brgya yod na/ /dpe mi srid pa bzhin du ji tsam smod/ /bud med stong la res kyis spyad na ni/ /byi bo byed pa'i don kyang ga la yod/ /chung ma spyad pa log g.yem ma yin phyir/ /phyug po rnams la log g.yem ga la 'ongs/ /nor ldan rgan po kha ba'i skra lo can/ /na chung bu mo 'dams nas nyo bar byed/ /btsong ba'i yo byad tsam gyi rtsis thang can/ /kye ma bud med rnams la dpung gnyen med/ / pho yis 'dams te nan gyis bkug pa las/ /mo yis 'dod de tshur la ma 'ongs pas/ /shing la rdo yis lhan pa btab pa'i tshe/ / bud med rang bzhin brtan pa ga la 'ong / /ta zig yul du rgan po re res kyang / /chung ma gzhon nu lnga tsam len pa ste/ /chung ma gcig gis log g.yem spyad byas kyang / / de ma thag tu gson sreg byas te gsod/ / gcig la bu mo lnga yis tshim nus — 61 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/mod/ /lnga la rgad po gcig gis ji ltar tshim/ /de ltar 'jig rten rgyal khams du ma na/ /nor ldan rnams kyi rang 'dod khrims srol mang / /de la ya rabs chos su ming btags shing / /yul gyi rgyal po'i thugs dang 'phrod gyur pas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang rjes su 'dzum ston pa/ /bsam zhing bsam na yi chad sangs dus med/ / des na rigs mthun skye bo mgrin gcig tu/ /bsgrags pa'i ngar skad kho na mi nyan par/ /skabs su bden pa'i rgyu mtshan dpang bcol nas/ /gzu bor drang gtam tsam yang smra bar mdzod ces gsungs pa bzhin/ deng rabs kyi yon tan pa rnams la dge chos khong lta bu'i dpyod shes dang drang bden gyi 'du shes cha tsam ldan tshe bud med rnams kyis 'di bzhin ma nyes khag g.yogs 'khur mi dgos/ da lta'i gnas bab la bltas na de lta dpe mi srid pas/ bud med rang steng nas brtson len byed rgyu las thabs gzhan med/ yin na'ang / 'u cag bud med tshos 'di'i phyogs su bsam blo dang dri ba ci yang mi 'don par/ yang na yag las dang rgyan cha rkyang gi nang mgo 'khor ba'am/ yang na tha shal gyi srol ngan 'di'i rgyun skyong bar grogs byed gi yod pa red/ de la 'gyan sangs rgyas don grub lags kyi 〈〈rtogs sad med pa'i mi gshis〉〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig tu/lus kyi dka' spyad la brten nas 'tsho gnas la brtson bzhin pa'i rong 'brog phyogs kyi skyes ma tshor rtogs sad med pa yul dus kyi dbang du — 62 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul shas/song drags phyir ci khag kyang / nga tsho'i ‘deng rabs bud med tshos slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum 'grims nas slob gso myangs pa'i mtha' mjug gi dmigs yul 'jig rten rtse dgar bcol te/ yid la ci yang mi bya bar mi tshe hril po yag dang rtse dga'i don du 'dzad cing 'jig rten 'di snang gi bag med bde dga'i longs spyod kyi byed po 'di gser dngul gyi don du rang gi bla srog kyang btsongs te mi rigs kyi mtshang byed pa 'di ni shin tu 'os ma yin no zhes bkod 'dug pa ni gnad la khel ba'i gtam mo/ /des na/ bud med rnams kyis rang skyon ngos len yo bsrang byed pa gzhir byas/ skyes pa rnams kyis kyang sngon goms kyi bsam blo ma dag pa rnams bsgyur te bud med rnams legs lam du 'gro bar grogs byed dgos so snyam/bco lnga/ma gcig lab sgron gyi snying stobs dang mdzad rjes dag la nga tsho bud med rnams kyis slob sbyong byed 'os shing / blo bzang rab rgyas lags kyi rtsom yig las 'di 'dra zhig 'byung ste/ ma gcig lab sgron ni dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang gi bod du byung ba'i mkhas mdzangs gnyis ldan gyi bud med cig yin/ kho mo'i mtshan snyan ni gangs can bod tsam ma yin par/ bal yul dang rgya gar bcas na 'brug sgra ltar grags yo/da — 63 ge

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/pa red/ kho mos slob dpon du ma bsten nas mkhas pa'i yang rtser son pa dang / ma gcig gis gcod gzhung lugs gsar brtsam mdzad de dar spel che cher mdzad/ spyir gangs can yul du rgya gar gyi gzhung lugs bod du dar spel byed srol shugs chen po yod pa red/ ma gcig gis gcod kyi gzhung lugs rgya gar yul du dar spel mdzad pa ni bod rang nas sa skyes rdo skyes kyi gzhung lugs gting zab mo zhig rgya gar yul du dar spel dang / rgya gar gyi mkhas grub rnams la bka' chos gnang ba kho na de yin nges/ ma gcig rgya gar du phebs te/ deng sang kha na ṭa kha mnga' sde khongs kyi sbe la kol pel 'khris kyi ri bo zhig gi steng du rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor tho pa sba kra zhes pa zhig dang mnyam du sgrub pa nyams len gyi mtshams la bzhugs skabs/ phru gu rnams tho pa sba kras gso skyong gnang ba dang / kho mo mtshams grol rjes kho mos gso skyong byas/ khong gi bza' zla tho pa sba kras sgom gyi nyams len mdzad de khong gnyis kyis re mos su phru gu gso skyong byas/ phru gu rnams lo na chung dus a ma dgos gal che ba'i skabs su ma gcig gis sgrub pa nyams len mdzad yod pa dang / phru gu rnams nar son rjes kho mos phru gu rnams chos sems khongs skor slob gso sprad pa dang / kho mo'i bu mos gcod kyi gzhung lugs rgyud 'dzin gnang / mdor na ma gcig lab sgron ni dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang bod du byung ba'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan yin pa red — 64 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul sa/ ces bris 'dug nga tshos nges dgos pa zhig la/ kho mo yang nga tsho nang bzhin sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung por grub pa'i bud med cig dang na zug gi mnar gcod khrod tshe srog bskrun pa'i spyir btang gi a ma zhig yin pa red/ kho mos bud med la dpyod shes med ces pa'i phyogs lhung gi lta ba der btsan gyis bzhi shad bkod 'dug cing / nang tshang du 'dra mnyam byung tshe bud med la'ang rjes lus thebs mi dpe ba bden dpang yang byas 'dug pa red/bcu drugakha sang bdag gi grogs mo yag shos shig dang kha brda byed skabs/mos bud med cig gis 'go khrid byas na skyes pa las ldab 'gyur gyis dka' khag che zer/ sgo phyi nas las ka'i dgos mkho'i ched du gzhan la ram 'degs kyis chang dang sbi rag 'thung dka' bas sdug gyong myong dgos pa dang / tshogs ra gang rung nang zhugs tshe mi gzhan gyis lta stangs mi legs pa 'dzin pa/ khyim du kha lag bzo rgyu dang khyim gzhis 'du 'god/ phru gur kha mgo byed rgyu sogs bud med phal pa rnams kyis ji byed de bzhin las ka yod do cog byed dgos shing / dus tshod ltar khyim du log ma thub tshe khyo ga dang kha rtsod kyang 'byung nges/ de las kyang khag pa ni/ las ka'i nus pa dang rig gnas chu tshad/ blo bkod — 65 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/'char sgo sogs gang thad nas skyes pa dang gcig 'dra yin na'ang kho tshos bud med kyi 'jon thang la yin 'jog gtan nas mi byed pa'i thog bud med cig gis go sa snyeg pa dang las don thad re ba mthon po bcangs tshe rgyun ldan ma yin pa'i lta tshul 'dzin zhing / mtshams rer zur za yang nyo dgos/ skyes pa tsho'i bsam blor bud med kyi 'jig rten ni go kha gru bzhi tsam rang yin pa dang / bud med kyi las don ni khyim mi gang bor zhabs g.yog bsgrub rgyu de red 'dod/ thengs shig tshogs ra zhig gi nang du mo rang gral mgo ru sdod skabs skyes pa mang po zhig dogs mi bde ba'i snang tshul mngon yong gi 'dug zer/ bden pa red/ las ka gang zhig byed pa dang don dag gang zhig bsgrub na'ang bud med tshos skyes pa las ldab 'gyur gyi dka' las myong dgos pa red/ de la mang bza' pad dkar gyis 'di ltar zer/ skyes pa rnams kyi las don ni chu rgyun dang 'grogs nas skyod kyi yod cing / skyes ma'i las don ni chu rgyun gyen ldog gis skyod dgos kyi yod zer ba red/ las don la dga' ba dang 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i bud med rnams 'tsho ba'i khrod gcig mthun gyi dka' gnad cig la 'phrad kyin 'dug pa red/ bud med rnams la phyi logs nas khyo shug bar phra ma 'jug pa sogs sems gting la rma kha bzo khar/ nang tshang du kho mo tshos nyi ma re'i bza' tshang gang bo'i kha lag bkod sgrig dang / nyi ma re'i byis pa'i lwa ba gtsang sbra dang gyon chas gra — 66 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha shas/sgrig 'tsho ba'i 'gro song sna tshogs thabs bkod dang khyim gzhis 'du 'god sogs tshar rgyu med pa'i las ka'i khrod rang gi tshe srog mar me bzhin sbar na'ang / kho mo tsho'i rngul chu dang sems shugs spyi tshogs kyi gad snyigs dang skyes pa'i g.yog rgyug gi rin thang las med pa red/ de las ldog ste grub 'bras can gyi skyes pa re'i rgyab na yod tshad blos gtong phod pa'i bud med re 'dug cing / grub 'bras can gyi bud med re'i rgyab na skyes pa de rigs yod med ni dogs ga'i red/ bud med rnams kyang skyes pa bzhin phyi nas gzhan gyi gong bkur dang nang du bza' zla'i rgyab skyor 'og 'gro shag shag gis skal bzang yar 'gro ba'i dus de ni nam zhig yin/ rang dbang la dga' ba dang rang gi 'tshol snyeg la brtsi 'jog byed mkhan zhig yin tshe/ nges par du pho mo 'dra mnyam rtsod rgyu nas mgo rtsom dgos/ yid phangs pa zhig la/ bdag gi grogs mos kho mor phyi nang gnyis ka nas skyes pas gnya' gnon byed pa de srol rgyun gyi bag chags las byung ba zhig yin pa gsal bor ha go gi med pa 'dra/dga' 'os pa zhig la/ phyi nang gnyis ka nas gnya' gnon thebs kyang /kho mo ni rang rlom can sdug rus byed mkhan zhig yin gshis srol rgyun gyi 'chang rgya las thar te las don thad 'bras bu mi dman pa rag 'dugabadag gi bsam par de ni kho mo'i spyang grung gnyis 'dzoms kyi a ma'i slob gso dang 'brel ba los yod 'dod/ gal te mgo nas gnon — 67 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/mkhan dang gzhug la 'then mkhan/ srol rgyun gyi bkag rgya sna tshogs med par/ ming don gnyis mtshung sa kyi pho mo 'dra mnyam sgos las don gnyer ba yin tshe/ 'bras bu g.yur du za ba len mkhan bud med rnams yin pa smos ma dgos so/ /bud med ni tshe srog skrun mkhan yin la/ tshe srog skyed pa'i go rim khrod kho mo tshos dka' sdug dang mnar gcod/ na zug gi sdug bsngal dang bde skyid kyi tshor snang sogs ma myangs pa gcig kyang med/ de ni skyes pa tsho'i blo la shong ba zhig gtan nas min/ bud med la sdug rus dang ngang rgyud/ snying stobs dang byams sems/spyang grung dang zhib cha khyad 'phags ldan pas mthun rkyen tshang na gang yang 'khyongs nges red/bcu bdun/da lo'i ston kar/ pha yul du phru gu bu mo skyes pa'i bud med kha shas dang gleng mo ci rigs byas pa na/ kho mo tshos/ phru gu bu mo zhig skyes na yul mi tshos cang la'ang brtsi gi ma red zer/de dag khrod kyi bud med gcig la bu mo spun gnyis skyes yod cing /da lor mnyam du slob chen mi 'dra ba gnyis su rgyugs 'phrod song ba red/ngas yid smon dang bcas bstod ra byas pa na/ a ma des ldog ste phangs sems kyis/ bu mo ji 'dra'i ya rabs rig bzang yin na'ang bu — 68 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha sa/zhig gi do zla ga la yong zer/red ya/ grong tsho'i yul srol ltar na/ bu ni ma 'ongs par ngan pa lang shor dang / ma rabs tha shal zhig tu 'gyur 'gro na'ang /btsas ma thag lha'u dar po 'khrungs pa bzhin bsang chung bsang chen btang ste skyes ston cho ga'i mdzad sgo mang po sgrub srol yod pa red/ bu mo ni de las ldog ste phyis 'byung 'jon thang khyad 'phags can zhig tu 'gyur srid na'ang / tsha gsur zhig kyang mi 'phud par go med tshor med ngang btang snyoms su 'jog pa red/ yul srol des tshor pa skyen pa'i bud med rnams la ngan shan thebs kyin yod par ma zad/ bud med skor zhig gis rang nyid skye ba blangs pa gzhi nas nor ba'i nyes can du brtsi yi yod pa red/ rkyen de la sogs pa'i dbang gis/ bud med rnams kyis kyang pho dbang ring lugs kyi srol rgyun gyi lta tshul mkhregs 'dzin byas te/ rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i rin thang skyes pa las dman pa'i 'du shes drag po 'dzin gyi yod pa red/bco brgyad/nga rang chung dus a ma'i las ka las sar 'gro rgyur ha cang dga'/mos dbyar khar yur ma yur ba dang ston kar zhing 'breg dus lag pa'i mkhrig ma la na zug skye gi zhes rgyun du bshad/

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/nga tsho'i lung pa la mtshon na/ lo re'i bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes pa nyi shu bzhi'i nyin thab ka la zhal zhal byed cing / bshad tshul ltar na de ni thab lha mchod pa'i nyi ma yin zer/ nyi ma der thab ka la zhal ba btang tshar rjes/ sha btso ba sogs kha lag bzos nas ston mo bshams te thab lha mchod pa red/ nga ni bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu bzhi la skyes shing / a mas nyi ma der skyes pa'i byis pa rnams la kha bsod che zer/ yin na'ang bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu brgyad nyin la lo gsar gyi go re dmar po btso dgos pa red/ de bas nga skyes pa'i nyi ma bzhi pa der a ma mal las langs te gor dmar btso dgos byung /dus de nas lo mang po 'das rjes kyi nyin zhig a mas nga la nga'i mkhrig ma na ba'i nad 'di de dus byung ba yin zer/pha yul rnga ba nas yin pa'i grogs mo zhig gis/ kho tsho'i pha yul du bud med rnams la byis pa skyes rjes bang la 'dug srol med par lam seng mal las langs te nam rgyun gyi las ka thams cad byed dgos zer/kyi hud/ kho mo tsho ni bdag gi a ma las kyang sdug pa ma yin nam/bcu dgud lo'i ston kar pha yul du sdod skabs/ nu bos khyim gyi sgo ra'i phyi rol gyi chu rka'i g.yas 'gram du bza' chas tshong khang chung ngu zhig phye — 70 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha sa/yod pa de'i nang sho cog thabs chag cig bzhag 'dug cing / tshong khang sgo mdun gyi thang leb der si no khi spo lo'i stegs bu nyams shor zhig bzhag 'dug de ru sho rgyag sa dang / si no khi spo lo rtse sa/ sbi rag dang tha mag da dung bza' btung sna tshogs kyang btsong rgyu yo/da pas/sde ba'i skyes pa rgan dar gzhon gsum rnams dga' 'du byed sa red/der 'dus kyi skyes pa'i khrod du sbag 'khor zhon mkhan dang / lag khyer kha par thogs mkhan/ mgo skra ser por bsgyur 'dug mkhan dang rgyan gos gzab mchor spras mkhan yang kha shas 'dugabadag gi pha yul du bud med kyis sho rgyag pa ni than du brtsi bas bud med tshor sho rgyag pa'i srol gtan nas dar med/ yin na'ang nga rang phogs za mkhan zhig yin gshis/ kha ngo tog tsam gnangs te sho rgyag par skad gtong ba red/ bdag gis kyang nyi ma 'khyol thabs su kho pa tsho dang mnyam du sho re brgyab pa yin/ sho rgyag mkhan dang lta mkhan skyes pa rnams kyis rang la 'dzoms tshod du sbi rag dang btung ja 'thung zhor kha tog zos te bag g.yeng skyid po rang gtong gi 'dug yin na'ang chung ma rnams snga rting du yong nas khyo gar zhing 'breg rogs dang /rtswa len rogs/ byis par lta skyong byed rogs/ da dung gnyen nye'i 'drud 'then 'khor lo gram pa'i 'dam la zug pa 'then rogs la shog zer nas sdug smre 'don mkhan rgyun mi chad pa mthong zhing / de las — 71 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/ston thog len pa'i gzhung sgang yin pa tshor yong / yin na'ang skyes pa la lar sho rgyal gyi ham pa che ba dang / la lar sho pham gyi na zug drag pa/la las ltad mo'i bslu brid bzlog ma thub pa sogs kyi dbang gis chung ma dag la skad cha mag mog re bshad de las ka g.yol thabs byed pa las/de mur mtshams bzhag ste 'gro mkhan ni mi 'dug sdug res byung na lab res kyi dpe bzhin chung ma rnams 'a zad 'u thug ste/ ngas de ring nyin gang bor zhing bregs kyang khos da dung sho rtse nas 'dug ngo ma ngo tsha mi 'dug zer nas sdug smre 'don zhor/ rang gis dbyar dgun sto na dpyid la 'bad pa'i lo tog gi 'bras bu sa la thor na yid kyis ma bzod par/ brel stabs kyis zhing 'breg gi las rgyun skyong du bud 'gro/ rikho mo tsho'i tsha ba dang skom gdung gis mnar ba'i gdong yongs la rngul dreg chags pa'i steng / mgo skra yang slas khom med par gzengs nas 'dug gyon chas ngan ngon dang cha lugs 'bag btsog yin par brten kho mo tsho gcig las gcig gi kha ngo sdug cing rgas nyams shar 'dugapho lo lnga bcur rgas nyams med/ mo lo sum cur gzhon nyams med ces pa'i 'u cag gi srid pa rgan po'i kha dpe de ni tag tag nga tsho'i grong tsho'i skyes pa dang bud med dag la bltos nas bshad pa min na ci/yin na'ang nga rang sdod sa'i grong khyer 'di ru de las ldog ste bud med rnams mo lo sum cur slebs skabs lang tsho'i kho lag rgyas pa'i gzhung — 72 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga zul sa/sgang red/ de la bdag gi a mar rgyun du bshad yas shig yod pa/ rgya mo 'di tsho la ltos dang / sde rgya mi'i khyo gas rang gi chung mar sha tsha snying nye bas chung ma rnams la rgas nyams shar mi 'dug zer/ lhag par du brnyan 'phrin sogs su skyes pas rang gi chung mar gus byams dang 'dang rtsis byed pa mthong tshe a ma yid smon dbang med du 'chor gyin 'duganyi shu/mang bza' pad dkar lags kyi deb tu 'dzam gling bud med gcig mthun gyi las dbang skor nyung tsam brjod 'dug pa zur lta'i tshul du drangs pa 'di lta ste/bud med rnams la 'dzam gling gi yul gru dang rgyal khab mi 'dra ba'i srol rgyun lo rgyus nang gcig mtshungs kyi las dbang yod/ dper na/rgya gar nang khyo ga grongs rjes zla mo mnyam du me bsreg gtong ba dang gal te me bsreg ma btang na shi bo'i 'du shes 'dzin pa'i yul srol yod cing /rgya nag nang sngar bud med kyi rkang pa bsdams pa ji ltar chung tshe de ltar mdzes ma yin par mthong gi yod pas/ bud med rnams mi tshe hril por 'gul bskyod stabs bde khyon nas med pa bzos yod/ rgya nag nang thon pa'i rus brkos yi ge nang bud med mtshon pa'i yig 'bru de pus sar btsugs te bsgur nas bsdad yod pa'i mi'i gzugs dbyibs shig — 73 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/red/ dbyin ji'i nang sngar bud med kyi rked pa bsdams pa ji ltar phra na de ltar mdzes mar blta ba dang / a h+phe ri khar deng yang bud med kyi mo mtshan btsems nas bu ga phra mo gcig las lhag tu bcug med pa dang rkyen des drag skyed med pa'i nad rigs sna tshogs skyed kyin yod pa red/a rab lung pa'i rgyal khab kha shas nang gnyen bsgrigs rjes kyi bud med kyi mi tshe gos lwa nag po'i nang btang yod/ bod kyi bud med rnams kyis kyang lus sems gnyis ka'i mnar gcod myong bzhin pa ste/ a mdor gro phye ji ltar brdzis na de ltar snyi ba dang bud med la ji ltar brdungs na de ltar kha nyan pa red ces bshad rgyun dang / khams khul du zla mo g.yog mo zhig dang 'dra bar khyo ga'i lhan du kha lag za mi chog pa dang / bud med dkyil dkrung du bsdad tshe spun zlar dmod mo bor gyi yod par blta ba dang tha na bud med rnams skyes pa'i gong nas 'dug pa'am/ skyes pa'i ca lag sgang lding ba/ yang na mgo bkrus pa'i chu dang mgo nas lhung ba'i skra shad kyis kyang skyes pa tshor grib skyon 'byung bar bshad kyi yod pa'i khar/ chos lugs kyi mdzad sgo chen po kha shas nang zhugs chog gi mi 'dug dbus gtsang du bud med la cung gu yangs kyi rnam pa thon yod na'ang / chu ji ltar che yang zam 'og tu 'gro dgos zhes pa'i bshad rgyun tan tan 'dug ces bris yod pa red/'di nas nga tshos 'dzam gling gi bud med rnams la gcig mthun gyi — 74 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul sa/las dbang yod myong ba shes thub/ yin na'ang / da lta gzhan gyi sngon thon rgyal khab dag tu bud med rnams kyis rang nyid kyi mgon skyabs rang nyid yin par go ba gsal bor lon yod par ma zad/ de bzhin lam lhongs kyang byung dang 'byung mus su yod pa red/mtha' dpyad/srol rgyun gyi 'ching thag sra mos bud med tsho'i bla srog dam gyis bsdams par brten/ kho mo tsho skyes pa'i khe phan gyi ched du bzhengs skrun byas pa'i srol rgyun gang de'i glud rdzas su gyur yod pa red/ rkyen de dag gtso byas thog tha na/ de ring a ri rgyal khab tu 'tsho sdod byas yod pa'i bod kyi bud med re gnyis kyis kyang a ri'i bud med kyis mtha' gcig tu rang gi khe dbang dang 'dra mnyam rtsod pa'i bya spyod der mos mthun med tshul ston pa red/ ma zad/ nga rang 'tsho sdod byed sa'i grong khyer 'di na'ang bud med las byed skor zhig gis rang nyid skyes pa las las sdug po byed mkhan yin pa khas len byed bzhin du/ da dung 'di ni las dbang red zer zhing / skor zhig gis/ pho mchog mo dman gyi srol rgyun tha shal 'di rang mi rigs kyi srol rgyun yag po ru brtsis nas rgyun 'dzin byas na bzang rabs yag rabs brjod pa red/pho mo'i bar 'dra mnyam khyon nas med pa dang / skyes pas chung mar — 75 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/gang 'dod du gcar rdung byed pa/ bud med kyi khe dbang la khyad gsod dang mi gshis la dma' 'beb byed pa'i srol rgyun rigs ni nam yang skyon las yon tan ga la yin/ kho mo tshos de ltar bsam don yang srol rgyun gyi bag chags zab drags pas 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes shig skye ma thub pa'i rkyen red/ yin na'ang / bdag gi sems par 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes de gdod ma nas mi'i rang gshis su grub yod pa zhig yin tsang /gnas skabs su bag la zha na'ang / yun gyis yun gyis rang dbang dang rang bde/ rang gtso rang bdag sogs rtsod nges red/ 'u cag bud med rnams la mi'i rang gshis su grub pa'i rang dbang de dag kyang mi dgos na/ mi'i mtshan nyid tshang min yang brjod khag po red/ spyir mi zhig gi blo sgo phye yod med de mthar gtugs na/ rang la rtsis thang yod med dang / gzhan la brtsi 'jog byed min las kyang shes thub/'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes med pa ni 'u cag gi ya ma gzugs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la thug 'dug pa zhig red/ ci ste de 'dra yin na'ang / mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam rtsod rgyu ni/ rgyun shes shig yin na 'grig 'u cag bud med tshos de las ldog ste rang la yod rung ba'i khe dbang dag kyang btang snyoms su 'jog pa red/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster ba/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis 'khur ba'i bya spyod de ni/ rang gi tshe srogre/ la 'gan ma khur ba dang / rang gi mi tshe'i — 76 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha sa/rin thang 'don par bkag rgya byas pa tsam las ma 'das so/ /bud med de rigs rim bzhin rjes nas rjes su lus khar/bsam blo dang re snyeg gis kun nas stong bas khyo ga dang gcig mthun gyi lta tshul ye nas med 'gro ba red/ mthar thug rang gi khyo gas kyang chung ma dang bar thag rgyang nas rgyang du bkyed nges la/ tha na rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu phrug dang yang 'dra mnyam gyi kha brda dang gros mol tsam yang byed khag par gyur te/ rang gis rang nyid mi gral nas phud de grogs med kher rkyang du gtong nges red/bdag gi nyams myong ltar na/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs / sha mdog bcas mi 'dra ba'i skyes pa rnams la thun mong gi 'dra sa gcig yod pa ni/ bud med kyis 'dra mnyam rtsod par kho pa tsho mgo na ba de red/ a ri'i spyi tshogs su yang de 'dra'i lta tshul zhig chags yod pa red/ 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes drag pa'i rang rigs kyi bud med las 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes zhan pa'i gzhan rigs kyi bud med bza' zla byed par a ri'i skyes pa tsho'ang dga' ba'i tshod red/ gzhan da dung nub gling rgyal khab kha shas su rtags mtshungs dga' rogs sgrig srol dar ba'ang kho tshor pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes zab pas/ skye khams 'dra ba gnyis mnyam du 'tsho ba yin na rang bzhin du 'dra mnyam byung ba yin 'dod pa red ces kho tshos zer/

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bod mo zhig byis pa'i pha lags dang bza' tshang thor nas a rir slebs rjes/ a ri'i mi rgyud dkar po'i skyes pa zhig dang dga' rogs bsgrigs pa red/ thengs shig mo rang phyi gling gi skyes pa de'i a ma dang phrad skabs kho mos mo la hang sang ba'i gtam zhig bshad pa 'di lta ste/mos/ rang gi bus g.yog mo zhig btsal ba kho na'i ched/ sha mdog mi gcig pa'i bod mor dga' rogs bsgrigs par nga mi dga' zer/gnas tshul 'dir bltas na/ phyi gling pa'i a ma de mi bden drang skyong mkhan zhig yin pa shes la/ mo'i bsam tshul las phyi gling pa'i rig gnas kyi rin thang lta tshul gyi zur zhig kyang ngang gis mthong yong /skyes pa tsho de ltar 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen/ pho dbang ring lugs kyi rang nyid lte bar 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun gyi lta ba des bskyed pa red/de yang mthar gtugs na/ mi'i rigs dar ba'i 'byung khungs la 'brel ba dam po 'dug snyam/ skyes pa rnams skye khams dang / rang gshis/ lus stobs dang spobs pa sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas skabs de'i khor yug tsub po der 'tsham par ma zad/ khyod shi nga gson gyi 'gran sems kyi rang gshis ldan pa zhig yin tsang / ri dang phyi rol la song nas 'thab 'dzing byed pa dang ri dwags rngon pa/ 'phrog bcom la sogs pa'i kha zas btsal 'tshol gyi las la zhugs nas khyim mi'i 'tsho thabs sbyor ba/ bud med ni de las ldog ste/ byams sems kyi rnam — 78 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul kha shas/nga/sa khengs shing / phru gu dang khyim gzhis kyi 'du shes drag pa/ las zhib mo'i rigs la mkhas pa/ gdug tsub dang dmar gsod kyi las la mi dga' ba/ rang gi mig mdun gyi 'tsho ba bde skyid du sgom pa/ sger sems las gzhan sems che ba sogs yin phyir/ gdug tsub kyi las ka de kho mo tsho'i gshis ka dang mi mthun pa red/ de bzhin skyes pa pho rnams ri dang za ma mo rnams khyim du sdod pa'i srol chags par ma zad/yun gyis yun gyis ri la 'gro mkhan gyi las ka khyad 'phags can dang /khyim skyong mkhan gyi las ka rin med du brtsis pa red/dus kyi lo zla ngang gis 'das nas gdug tsub khor yug khrod khyod shi nga gson gyi gdod ma'i gnas stangs la khad kyis 'gyur ba byung ste/rim bzhin rong 'brog 'tsho ba'i thon skyed kyi dpal yon dar nas rang kha rang gso'i 'tsho ba'i 'gro stangs kyi mgo brtsams pa red/ de dang 'brel nas bud med rnams khyim skyong byis snyor gyi las ka las brgal te phyugs 'tsho zhing 'debs kyi las la zhugs dgos par ma zad/ las ka de'i brgya cha'i drug cu yan chad bud med kyis byed dgos byung / 'dra mnyam med pa'i las bgos der yid 'thad meng/ na'ang skye khams kyi dbang gis bud med rnams skyes pa'i ngag bkod las 'da' ma thub pa red/de lta yin na'ang / bud med rnams la khyim 'khos 'du 'god la — 79 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/the jus kyi dbang cha ye nas med cing / las bgos der yid mi tshim pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i dbang cha yang yod pa ma red/ skyes pa tshos rang gi khe phan la dmigs nas spel zin pa'i srol rgyun de gtor zhig tu btang na blo bde po yong mi srid pa red/ mi su yin rung khe bzang rag par goms lobs su song drags pa zhig yin tshe/ khe phan la phog thug bzos te lam bu der bsgyur bcos byed dgos zer na/ mi dga' ba da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dngos las shes pa lta bu red/ dper na/grong khyer bod mi'i khyim tshang mang che shos su'ang / chung ma rnams kyis khyo gar zas g.yo ja 'dren lwa bkru 'tshem bzo sogs byed pa ni 'os 'tsham nang gi yang 'tsham du brtsi zhing / yang khyo gas chung mar zas g.yo ja 'dren byed pa ni ha cang rgyun ldan min pa'i tshul du brtsi thogakhyo ga de 'phya smod byed yul du'ang 'gyur nges red/gdod ma'i dus su/ pho mo'i rin thang 'jal byed gtso bo skye khams kyi lus shugs dang dpa' spobs kyi drag zhan sogs la ltos nas bshad pa red 'dod/ de yang dang thog gi spyi tshogs dang khor yuga'atsho ba'i dgos mkho la dmigs pa yin srid kyang / deng skabs gdod ma'i gnas stangs de rtsa ba nas 'gyur te/ so so'i blo rig dang klad shugs la brten nas 'tsho ba rol dgos pa red/ der ma zad bud med kyi rig pa skyes pa las zhan pa tshan rig gis kyang bden dpang byas med — 80 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul kha sa/pa red/yin kyang 'u cag bud med rnams la thog ma'i ming 'dogs dus nas rten 'brel gyi mgo ma bslogs 'dug pa red/ de la sku zhabs bo thar bkra shis chos 'phel lags kyi brtsams chos las/ ming brda tha snyad phyogs la dpyod na/ bud med zer ba ni skyes pa'i gong la bud med pa'am mchog gyur 'phags pa rnams bud du med pas bud med zer ba'i sgra bshad 'dug sgra de ni bud med rigs la nyes pa kun gyi gnas su gzigs pa'i chos pa rnal ma zhig gis bshad pa srid de/ don du pho mo gnyis 'dra mnyam min pa'i dgongs bzhes mtshon yod/ yang la las skyes dman zhes skye ba len pa'i mi rnams las ches dman shos dang ngan shos su bshad yod ces brjod 'dug gzhan da dung tsha ba mda' smyug lags kyi zin bris las/ nga tshos skyes pa brgya yi nang nas dgu bcu go dgu lha pho dang / gcig 'dre pho/ bud med brgya yi nang nas gcig kho na lha mo dang / dgu bcu go dgu po yod tshad 'dre mo red ces bshad srol yod ces bris 'dugasrol rgyun gyi bag chags ngan pa 'di dag gi dbang gis deng skabs da dung bud med rnams ltos bcas kyis skyes pa las slob gso thob pa'i grangs ka nyung zhing / slob gso thob pa'i rim tshad dma' thog bud med kyi rtsis thang la khyad gsod dang mi gshis la rdog brdzis byed pa'i — 81 —

za ma mo'i sgyid ngas ma char/gdod ma'i srol rgyun gyi rin thang lta tshul rgyun skyong si yod pa red/rkyen de dag gtso byas nas/ spyi tshogs yongs su rtsis thang can dang rang gshis ldan pa'i bud med shes yon can ha cang dkon por snang /de las spyi tshogs hril pos bud med kyi rtogs pa sad par 'bod skul btang ste/ bud med rnams kyi bag nyal gyi nus pa 'don par bcug na/ 'u cag gi spyi tshogs su yang bud med rang gi mthong sne ltar bris pa'i brtsams chos mang po 'byung thub la/ de lta yin tshe/ skyes pa rtsom pa po'i phyogs zhen dang sdang sems med par/ kho mo tsho'i sems khams ngo ma dang tshor pa dngos ma/ rin thang lta tshul rnal ma/ brtse dung la bcangs pa'i 'dun ma sogs nang sems kyi 'jig rten gson po zhig rjen par mthong thub cing / zhor du/ lo rgyus su bud med rnams 'dod chags dang zhe sdang / gdug tsub dang phrag dog g.yo sgyu sogs kyi phung po ru 'dod pa'i lta tshul phyogs lhung can der yang ngam ngam shugs kyis 'gyur ba thebs nges te/ gzhan de las kyang khyad 'phags ldan pa ni/ kho mo tshor gtong phod kyi spobs pa dang byams sems kyi snying rje/ spyang grung gi blo rig sgyu rtsal gyi myong rtogs/rung bstun dang zhib mo'i rigs la 'byongs pa/ ngang rgyud ring zhing sdug rus che ba sogs yin/ de min/ 'khor ba byams dang blo rig gis skyong zhing / yod tshad thal dang rdul du mi gtong ba'ang kho mo tsho'i — 82 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga chul kha shas/gshis ka yin no/ /gter khungs legs po 'di 'dra zhig sngog 'don ma byas par chud zos dang rul myags su btang na ni/ mi rigs kyi gyong gun dang skyes pa tsho'i mtshang skyon du 'gro ba ma red dam/de ring srol rgyun gyi chu rgyun ring mo'i chu rnga bzhur te tag tag grong khyer gyi nang tshang du lhags 'dug bud med rnams kyis phyi yi gzhung las nas nang gi khyim las dang / byis snyor zas g.yo sogs kyi las ka mang che shos byed gi yod pa red/ lar khor yug tsub po'i khrod kyi khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing dang gdod ma'i 'tsho thabs sbyor stangs kyi srol snga mo nas mjug rdzogs te/ gzhi khyon chung du phyin nas nang tshang gru bzhi'i khyim las tsam las lhag med/ lo kha shas kyi sngon la skyes pa rnams kyis gro phye dang 'bras/ rdo sol/ sol rlangs kyi lcags zo sogs 'khur skyel gyi shed shugs ngal rtsol nyung tsam byed dgos na'ang /dus da lta las de dag kyang byed mi dgos par nang tshang gi shed shugs las ka rnams phal cher mjug rdzogs grabs 'dug shul du lus pa ni nam yang rdzogs rgyu med cing nyin mtshan bar med du las kyang 'bras bu mthong rgyu med pa'i nyi ma re'i zas g.yo dkar bkru dang byis pa bdag skyong / khang pa gtsang sbra/ khyim tshang gi 'du 'god dang bza' tshod nyo sgrub sogs kyi khyim las tsag tsig rkyang red/ de lta yin na'ang skyes pa mang shos shig gis khyim las thams cad bud med kho na'i las ka ru — 83 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bsam nas g.yol thabs byed kyin 'dug pa red/ rgya nag gi mkhas pa li dbyin hoduyis zhib 'jug byas pa ltar na/ sngon chad rgya nag gi spyi tshogs su'ang nang tshang gi las ka bgo bsha' byas pa pho mo 'dra mnyam min thog nang tshang gi las ka gnyer bzhin pa'i bud med skor zhig phogs dma' bas dpal 'byor thad kher tshugs yong thub med la/ de yang bud med rnams gzhan dbang du tshud pa'i rkyen gcig yin par bshad/ yin na'ang nye ba'i lo 'ga'i sngon du mos pe cing grong khyer du pho mo'i khyim las byed pa'i bsdur tshad la rtog dpyod byas pa na/ gong gi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ nang tshang du khyim las byed pa'i skyes pa'i grangs ka brgya cha'i bzhi bcu la slebs 'dug pa dang / bud med rnams kyang skyes pa bzhin phyi rol gyi las kar zhugs shing 'bras bu'ang mi dman pa thob dang 'thob mus su yod pa red zer/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang deng skabs da dung bud med rnams kyis las ka 'dra mnyam dang thob thang 'dra mnyam bsam blo 'dra mnyam yong dgos tshul gleng skabs kho pa tsho mgo na ba red/ bud med rtogs pa sad cing 'dra mnyam gleng mkhan dag dang bshol ched/ yon tan pa'i sde'i skyes pa kha shas shig gis kyang slob gso thob myong med pa'i zhing 'brog bud kyi 'dosdo pa sdopre sdosh+tsa shā/〉sgolha/ mi maig1952—)krung go'i 'dod pa rig pa'i ched mkhas/ brtsams chos〈〈rgya nag bud med — 84 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul sa/med chung mar bsu 'dod kyi bsam tshul smra ba thos myong / de'ang mthar gtugs na/ shwa la gces pa ma yin par rwa la gces pa'i dpe bzhin 'dzam gling skyes pa'i gcig mthun gyi nad rigs shig red 'dod/ ma zad/ bod pa'i skyes pa la las rang gi chung mar mthong rgya dang shes rgya je cher song ba'i nyin mo ni rang nyid skobs su lhung ba'i nyin mo ru rtsi yi yod pa red/a ri na yod dus/ lcags mo lags kyis skad cha zhig bshad pa dngos gnas red/ mos deng skabs bod mi'i spyi tshogs steng bud med cig rtsom 'bri'i las su zhugs dgos na de ni kho mo tsho'i las rigs gsum pa ru 'gyur dgos/ bod mo rtsom la 'jug mkhan mang po med pa'i rkyen gcig de red brer/ bu mo kha shas shig slob grwa na yod dus sbyangs 'bras ha cang legs po 'dug yin na'ang / spyi tshogs su zhugs te gnyen sgrig chang sa brgyab rjes/ bu mo de tsho khad kyis bsam blo dang re snyeg sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas ltos bcas kyis sngon chad dang bsdur na rjes lus thebs kyin yod pa'ang gtso bo kho mos bshad pa der 'brel ba mi 'dug gam snyam/ bud med dang 'brel yod kyi gnad don gang rigs la bsam blo zhib phra zhig gtong dus/ spyi tshogs thog byung dang 'byung mus su mchis pa'i skyo gar 'di dag kho mo tsho gcig pu lan pa'i mjug 'bras shig min par/ bud med rnams btsan gyis de — 85 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/ring gi lam bu 'dir 'ded mkhan/ 'u cag gi pha mes yang mes nas dar yong ba'i srol ngan te pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes der 'brel ba dam po yod pas na/ dus rabs gsar pa'i na gzhon rnams kyis srol rgyun gyi lta ba las brgal te bsam gzhig gsar pa dang mthong sne mi 'dra ba'i steng bsam blo re gtong dgos tshod red/ gang yin zer na/snang tshul mi legs pa 'di bsgyur tshe bud med gcig pu'i las dbang tsam ma yin par/ mi rigs spyi la phan pa'i sman du 'gro nges red snyam/gza' sngon ma'i nang a ri nas yong ba'i mi rgyud dkar po'i bu mo zhig dang kha brda byed skabs/ ngas mo la khyed rang sngon thon mi rigs kyi 'dra mnyam 'du shes nang slob gso myangs mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha nas/rang gi mi tshe'i lam bu'i khrod skyes pa dang mi 'dra ba'i bkag rgya thebs myong min dris pa na/ mos bshad don/ kho mo'i a ma yang bud med kyi khe dbang rtsod dga' ba zhig yin gshis/ chung dus a ma'i kha ta bslab bya rnams kyis mo la mi mngon pa'i yid ches brtan po byin myong / spyi tshogs steng srol rgyun gyi rjes shul nyung tsam mthong rgyu yod cing / skyes pa rnams la'ang nga rgyal tog tsam yod pa bsnyon du med na'ang / khyim mi dang slob grwa'i slob gso de la phan cha chen po 'dug der ma zad a mas rtag tu bud med skyes pa las yon tan mang tshul brjod pa dang /gal te a ri rgyal khab 'di skyong mkhan yang bud med dag yin rgyu na/da lta'i gnas stangs las yag po yin gyi red/ ma mtha' yang rgyal khab — 86 —

bud med dang 'brel yod kyi nga tshul sa/kyi 'gro sgo je nyung du 'gro nges/ rgyu mtshan bud med rnams dgos med kyi 'dzad spyod dang gdug rtsub kyi 'thab 'khrug la mi dga' ba red zer/a ma'i skad cha de dag gis mo rang yid ches dang rang rlom gyis khengs 'dug kho mo'i rmi lam ni ma 'ongs par rgyal srid blon chen byed rgyu de red/ da lta mo rang la 'bum rams pa dang rab 'byams pa'i thob thang yod thog yang bskyar 'bum rams pa'i thob thang gzhan zhig len par gra sgrig byed gi 'dug bslab gnas thob thang du ma len rgyu de rgyal srid blon chen la 'gran rtsod byed pa'i thog ma'i rmang gzhi red zer/pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi rig gnas khor yug las 'tshar ba'i bu mo zhig gi rang rtsis dang rang rlom/ yid ches/ ham sems las/ bud med la'ang re snyeg dang rmi lam gang 'dod du yod chog chog yin pa shes par ma zad/ rang gi re snyeg gi slad du 'bad de 'bungs na yod tshad ji bzhin legs 'grub kyang 'byung thub nges red/skye khams kyi steng nas tshang ma bud med yin pa cha 'dra na'ang /pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi rig gnas 'og 'tshar ba'i kho mo tsho rang rlom dang yid ches kyis phyug la/ pho mchog mo dman gyi srol rgyun 'og 'tshar ba'i bud med rnams dus nam yang rang rlom dang yid ches kyis dbul ba red/de ni rig gnas gnyis kyis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu min na ci/2006—2007lo'i bar bris pa yin/— 87 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bud med kyi gnya' bcag pa'i mtha' 'bras/zi ling nas lam la chas te mig gi dbang pos grong tsho thar thor dang ljon shing stug po/ gro nas sran log sogs kyi lo tog smin pa'i 'bras bu dang / lung dang shur na rtswa dang rtsi shing do mi mnyam par skyes pa'i yul ljongs/ da dung bya byi'u 'ba' 'bus rang byung khams chen mo'i pang la log par bsu ba byed pa dang mtshungs pa'i gsung skad la rol bzhin khams g.yeng bag lhod ngang chu tshod gnyis lhag la song rjes/sgo me la brgyab nas dkar brjid lung pa'i ri rked kyi rlangs 'khor bkru sa zhig la slebs/ de ru kha lo pas 'grul pa rnams thang la 'bab tu bcug ste rlangs 'khor bkru rtsis byas pa na/ chu lham yu ring gyon zhing lag la 'khrud ras thogs pa/ bltas tshod du lo sum cu lhag la son pa'i bod mo gnyis yong nas rlangs 'khor bkru 'go brtsams/ kho mo gnyis kyis thog mar chu sbug 'then nas rlangs 'khor steng la chu gtor ba dang / de nas 'khrud ras kyis phyis/ bud med de gnyis las ka der 'byongs po yod na yang / kha lo pa yid ma tshim pa'i tshul gyis rlangs 'khor steng mdzub mos bstan te gan dang 'di gtsang mar khrus zer nas yang yang bshad kyin 'dug kho mo gnyis kyis kyang kha lo pa'i re ba ltar

bud med kyi nya' bca pa'i mtha' 'bras/mtho sa dang mi slebs sar yar 'dzegs nas rang gi nus tshod kyis yang dang bskyar du bkrus/ de ltar bkrus nas phal cher dus tshod skar ma bco lnga tsam 'gor rjes kha lo pas mi rnams rlangs 'khor la 'bud pa'i skad brgyab/ der 'khod kyi 'grul pa rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rlangs 'khor nang du bud/ nga rang yang rlangs 'khor nang 'bud skabs kha lo pas bud med de la bkrus gla sgor ga tshod yin zhes 'dri bzhin pa thos/ kho mos bkrus gla sgor brgyad yin/ rlangs 'khor che bar sgor bcu dang chung bar sgor lnga/ 'bring bar sgor brgyad yin zer nas gsal bshad cig byas/ nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor de 'bring ba zhig red/ nga rang sdod sa tag tag rlangs 'khor gyi sge'u khung kha yin pas mu mthud du sge'u khung phyi rol gyi gnas tshul der mnyam 'jog byas pa yin/ rlangs 'khor bkru mkhan gyi bud med cig gis kha lo pa'i rjes su dam por bsnyegs te bkrus rin sgor mo e ster la re sgug byas 'dugarlangs 'khor 'gro la nye skabs kha lo pas 'thad mi 'thad kyis sgor mo 'ga' sprad song / bud med des mi dga' ba'i tshul gyis sgor mo len pa las tshig gcig kyang bshad ma phod/ mo rang nga sdod sa'i rlangs 'khor sge'u khung kha nas 'gro skabs ngas sgor ci tsam byin song zhes dris pa na/ sgor gnyis las byin ma song / kho mos 'khang ra'i tshul gyis kha lo pa kha shas shig gis rlangs 'khor bkrus tshar rjes rin skar li gang — 89 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/yang mi ster bar bros 'gro ba'ang yod zer ba'i bshad srol la bltas na/kha lo pa 'di las kyang sdug chag yod pa shes thub/ ngas snying nye nye dang rus dung dung gis khyed tshos rin gong gsal po zhig bris nas 'dir sbyar na mi chog gam zer skabs rlangs 'khor tu'u sgra zhig dang mnyam du lam la chas song / yin yang nga'i mig lam du bud med de gnyis kyi nyams skyo po de re zhig yal ma thub/ de bas yun ring la kha lo pa'i tshul min gyi bya spyod der 'tshig pa gting nas zos te kho'i ltag rgyab la cer nas 'dug pa las thabs gzhan gang yang med song / sems pa rbad de mi skyid pa'i snang ba dang bcas mthar pha yul lung kyog tu slebs song ba tshor/pha yul nas phyir log skabs tag tag rlangs 'khor bkru sa gzhan zhig tu 'byor ba na/ hu'e rigs bza' zla gnyis kyis gnyer ba'i bkru sa zhig tu nga tsho sdod pa'i rlangs 'khor de bkrus pa red/ dus tshod phal cher skar ma bcu yas mas las ma 'das/ yin kyang bkrus gla sgor kha tshang rlangs 'khor bkru mkhan gnyis la sprad song /gzhan gyis rlangs 'khor bkrus tshe gla cha kha tshang du sprod pa dang /'u cag bud med rnams kyis bkrus par gla cha mi sprod pa de ma gzhi rlangs 'khor kha lo pa tsho 'grig med pa gzhir bzhag yin kyang nga tsho rang nyid — 90 —

bud med kyi gnya' bcag pa'i mtha' 'bras/lan med pa zhig kyang ma red/ re zhig kha nang la 'khor nas dpyad pa phran bu re btang na/ 'di lta ste/ 'u tshor dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod bud med kyi rtsis thang khyad gsod dang khe dbang la rdog brdzis byed pa'i kha dpe'ang mang po yod de/ dper na/ bud med kyis ci shes/ bong bus ci theg skra ring ma dang blo thung ma/ mo mkhas 'gong po/ bud med la brdung dgos pags pa mnye dgos/ sman skyid sa nas mi sdod ra bde sa nas mi 'dug zer ba lta bu'o/ /gzhan ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung nang du'ang mi nag nag bzo mkhan nag mo dang/ khyi bu mo gnyis la blo gtad med ces pa dang / seng lcam 'brug mo dngos po ji bzhin rta rgyug rgyal 'jog gis 'phrog rtsod byed pa dang / rme stag lha mo'i rang gshis btsan pas bdud mo'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ da dung mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi nang du'ang bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa zhes bkod 'dug cing / dga' ldan pho brang ba'i gzhung nang du bud med gcig la'ang go gnas sprad med pa sogs kyis bod spyi tshogs su bud med kyi thob thang dman pa mtshon 'dug la/ 'di 'dra'i gnya' gnon dang khyad gsod 'og skyes shing 'tshar ba'i bud med rnams kha chung dbang chung gi g.yo/ga mo dang khol mo mi chags thabs med red do/ /spyi tshogs ril po'i nang de 'dra'i goms srol dang de 'dra'i rin thang lta tshul grub yo/da pas na/drin chen a mas zla dgu zhag bcur mngal du 'khur ba'i dka' sdug — 91 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/dang / btsa' ba'i na zug snyor ba'i lan chags sogs kyi 'og 'tshar longs byung ba'i byis pa kha shas shig gis kyang a mas rang la slob gso gtong shes gi mi 'dug snyam pa'i bag chags kyis a ma'i skad char de 'dra'i do snang mi byed pa red/ ma zad/ pha bu tsho gong du 'khod rjes a mas zhabs tog sgrub pa'ang gang mang mthong rgyu yod/ rong 'brog phyogs kyi sa cha mang che shos su bud med tshor nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod skad cha nyung ba dang las ka mang po byas tshe/ bud med kyi yon tan du brtsi ba dang / yang skad cha mang ba dang rang gi lta tshul re mkhregs 'dzin byas tshe phral ma nyid du bud med tha shal gyi gras su 'jog pa red/ya ma gzugs kyi rig gnas snang tshul 'dis kho mo tsho skyes ma thag nas bsam blor bkag sdom gyi lcags zwa rgyag gi yod pa red/ 'u cag gi spyi tshogs 'dis bud med kyi ngal rtsol rin thang la snang chung byas drags pas/bud med rnams kyi sems par rang nyid skyes pa las dman pas na/zas ngan ngon za mkhan dang las sdug po byed mkhan yin snyam pa'i sems byung skyes thog nam yang rgyal kha gzhan la ster ba dang gyong gud rang gis nyos nas ngal rtsol dang rngul chu 'phro brlag tu btang ste mi tshe sdug zad rang du 'gro bzhin yod pa red/ der brten/ khyo dbang ring lugs kyi btsir gnon 'og 'tsho bzhin pa'i 'u cag gi bud med rnams skyes pa dang gdong gtod dus/ rang nyid ni nyam chung dang 'khos zhan — 92 —

bud med kyi nya' bca pa'i mtha' 'bras/yin pa'i tshor pa zhig ngang gis skye yi yo/da pa red/ de yang bud med de dag la slob gso thob pa'i skal pa ma ldan pas rang gis bsam blo gtong ma shes pa'i thog khyo dbang ring lugs kyi srol rgyun lta ba de rtsa ba nas dang len byas pas red/ 'o na bud med tsho dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du de 'dra'i mkho med dang 'khos zhan zhig red dam zer na de gtan nas ma red/ nga tsho rong 'brog phyogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod ngal rtsol gyi gdung 'khur gyi ka ba gdung ma lta bu dang / dka' khag sna tshogs kyi mdun du nam yang dpa' mi zhum pa dang ngang rgyud ring la sdug rus che ba rnams mthar gtugs na bud med dag red/ rgyu mtshan ci zhig la skyes pa zhig dang gdong gtod skabs rang nyid bag 'khums ngang dma' sa nas bsdad de yar la blta dgos song ba red zer na/ de ni rang khyim du 'u cag gi bud med rnams kyi khe dbang dang rtsis thang sogs mtha' gcig tu khyad gsod dang 'bur 'joms byas pa'i 'bras bur/ kho mo tshos rang gi rngul chu la brten nas btsal ba'i rin pa len pa'i spobs pa'ang dben song ba red snyam/ de yang gtso bo nang tshang dang / spyi tshogs/ khor yu/ga srol rgyun sogs kyis bskyed pa red snyam/blo zhib mos bsam gzhig re btang na/ nga tsho'i rig gnas dang srol rgyun mtha' dag ni skyes pa pho rnams kyi khe phan dang khe dbang rkyang la dmigs nas bzos te grub pa zhig min nam bsam/ bud med rnams — 93 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/la ma bzang zla yag ma zhes pa'i rngo mi thogs pa'i ming skam tsam btags rjes srol rgyun gyi 'ching rgya'i lcags sgrog re brgyab ste 'dug khad kyis skyes pa'i rin thang lta tshul de dag sha gseng rus rkang du thim pa'i bud med tsho rang nyid kyis kyang pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes bzung ste/skye ba gzhug mar rang nyid pho lus shig thob pa'i smon lam rdzogs med rgyag bzhin tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs kyin 'dug pa red/ de yang mthar gtugs na 'u tsho'i rig gnas kyis bud med rnams de ltar du btang ba ma yin nam/ 'u tsho'i spyi tshogs steng bud med kyi thob thang dang las dbang gang 'dra zhig yin pa nga tsho'i pha yul gyi bshad tshul 'di las kyang rjen par mtshon yod/ mi gang zhig gis mtshan mor rmi lam nang bod kyi bud med cig rmis tshe/ de gdon gyi rtags mtshan dang bkra mi shis pa'i snga ltas su brtsi ba dang / yang rmi lam nang rgya rigs bud med cig rmis tshe de lha mo ru bkur la bya ba lam lhongs yong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dod pa red/nga rang byis pa yin dus bshad tshul 'di la shin tu yid ches/ de bas thun ring mtshan mo rer/ gdong yongs lo zla'i rjes shul gyis khengs shing bzhin mdangs mi mdzes skyo mo chags pa'i lus la bod lwa hral hrul gyon pa'i bod mo dag rmi lam nang lhags dus/ rang la bgegs bar chad ji zhig yong bar dogs nas 'jigs snang skyes myong / skyi g.ya' da 94 da

bud med kyi gnya' bcag pa'i mtha' 'bras/ba'i rmi lam de 'dra rmis tshe/ dwangs gtsang byis blo can gyi nga rang la mtshon na/ skyabs re sa nyag gcig ni a ma yin la/ a ma'i hral zhing hrul ba'i pags tshag dang rtsing zhing rags pa'i thu 'og tu nyal thub pa'i skal pa ldan tshe dga' 'os pa'i don bya ru brtsi ba yin/da lta nga rang srol rgyun gyi bshad tshul 'di la gtan nas yid mi ches par ma zad/ skyug bro zhing zhe mer yong / nga tsho'i srol rgyun dang rig gnas ni/ gzhan la bkur zhing rang la smod pa/ dgra la dga' zhing gnyen la sdang ba zhig yin pa 'di las kyang shes thub/ bud med skye ba dman na de'i bu rgyud rnams la'ang bzang po mtshan ldan 'ig 'byung ba dkon te 'bras bu rgyu la ltos pa dang / chu shing skya ra las lha r+shang shug pa 'khrungs rgyu med pa 'jig rten 'di'i chos nyid yin ①/ pas na/bud med smad pa'i 'bras bu ni pho mo gnyis 'phung las gzhan gang yang yod pa ma red/2005(10(11nyin grub/rjo bo thar bkra shis chos 'phel gyiphakha ba ri pa'i bud med las drangs//

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/gnas tshul dang gnas lugs/gcig gnas chul/kanyin der rlangs 'khor las pha yul phyogs kyi ngo shes bza' zla gnyis dang phrad de/ nga tshos pha yul gyi lo tog yag min dang / yul mi'i 'tsho bar 'gyur ldog byung min sogs kha brda mang po byas/mtshams shig la rang gi dga' kha 'khyer phyogs ltar pha yul bud med kyi bde sdug skor gleng ba yin/ ngas kho gnyis la da lta nga tsho'i pha yul gyi skyes pa rnams kyis rang gi bza' zlar gcar rdung skor gsum byed pa'i snang tshul mi legs pa de bsgyur yod dam zhes dris pa na/ kho pas da lta srol ngan de phal cher mjug rdzogs 'dug 'on kyang skyes pa mang che shos kyis khyim tshang gi las ka'i 'gan mi 'khur bar ma zad/ da dung khyim gyi bal dang ra khul/ 'bru rigs/ sdong po/ log dkar/ ra lug sogs lkog nas btsongs rjes sho(macang)rgyag pa dang rang kho nas kha skyid rgyag pa'i srol ngan zhig chags dang chags bzhin yod pa red/ de 'dra'i don dag sna tshogs byung bas skyes ma mang po zhig thabs zad 'u thug 'dug da dung kho tsho'i sde ba'i skyes ma zhig gis dpyid mgo tshes ma — 96 —

sa tshul dang ga sa lu sa/thag rang gi khyo ga sa gzhan du zhor las la mngags ci thub byed pa'i gtam ya mtshar zhig kyang gleng / rgyu mtshan/ khyo ga khyim du bsdad na las ka'i 'gan mi 'khur bar ma zad/ da dung khyim tshang gi yong 'bab tshang ma brlags tshar 'gro/ khyo ga zhor las la song na phyir sgor mo skar li gang khyer yong rgyu med na'ang / khyim tshang gi yong sgo rlag mkhan med pas/ skyes ma de dga' ba'i tshod du 'dug zer/khyo ga rnams kyis rang gi chung mar gcar rdung skor gsum byed pa'i goms srol than ltas de sa cha kha shas su phal cher mjug 'gril ba ni shin tu dga' 'os pa zhig yin yang / nga tshos nges dgos pa ni/ mi rigs shig nyams nub tu 'gro ba ni mi rigs de'i skyes pho mo re re le lo sgyid lug can du gyur pas yin la/ de bas kyang skyes pa pho rnams ma 'jon pas red/ des na 'u cag tshang mas/ de las kyang bod kyi bu pho tshos don dag ngan pa 'dir bsam blo zhib tu gtong dgos ran 'dug snyam/khanam zla shin tu dwangs shing kha dbugs rab tu gtsang / nangs ja 'thungs rjes nged khyo shug gnyis sngar mus bzhin 'cham 'cham du song ba yin/ sde ba'i nye 'dabs su thon pa na/ bud med rnams kyis tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang rtswa dang gro 'breg bzhin pa mthong dus sems su ston bsdu — 97 —

za ma mo'i skyid ga ngas ma char/skabs lo lon 'chi khom med la byis pa skye khom med zer ba'i kha dpe de ci ma bden snyam pa'i tshor pa zhig skyes yong / nged gnyis ha cang skyid sa'i sdong gseng zhig la thon nas ngal zhig gsos/ skabs der sde ba'i nang gi a phyi rgan mo zhig gis rang las che ba'i gzan rtswa'i rdog khres shig khur yong nas nged gnyis la 'tshams 'dri byed zhor khur po sa la 'phangs te mo'ang der bsdad nas ngal gso byas pa red/ ngas kho mor khyod rang lo na mtho bas shed kyi las ka byas na nus sam/ las ka lci mo dag lo gzhon tshos las na 'grig gi mod/ khyed kyi bu dang mna' ma gang du bud song zer nas dris skabs/ mos khog gi sdug bsngal brjod sa'i yul zhig rnyed pa bzhin sdug bsngal thams cad lhog lhog tu phyir bton/mo dang thog sa 'dir bag mar yong skabs gzhug khrid bu mo zhig kyang khrid yong / yin na'ang gnas yul gyis ma gces pas bu mo phyir pha yul du bskyal ba red/ mo rang khyo ga de dang gnyen sgrig byas rjes byis pa ma skyes pas khyo ga'i tsha bo'i bu zhig snyor skyong byas nas da lta bu de lo nyi shu lhag la slebs yod par ma zad/ lo bcu bdun gyi steng du chung ma'ang blangs tshar/ dang thog mna' ma len skabs rang khyim gyi byu ru nyung dogs nas khyo ga'i tsha bo(snyor bu)tshang gi byu ru g.yar nas bag mar 'dogs su bcug bus skabs de dang bstun nas khyim gnyis ka'i byu ru lkog nas btsongs rjes lha sar bros song ba red/ rkyen de gtso byas — 98 —

nas chul dang gnas lu sa/thog mna' ma'ang gnas yul nas ma bsdad par rang yul du bud song /byu ru btsongs pa'i sgor mo rnams brlags tshar rjes bu phyir pha yu/la du 'khor mod/ 'on kyang mna' ma phyir yong kha ma nyan/ de'i rjes bu la yang bskyar mna' ma zhig blangs/ dus der bus rgyan cha byu ru me+ed par le bda' dang 'khang ra byas/ yin na'ang rang gi byu ru btsongs pa phar zhog gzhan gyi byu ru'i skyin pa la 'gro sgo mang po btang song bas da byu ru nyo spyad kyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan zer/ ngas 'o na khyod tshang la ra lug mang po yod pa ma yin nam zhes pa na/ mos sngon chad nga rang lo na gzhon dus nangs snga langs dang dgong 'phyis nyal gyis ra lug rnams rtswa bzang sa dang chu mod sar ded de 'tshos pas ra lug 'phel kha cung rgyas yod/ yin na'ang da lta rang nyid lo rgas nas ri mgo la thur la zog 'tsho ru 'gro mi thub par ma zad/ khyim tshang 'di'i pha bu gnyis sha za rgyur dga' ba las lug 'tsho rgyur mi dga' bas ra lug rnams lo re'i dgun sha dang dbyar shar bshas nas je nyung nas je nyung du bud song /yang ra lug skor zhig btsongs zin/ btsongs pa'i sgor mo yang brlags tshar/ bu las kar mi dga' yang gon pa gang yag gang dar gyon rgyur dga' thog sa gzhan la 'khyam rgyur yang ha cang dga' ba red/ de bas khyim tshang 'di'i gdung 'khur mkhan lo drug cu lhag gi rgan mo nga gcig pu yin pas/ da skabs g.yu byu ru'i rgyan cha nyo ba'i cha — 99 —

za ma mo'i skyed ngas ma char/rkyen med/ der brten mna' ma gzhug ma yang rgyan cha med pa dang bu sho(ma cang) dang rgyal 'dzugs par dga' ba sogs rkyen byas te ma bsdad par phyir rang yul la bud song / mna' ma 'gro khar lo gnyis can gyi byis pa zhig yod pa de'ang khrid song // mna' ma song rjes bu yang gang sar 'khyams/ mi la las bshad na/ kho nyi ma kha shas kyi sngon la chab cha ru bsdad 'dug zer/ mos bshad pa yin na/ rang gi khyo ga lo na gzhon dus nas bzung las kar mdzub mos mi thug yin yang zas zhim po dang chang bdud rtsi spyod rgyur ha cang dga'/ da lta mo'i khyo ga lo bdun cu lhag la slebs 'dug zer/ mo pha yul dpa' lung nas sa der yong nas da lta phal cher lo bzhi bcu lhag 'gor song / lo 'di dag gi ring la mos zhogs pa'i tho rengs shar ba nas mtshan mo'i skar ma 'char rag bar du ngal rtsol byas pa yin la/ da lta da dung ngal rtsol gyi lci 'gan 'khur mkhan yin zer/ bltas tshod kyis mo'i lus po ha cang nyam thag 'dug mos 'di ni rang nyid mo lus blangs pa'i mjug 'bras red zer nas rang gi skye khams la 'khang ra byed kyin 'dugaskabs der ngas nga tsho dang ha cang rgyang thag ring ba'i sa cha na/ skyid la kha'i rtswa la mnyam za dang / sdug kong mo'i chu la mnyam 'thung byed pa'i pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi bde ba can yang yod pa red zer rgyu na mo gtan du yid mi ches pa'i tshod du 'dug— 100 —

nas tshul dang nas lu sa/gnyin zhig a ce nged gnyis nu bo tshang la 'gro skabs lam bar du a ye rgan mo zhig dbugs 'tshang bzhin gom zheng chen po spos te rings stabs kyis 'gro ba dang phrad/ a ces khyod la ci byung song zer ba na/mos nged tshang gi bu chung bas yang sho(ma cang) brgyab nas nam bslangs song bas da dung nyal 'dug mna' ma skya rengs shar ma thag nas zhing 'breg tu bud song / zhing khar shog sdud mkhan zhig kyang med pas ngas bu 'bring ba tshang la rogs shig byos zer nas brda rgyag tu song ba yin/nged tshang gi bu 'di dud 'gro zog 'dra ba zhig red/ ston las mi byed par ma zad/ da dung khyim gyi yod yod thams cad brkus te sho brgyab 'jog pa red zer/ ngas bltas na/ de ni pha ma rnams kyis rang la bu zhig skyes pa na bu de lha ltar mchod cing klu ltar bkur te mi dmigs bsal can dag tu skyed sring byas pa'i mjug 'bras red snyam/ yin yang kho tshos de gtan nas tshor gyin med pa 'dra/ngayang nyin zhig nga rang sde ba'i rgan po zhig dang mnyam du khyim nas kha brda byed 'dug skabs/ nga'i chung dus kyi rtse rogs shig yong nas khos rang gi lo rgyus ya mtshan zhig gleng byung / bshad pa yin na/ kho — 101 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/lo nyi shur ma thon sngon la sho(ma cang) rgyag mgo brtsams pa yin zer/de kho rang chung dus a phas sho(shog phe) rgyag skabs sgor mo gnyer mkhan dang / yang gzhan gyi shog phe brku gi yod med la lta mkhan byas myong bas/ sho la dga' ba'i bag chags zab mo bzhag zer nas yin shag tu byas/ dang thog khos rang gi lag gi sgor mo tsag tsig re spyad de sho brgyab pa dang / de nas khyim gyi dngos po rgyal la bzhag pa/ de nas gzhan la dom byas te sho brgyab pa/ de ltar rim bzhin sho chen po rgyag rgyur lobs song ba yin zer/thengs shig la sde ba gzhan pa zhig nas sho rgyag skabs lag gi sgor mo tshar rjes/ khyim tshang la glang rgan zhig yod pa de rgyal la bzhag nas de yang shor song zer/yang thengs shig la sde ba gzhan zhig nas rgyal 'jog skabs sngar bzhin rum gyi sgor mo tshar na'ang / da dung rang tshod 'dzin ma thub pas/ kho'i lag tu sde ba de'i mi zhig gis bong bu mngags nyo byed pa'i sgor mo sprad yod pa de tshang ma rgyal la shor rjes da gzod yul du mi log ka med byung / nyin zhig bong bu nyo mkhan de kho'i khyim du slebs skabs kho rang la gcig nas sgor mo sprod rgyu med pa dang / gnyis nas bong bu 'ded rgyu med pas thabs zad de mjug mthar khos skyin tshab tu rang khyim gyi ra ma mang po sprad/ skabs der yang gyong gud chen po rag song /— 102 —

gnas chul dang nas lu sa/de'i rjes khos mna' bskyal dpang btsugs te sho lan tshar mang por bcad myong zer/reb cig la kho rang sde ba'i sku tshab tu sgor stong gsum lhag khyer nas sa gzhan zhig la g.yul gcog 'phrul 'khor nyo ru song / sa der thon pa na 'phrul 'khor 'tshong mkhan gyis 'phrul chas pha yul du 'byor rjes da gzod sgor sprad chog zer nas khos 'phrul chas sprod yul gyi sa gnas gsal bor bris rjes sngon la yong / pha yul du log skabs grong brdal chung chung zhig brgyud nas yong dgos pas nyin der kho rang sa der bsdad pa red/ dgong mo rang gi ngo shes sho rgyag cig dang phrad de sho khang la 'gro zer ba na/ kho yang sho skyo langs nas bslu brid de bzlog ma thub par sho rgyag tu song / mtshan gang bor sho brgyab ste nam langs la nye dus kho'i lag gi sgor mo stong gsum lhag tshang ma shor tshar/ skabs der khos sgor sum brgya logs su bzhag yod pa de yid la shar/ 'on kyang dngul tshar nas lag rtsa stong bar gyur na/ sa gom gang la'ang 'gro mi thub pa'i nyams myong rnams yid la dran/ de bas khos rang gi sho grogs lag nas sgor brgya bskyis nas sho brgyab/ de tshar rjes yang sgor brgya blangs/ de tshar ba na yang bskyar sgor brgya blangs/ snga gzhug tu sgor sum brgya bskyis pa tshang ma cung ma 'gor bar tshar song / skabs der khos bsam zhig tshugs rjes da mu mthud du 'di ltar song na dngul — 103 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/ster rgyu med pas srog kyang 'chor nges snyam nas sho rgyag mtshams bzhag ste yar langs nas sgor bud/ don dngos su nyin de ni kho la mtshon na/dmyal ba thengs shig brgyud pa dang gzhi nas mtshungs/ skabs der kho'i sems su 'gyod pa rtas mi zin pa zhig skyes kyang yod tshad 'phyis drags pa red/ nyin phyed tsam gyi ring la sems pa mnar gcod kyis bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang rjes da gzod sa gzhan la 'khyam rgyu de bdams pa red/ rgyu mtshan zhe khrel ba'i don dag 'di 'dra byas pas phyir pha yul du log kyang sgor mo'i rtsis sprod thabs med/ lo 'di dag gi ring la sho la zha ba'i sgor mo dang dngos po khyon bsdoms na ha lam sgor khri gnyis tsam la 'bud/ 6‘tag tag nga rang pha yul nas bros byol byas pa'i lo de ni nga'i bu mor slob yon med par slob grwa nas phyir pha yul la log pa'i dus de red/’ khos da dung bshad rgyur/ ‘‘gal te nga'i bu mo slob grwar song yod rgyu na/ da lta khyed tshang gi tsha mo dang 'dra bar slob grwa chen mo 'grim bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ 'on kyang bdag gi bu mo de sngon rdzong gzhan gyi zhing sde zhig la mna' mar byin/ zla gcig tsam gyi sngon la mos byis pa skyes skabs lus mtshag zhan drags pas en tsam gyis srog kyang shor song / don dag de nga'i mig gis dngos su mthong bas yid la 'gyod pas khengs shing / snying la na zug skyes song / 'di yod tshad rlag mkhan nga yin/ nga ngo ma 'gyod pa skye zer/— 104 —

gnas chul dang gnas lugs/ngas khyod kyis rang gi chung mas sen mgo khrag dang sen rting rnag gis dbyar dgun ston dpyid la ngal rtsol byas byas mthar bsogs pa'i dngul de ltar las sla mos brlags na sems kyis bzod dam zhes dris pa na/ khos don dngos su sho pham byung ba'i nyin mo re re ni nga'i sems pa ches mi skyid pa'i nyin mo re re yin/ de bas ngas nyin zhag ris med la zas chu kha la ma reg par bsdad pa'ang gang mang yod/ dang thog ngas sho brgyab ma thag nged bza' zla gnyis kyang de'i don du bza' 'khon re gnyis byas myong / rjes sor nga sho dbyings zhugs rjes mos le bda' tshig gcig kyang bshad ma myong / bud med tsho skyes pas bya ngan bsgrubs pa tshad las brgal na gshis ka je 'jam dang je gnyom red zer nas bud med la gsal cha dod po yod pa'i tshul zhig bstan pa las/ rang gi chung ma'i bde sdug dang tshor pa la do snang gang yang byed gi med pa 'dra/skabs der sde ba'i nang gi rgyal khams 'grims myong ba'i rgan po des khyod la dngos gnas chung ma rig yag cig 'dug mos khyod kyi tshe srog la bar chad yong bar dogs nas khyod kyi mi legs pa'i bya spyod la le bda' dang 'khang ra ma byas pa red/ de ni bud med de'i rigs kyi yon tan gyi cha red ya zer/ dngos gnas nga tsho'i lung pa der skyes pa zhig gis sho brgyab nas sgor khri 'ga' shor rjes rang shi brgyab pa red/ kho da dung zla phogs rag mkhan gyi las byed pa zhig red/ bshad tshul yin na/— 105 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/khos rang gi gla phogs kyis sho rkyang rgyag pa las byis pa'i slob yon la'ang kha ya mi byed pas/ kho'i bya ba med pa'i chung mas phag gso ba dang /gtsag drub byed pa sogs kyi yong sgo la brten nas byis pa'i slob yon gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba red/nged gnyis kyis kha brda'i khrod khos rang gi bu mor slob gso ma thob par mi tshe 'phro brlag tu btang bar 'gyod sems drag po skyes pa bden mod/ yin yang rang gi tshe gcig gi skya ya sdug la sbyar ba ni 'os 'tsham red snyam pa'i snang ba zhig byin/ don dngos su lo de dag gi ring ni kho'i chung mar mo nad cig byung nas sman khang du bsten ma thub par na zug bzod bsran gyis bsdad pa'i dus dang / yang khyo ga'i shi gson la sems khral byas te sems pa sdug gis mnar bzhin pho las mo las nyis brtsegs byas pa'i dus kyang red/ zhing grong nas yong ba'i mi zhig yin tshe/ ston las dang dpyid las kyi tshegs sdug ci 'dra yin pa yid la gsal nges red/gnyis/ gnas lugs/gong gi gnas tshul 'di dag ni 'u cag gi ches gzhi rim dang ches dma' sa nas byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i don dngos red/ yin na'ang don dngos la gsal cha ci yang med pa'i skyes pa kha cig gis da — 106 —

nas tshul dang nas lugs/dung bud med rnams gzhan brten srin 'bu red zer/ nga'i snang ngor 'u cag kha ba ri pa'i skyes pa rnams la dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod thun mong gi 'dra sa gcig yod pa ni/ gzhan gyi ngal rtsol 'bras bu longs spyod byed rgyur dga' ba de red/ de ni gzhan brten srin 'bu'i mtshon rtags ma yin nam/ skyes pa kha cig gis/ khe dbang rtsod dus las ka kho na rtsod pa ma red zer/ yang kha cig na re/ khe dbang rtsod pa za 'thung kho na rtsod pa ma red zer/ 'o na khyod tsho ltar na/ zas zhim po yod tshad a phas zos/ las sdug po thams cad a mas byas na da 'dra mnyam byung song ba e red/ de ni thog ma'i gzhi rtsa'i steng 'dra mnyam ma yong ba'i rtags red/ 'dra mnyam med sa zhig nas khe dbang ji ltar rtsod/ yang dpyod shes pa zhig gis bud med kyi khe dbang bud med rang nyid kyis rtsod pa las gzhan gyis ster sa 'gro ba ma red zer/ zur gcig nas bltas na/ de ni dngos gnas red mod/ 'on kyang /skye khams kyi drag zhan la brten nas bud med rnams mtha' gcig tu gdul bya red snyam pa'i khyo dbang ring lugs kyi srol rgyun 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og tu/ 'dra mnyam ji ltar gleng dgos/ khe dbang ji ltar rtsod dgos/ rtsod rgyu mang drags na skyes pa de'i rigs kyis gcar rdung mi byed pa'i nges pa'ang gtan nas yod pa ma red/ khyod kyis bshad sa'i dmigs yul grong khyer du 'tsho bzhin pa'i bud med dag yin pa bden — 107 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/mod/ yin yang 'u cag bod pa phal mo che rong 'brog khul nas yin pa khyed kyis shes gsal ltar/ khor yug de 'dra ru 'tshar longs byung ba'i nga tshor 'dra mnyam dang / khe dbang / rang dbang / rtsis thang gi 'du shes shig ji ltar skye thub/ nga tsho skyes ma thag gi blo 'byed slob gso ste/ a phas bu mo tsho skra ring la blo thung zer nas lo chung gi gangs dkar dran pa'i ngos la bud med la dpyod shes med ces thog ma nas thag gis bcad/ a mas mo lus blangs na gcar rdung nyo dgos zer nas bu mo tsho'i rtsis thang la rdog brdzis byas te bran gshis ldan pa'i mi bu dag tu skyed sring byas pa dang / yang bu mo tsho skyes ma thag nas srol rgyun dang khor yug spyi tshogs sogs kyis mtha' gcig tu yin dgag dang khyad gsod byas thog rin thang ldan pa'i mi tshe'i 'jon thang yang de la de bstun gyis 'phro brlag dang chud zos su btang dang gtong bzhin yod pa red/ de ni nga rang bud med cig yin pa dang yang khor yug de 'dra ru 'tshar longs byung zhing des bag chags zab mo bzhag yod pas yin/tha na de ring ngas rang tshod kyis lta tshul re gnyis 'bri skabs glog klad kyi gam du yi ge gtags pa'i thag sgra grags mtshams su glo bur du 'di dngos gnas yin nam rmi lam yin snyam pa'i yid ches dka' ba'i tshor pa re gnyis kyang mi skyes rang skyes red/ rgyu mtshan bud med la dpyod shes med ces pa'i tshig des bud med rnams ngang ngam shugs kyis chud zos su — 108 ge

sa tshul dang nas lu sa/gtong gin yod pa red/ 'di yod tshad kyi yod tshad srol rgyun la ma 'brel ba zhig ga la yin/ yang srol rgyun thams cad stes dbang du grub pa zhig min par bshad yod/ lar bdag ni bud med kyi khe dbang la zhib 'jug byed mkhan zhig min/ yin yang rang nyid bud med cig yin pas gangs can bud med kyi las sdug po 'di mig gis mthong thengs rer skyur skyur ba'i tshor pa rnon po zhig ngang gis byin yong ste/ rang tshod kyis 'di'i phyogs la bsam gzhig phra mo re mi gtong ka med byung song /rkyen de dag gtso byas thog gnas skabs su 'u cag kha ba ri pa'i bud med dag la mtshon na khe dbang sogs snyan snyan pa'i ming tshig 'di dag ha cang rgyas spros kyi tshod du snang na'ang / de gtan nas rag thabs med pa zhig kyang ma red/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms na 'u cag la'ang 'du shes de rigs skye nges red/ gzhan gyi sngon thon rgyal khab ltar na'ang bud med dpyod shes pa dag gis ma bskul dang len gyis bud med kyi khe dbang dang 'dra mnyam la rgyang 'bod dang brtson len byas mthar da gzod bud med tshor thob chog chog gi khe dbang de thob pa red/'u cag bud med shes yon can rnams gtso byas te bud med rtogs sad 'byung bar brtson len byas na mi 'gyangs par 'u cag la'ang 'dra mnyam gyi go sa thob par nga la yid ches brtan po yod/ rgyu mtshan ni de gzhan — 109 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/sngon thon rgyal khab dag gi bud med rnams brgyud myong ba'i lam gyi rim pa yin pas red/zhor du skyes pa dpyod shes pa dag la zhu rgyu zhig ni/ bud med la khe dbang med pa de skyes pa rnams la 'brel ba med pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ btsan po yod sa nas da gzod gnyom chung byung ba red/ khyo dbang ring lugs kyi 'byung rkyen gtso bo srol rgyun gyis skyes pa rnams la dmigs bsal gyi khyad dbang gnang ba de nas byung ba red/ spyir de ni mi'i rigs dar ma thag gi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin na mi chog pa med mod/ 'on kyang 'u cag la mtshon na/ dus rabs gsar pa'i pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi kha g.yang bar med du sgrog pa'i dus de ring / da dung gnas lugs gang yang mi brtsi bar skye khams kyi btsan shed kho nar brten nas bud med la gang 'dod du thub tshod byed kyin yod pa red/ 'u cag gi skyes pa dag gi mdzes dpyod lta ba dang 'du shes 'dzin stangs ni/bud med rnams mtha' gcig tu gdul bya ru snyam pa'i bsam blo de'o/ /de ni skyes pa rnams 95 srol rgyun gyi khyad dbang gnang drags pa'i rkyen dang / 'u cag gi rig gnas kyis pho mchog mo dman du 'dod pa'i 'du shes shugs drag pa/ tha na shes yon can skor zhig gis kyang srol rgyun gyi lta ba mkhregs 'dzin byas te mthong sne mi 'dra sa nas bud med kyi bde sdug la bsam blo zhib mo ma btang ba'i rkyen red/ de yang kho tshos — 110 —

nas tshul dang nas lugs/bshad pa bzhin mi rang nyid nas mgo rtsom ma thub pa'i rtags red snyam/skyes pa tshos 'dul bsam pa'i blo des 'u cag gi bud med rnams rang yul du sdod ma tshugs par gzhan yul du 'bro ba'i mjug 'bras de bskyed pa red/ bsam blo phra mo re btang tshe/ de yang rang re'i bud med rnams kyis phyogs mi mtshungs pa'i sa nas rang gi mi tshe'i sbyor ba'i steng khe dbang rtsod kyin pa'i rtags red/ phyi ngos nas bltas na skyes pa rnams kyis sngar bzhin srol rgyun gyis gnang ba'i khyad dbang gi cho lo de srung 'dzin byas yod na'ang / shugs na bud med rnams kyis mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin pa dper na nang log tu bag mar 'gro rgyugs che ba'i snang tshul de dag las kyang shes thub bo/ /yang ‘hi ma la ya’ zhes pa'i dra tshigs de'i steng bud med kyi gnas tshul mang po brjod yod pa las/ skyes pa skor zhig gis bud med kyi khe dbang skyes pa tshor gtan nas 'brel ba med snyam pa red/ de dag ni bsam gzhig sngon la ma song bar bstun blo ma smin pa'i lta ba yin pas de'i skor gleng rin med na'ang / de las gzhan rang nyid shes yon can du rlom mkhan dag gis dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ya nga ba'i snang tshul 'di rigs la do snang tog tsam re byas na mi chog pa ci la yod/ 'u cag khrod rtsom gyi lam nas bud med kyi bde sdug dang las dbang la thad kar bsam blo gtong ba dang the gtogs byed mkhan zhig da phan bdag gis mthong ma byung / de — 111 —

za ma mo'i skyid ga ngas ma char/yang 'u cag gi skyes pa tsho dngos yod 'tsho ba'i gnad don la rtsis mthong byed par mi dga' bar gzhung lugs sra mo'i rigs la 'ju bar dga' ba dang / yang mig mthong lag zin gyi 'tsho ba'i bde sdug la do snang byed par mi dga' bar rtog bzo dang 'phrul snang gi tshor pa skyid po 'tshol snyeg byed rgyur dga' ba'i rkyen yin na thang mod/ spyir mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos na/ pho dang mo ni bya zhig gi gshog zung lta bu red/ dpe chung chung zhig gi sgo nas bshad na/ khyim 'khos bzang zhan gyi gnad don de skyes pho mo re re la rag las yod pa bzhin no/ /2005(11nang grub/

bu mo kha sa bslas 'chong byas pa las 'phros pa'i gtam thor bu/bu mo kha shas bslus 'tshong byas pa las 'phros pa'i gtam thor bu/rong 'brog khul gyi pha ma phal mo che'i rgyud na pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes rnying pa zhig khrigs chags su yod pa red/ de yang khyim las mang che shos bu mos byed cing / khyim tshang gi rgyu nor gyi bgo skal thob pa bu mor nyung ba dang / slob gso thob pa'i go skabs kyang bu dang bu mo 'dra mnyam min pa sogs red/bdag gi khyo ga'i a khu zhig 'brog khul gyi rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring zhig gi dge rgan yin/ gnas der mtshon na kho ni shes bya yon tan 'dzoms pa'i mkhas pa zhig red/ lo du ma'i sngon du khos rang gi pha yul gyi lo rgyus dpe cha zhig kyang bris myong / kho rang la bu mo las bu gcig kyang med cing / khos bu mo tshang ma slob grwar ma bskyal bar khyim du bzhag rgyu mtshan dris tshe/ khos bu mo slob grwar bskyal kyang cang mi 'khyongs zer/ rjes sor gcig la mag pa bsus te khyim du bzhagagazhan rnams snga gzhug tu gnas la byin pa red/ de bzhin du/ 'u cag bod kyi khyim tshang zhig la bu zhig dang bu mo zhig yod cing / byis pa gcig las slob grwar bskyal ba'i cha rkyen med pa'i dbang du btang na/— 113 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/go skabs de ni bshad ma dgos par bu de la rag pa kho thag red/ slob grwa chen mo 'grim pa'i go skabs kyang de mtshungs red/rkyen de dag gi dbang gis/ bu mo tsho'i sems la/ pha ma tshor bu dang bu mor phyogs zhen yod pa dang / pha mas rang nyid las phu nu la 'dang rtsis che snyam pa'i bag chags shig 'jog gi yod pa red/ ngas tsha mo(bdag gi a ce'i bu mo) dang kha brda byed skabs mos nga la/ pha ma gnyis kas nga'i phu bo chung dus su slob grwar mngags pa dang / nga rang pha ma'i rkang tshegs lag tshegs len rogs byed du bcug nas khyim du bzhag pa yin/ de nas nga 'tshar longs byung ste gnas la 'gro ba'i dus nye skabs/rna lam du yang dang bskyar du bu mo 'gro sa gnas yin zer nas tshig brda rgyag pa red/ tha na rmo bos nga la bzhag pa'i byu ru'i ske rgyan de yang phu bo'i tshong brdibs skabs/ kho tshos dom de gsod byed du sprad song zer/skad cha 'di las kho mor pha ma gnyis la skang ra yod pa gsal bor mthong thub/'u cag bod kyi kha dpe la/ bu mo 'gro sa gnas dang / bu tsha 'dug sa gzhis yin zer/ de bas khyim tshang gi bdag po ni bu rnams yin pa dang / sgo phyi la 'gro mkhan ni 'u thug na ma gtogs bu mo dag red/ 'di ni nga tsho'i pha mes yang mes nas dar yong ba'i srol rgyun zhig red/ sngon chad yin na/ bu mo tsho mtha' gcig tu thal las rdul — 114 —
