za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/khyod kyis kho rang phal cher ngo shes kyi red/ kho ni ‘stag rgod7wu'u rdzidu red/mi su yin rung 'bad brtson la brten te rang gi bag la zha ba'i 'jon thang gang yod phyir bton na so so'i rmi lam mngon 'gyur byed thub/dka' khag ci rigs la 'phrad srid kyang / las de'i mtha' skyong ci thub byas tshe rang nyid la lam lhongs mi 'byung thabs med yin/ the ger wu'u rdzi ltar rmi lam gyi slad du 'bad brtson byas na/ nyin zhig khyod kyis kyang rang gi a mar gzim shag rgyas spros drug nyo thub min la the tshom med/sgrur mkhan gyi myong chor phran bu/ gong gi gnas tshul ltar na/ a ma rnams tshor pa skyen pas rang gi byis pa'i rang gshis la cha rgyus yod pa dang / kho mo tsho'i byams sems dang skul slong / yid ches la brten/phru gu de dag gis rang rang gi mi tshe'i rin thang mngon thub pa dang / a mas phru gur bzhag pa'i bag chags thog ma de kun las kyang gal chen po yin pa red/ de 'u cag la gsal cha ldan pa'i mi sna grags can dag gi lo rgyus las kyang shes thub/ ji skad du/ bo thar bkra shis chos 'phel lags na re/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chung ngu nas sru mo skye rgu bdag mos snyor skyong gnang zhing / dbyig gnyen dang thogs med gnyis kyang dhi stag rgod wu'u rdzi/ (1 thakhu‘spo00spu3 oṃ khroṭha 1975—〉a ri'i kol spru sgang li rgyag mkhan grags can/— 182 —

thabs la ma sa pa'i a ma dang sprung nga la pa'i byis pa/chung ngu nas pha med par yum gyis gso skyong gnang bas khong rnams yon tan sbyong ba'i go skabs byung ba yang ma yum gyi bka' drin yin/ 'dzam gling gi mi sna grags can mang po dang / mi la ras pa'i rnam thar sogs la mjal na grags g.yer che ba'i gang zag dag ma yum gyi bag chags 'og nas 'tshar longs byung ba mang shos yin/ mi la'i yum myang tsha dkar rgyan la snying rus dang u tshugs gang tsam 'dug rjes su bu thos pa dga' yang sgrub par bzhugs skabs de bzhin gyi snying rus bskyed nas mi tshe gang bor ri khrod du sgrub par bzhugs yod/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi rnam thar la gzigs na/ zhi byed gcod kyi dgongs pa dang nyams len mdzad stangs las a ma lab sgron de 'dzam gling 'dir bud med rnams las snying stobs che shos yin par go zer/ma gcig lab sgron gyis thog mar a ma'i drung du yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs nas rim gyis mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa bshad 'dug rgyal yum 'bro bza' khri ma lod mchog gis btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan sku phra ba'i dus su bod kyi rgyal srid bde bar bskyangs shing / dus der blon 'bangs khag gcig gis ngo log brgyab par drag gnon byas te rgyal khab bde 'jags dang mi rigs 'phel rgyas yong ba'i phyogs su nus pa chen po bton te rang gi tsha bo'i las don thad byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag pa lo rgyus deb ther sogs su bkod 'dug gzhan hor gtsang 'jigs med — 183 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/lags kyi〈〈drang bden gyis bslus pa'i slong mo pa〉〉zhes pa'i deb nang /dge chos chung dus nas rig pa bkra bas yum gyis khyed khyim du bsdad na don chung bas dhiḥtsha dgon du song la slob gnyer gyis zhes dre'u zhig la khal dang mnyam du sprad nas dgon par brdzangs tshul bshad rgyu yod la/dge chos rang gis bris pa'i dbyin yig gi rtsom zhig tu'ang a mas g.yang lag gis bzos pa'i bal gyi spo lo rtses pa dran tshul sogs yum gyi skor mang zhig bshad yod pa bcas yab las yum la mdzad rjes che se ba med dam snyam mo zhes brjod 'dug ma zad/ dge chos dang mi la ras pa sogs lo na chung dus nas pha 'das rjes a mas snyor skyong 'og 'tshar longs byung ba red/ gzhan da dung a ri'i srid 'dzin brgyad tsam a ma'i gso skyong 'og 'tshar longs byung ba dus deb sogs su bshad 'dugade'i phyir bu phrug la a ma'am bud med rnams kyi shugs rkyen thebs tshad de skyes pa'am a pha las khyab che bas bud med rnams kyi 'byung spus je mthor gtong rgyu de mthar gtugs na mi rigs shig gi dar rgud la 'brel ba dam po yod pa smos med red snyam/2006 09 26nyin grub/

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/a ri'i mthong thos than thun/la rtse dpe mdzod khang dang ko lum sbi ya slob chen gnyis kyi gdan zhus ltar bdag2006lo'i spyi zla3pa'i tshes6nyin zi ling nas rdog thon byas pa yin/ a ri la song ba thengs dang po yin zhing / dbyin ji'i skad yig gang yang mi shes pas sa de ga'i rig gnas dang goms srol sogs rgyus lon byed rgyu ha cang khag po yin na'ang de ru rang rigs spun zla mang po yod pas kho tsho dang kha brda 'brel 'dris byas pa sogs las byung ba'i mthong thos than thun re bris pa gsham gsal ltar/1a ri rgyal khab na bod kyi za khang kha shas 'dug zer ba thos rjes/cung yag shos yin pa'i hi ma la ya za khang der thengs shig song ba yin/za khang de ne'u yog gi 'du 'dzi che ba'i sa cha ru chags med na'ang /de'i rgya khyon ran po dang / rgyan bzo mdzes po yin thog rang re'i kha lag bzos pa'ang bro ba zhim po yin zer/ zla gcig lhag ring rig gnas gnyis kyi 'gal zla'i khrod sun snang gis gtses pa'i bdagarang rigs kyi kha lag za sa dang nang mi mnyam 'dzoms byung sa'i khor yug der 'byor skabs blo dga' bas myos song / nga'i grogs mo nged — 185 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/gnyis cog tse gru bzhi nar mo'i gam du bsdad rjes/ zhabs zhu pas lam seng ja dem gang 'khyer yong nas ja mngar mo dgos sam/ ja srub ma dgos zer nas 'dri zhor zhal zas re'u mig nged gnyis la sprad/ ngas zhal zas re'u mig lag tu blangs nas bltas tsa na/ tshang ma dbyin yig gis bris 'dug pas khyon nas ha go ma song / de bas zhabs zhu pa bu zhig yod pa der nga rang bod gzhis nas yong ba yin/ dbyin yig mi shes pas bod yig gi zhal zas re'u mig cig ster bar zhu byas pa na/mi 'dug zer/ de la ngas kun slong yag po bcangs te khyed kyis sbyin bdag la lab rogs/ za khang la bod ming btags 'dug cing /zas rigs kyang phal cher bod zas rang red/ bod pas bod zas la brten nas dngul btsal chog pa smos ma dgos/ yin na'ang / bod rang gi skad yig gi zhal zas re'u mig cig bzos na de 'dra'i ma rtsa chen po gtong e dgos sam/ gal te gzhis byes bod pa kun gyis gang nus sgos bod yig bed spyod dang khyab brdal gtong bar do snang byas tshe/phyogs gcig nas rang gi skad yig la brtsi 'jog byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod yig mi nyams pa bcas 'phral phugs gnyis phan gyi dge mtshan yang ldan nges red zer nas bshad skabs/ zhabs zhu pa bu des lan du/ sa 'di nas tshang mas dbyin yig shes gi red/ de bas bod yig 'bri dgos don mi 'dug bod yig 'bri dgos tshe zhal zas — 186 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thu /re'u mig ha cang mthug po zhig bzo dgos rgyu red zer nas zur za 'dra ba zhig byas/ skabs der/ nga'i grogs mos/ 'di ni thengs gsum pa yin/ ngas sngon ma'ang thengs gnyis la bod yig gi zhal zas re'u mig 'bri rogs zer nas zhus pa yin/ kho tshos da lta da dung snang med du bskyur bzhag 'dug zer/ kho mo ni dbus 'phan po nas thon pa'i zhing pa'i bud med phal pa zhig red/ 'di bzhin rang nus gang lcogs kyis mi rigs 'di'i las dbang dang ya nga ba'i snang tshul la sems khral chen po byed kyin pa mthong skabs nga rang ngo gnong dgos byung song /2a me ri khar bod kyi skyes pa zhig rgyal khab de'i bud med cig dang gnyen bsgrigs nas byis pa zhig skyes rjes/ kho tsho phan tshun ma 'cham ma 'grig par nang tshang kha kha la gyes dgos byung tshe/ nga tsho'i pha yul gyi srol dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar/ khyo ga des rang gi byis pa lo bco brgyad la slebs pa'i bar du 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen dang slob yon sogs dngul mang po dus bkag ltar sprod dgos par ma zad/ dus 'gyangs cung tsam dang yang na pha rol por phog thug tog tsam btang na/ kho mo tshos lam seng khrims la gtug nges red zer/ rgyun du rnam 'gyur yag pa dang bzang po ma byas par/ khrims khang du gtugs rjes/ rang — 187 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/nyid kyis kyang dngul mang po btang nas khrims rtsod pa zhig gla dgos tshod red/ pham kha myong mkhan gyi lo rgyus gsal tho dra tshigs steng 'god nges la/ khrims pham byung tsa na mi gzhan rnams kyis lta tshul mi legs pa bzung ste las ka yang btsal dka' tshod red/ de bas bza' thor byung ba'i bod kyi skyes pa kha shas shig gis a ri dag pa'i zhing khams su 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal‘‘lhag ma’zhig myong gin yod pa red zer/3dha ram sa la na a mdo'i bag ma slebs song zer ba'i bshad tshul zhig yod zer/ khyod tsho la shas kyis gtam de go yod las che/ yin kyang ngas da thengs thog dang por thos pa yin/ de la 'di skad zer/dha sa ru phyi rgyal gyi rgan mo yul skor pa kha shas slebs te dmangs srol dang rig gnas la lta zhib yag po byas rjes/ 'gro khar a mdo'i gsar bu mag pa re khrid de mda' gcig gis sha bo nyis sod kyi dpe ltar dga' ba 'bum gyis myos nas ngang pa cha ltar bud 'gro zer/ mjug 'bras la bsam blo gang yang ma btang ba'i rgan mo la las rang gi lo chung dga' rogs la a ri nas gtan sdod byed pa'i mthun rkyen gang legs bsgrubs rjes/ lo gcig gnyis ma song bar la rang nyid g.yugs te song ba na/yid 'gyod pas khengs te rgyu mtshan 'tshol bzhin 'dang phog gi med pa — 188 —

a ri'i mthong thos tha thun/red zer/ yang khog rgya che la blo rgya yangs pa'i rgan mo la las da 'dra mnyam byung song snyam pas dga' rogs la le bda' mang po byed gi med tshod red/las can gyi lo chung dga' rogs dag go skabs yag po rag nas a ri rgyal khab tu bca' sdod thub pa byung la/ yang las ngan gyi lo chung gsar bu skor zhig gis a ri'i rgan mo dha sa ru yong bar re sgug ngang mi tshe sdug zad rang du e 'gro 'dod na yid re skyo/4bshad tshul yin na/ a ri'i bod pa tshos gsar 'byor rang mi rnams la mgo ma tshos pa'i mi zer ba red/ ngas bltas na der gnas lugs med pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ nga a ri la 'byor nas bod khyim kha shas shig la song ba yin/ khyo ga rnams dngos gnas mi tshegs yang dang mi las ka can dag dag red/ so so'i chung mas zas g.yo bskol grub ste kha lag zos rjes/ kho tsho'i khyo ga rnams kyis ma bskul dang len gyis dkar yol sla nga sogs gtsang 'khrud byas te thab tshang gral dag bzo bar ma zad/ kho tsho tshang ma gnas lugs brtsi mkhan dag tu'ang gyur 'dug par snang / ngas khyo ga tsho ji ltar de bzhin du gyur pa dris pa na/ kho tsho'i chung ma tshos/ khyo ga tsho 'gan 'khri yod pa dang — 189 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/khyim las tsag tsig thad phan tshun 'dra mnyam yong ched kho mo tshos kyang 'bad brtson gang mang byas myong / la shas kyis da dung phan tshun bar tshig gan 'jog pa nas 'go brtsams pa yin zer/ dper na/ de ring khyo gas kha lag bzos na/ chung mas dkar zangs bkru ba/ byis pa bu bcol khang la'ang khyo shug res mos kyis skyel bsu byed pa yin zer/chung ma'i las ka brel ba che skabs nang tshang gi las ka khyo gas byed pa lta bu/khyo ga tsho 'di lta bur gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo khor yug la rag las yod pa red zer/ gang ltar kyang kho tsho'i khyo ga tshor khyo ga'i 'gan 'khri yod par ma zad/ byis par byams shing chung mar brtse ba sha stag tu'ang gyur 'dugangs ku re'i tshul gyis/ 'u cag gi khyo ga rnams mgo tshos pa zhig chags dgos na/ a ri nas lo kha shas la sbyong brdar byed dgos rgyu red/ de 'dra yin na ma rtsa che song ba ma yin nam zhes par kho tsho tshang ma dgod kha shor song /5a ri na yod pa'i rang rigs kyi bud med kha shas shig phyi gling pa dang gnyen bsgrigs 'dug pa mthong / ngas bud med de 'dra gcig la rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ mos bshad rgyur/ sngon chad bod na yod dus bhe 190 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/rang nyid dga' ba'i skyes pa zhig dang gnyen bsgrigs nas byis pa'ang skyes/ khyo shug zung gis lo gcig gnyis can gyi byis pa rum la bzung nas pha yul dang pha ma rgyab la bskyur te mi yul lung pa 'grims pa yin/lung pa gzhan la 'byor rjes yod tshad yang bskyar mgo rtsom dgos pas/dka' sdug dang pham kha gang mang khrod dang thog gi rmi lam la'ang chag grum shor song / rkyen de dag gi dbang gis khyo ga'i sems pa rbad de skyid ma song la/ nang sems kyi sdug bsngal dbo sa tag tag chung ma rang yin pas sha lpags kyi mnar gcod las thar ched khyo ga dang kha mi 'bral thabs med byung song zer/ bud med gzhan kha shas shig phyi gling par gnyen bsgrigs pa'i rkyen gtso bo'ang de red zer/ bshad tshul yin na gnas tshul de rigs a mdo pa'i nang du byung ba cung mang po 'dug zer/ de bas pha yu/la la log rjes grogs po tsho dang mnyam du de phyogs kyi gtam gleng byed skabs/ grogs po zhig gis de ni a mdo'i bud med rnams lan pa red/ kho mo tsho ma gzhi nas bsam pa brtan po min tshod red zer/ ngas lan du khyod tsho‘‘gru dpon rnams kyis gru la kha lo yag po ma byas na/ gru steng gi 'grul pa'i sems pa brtan po yo/nga rgyu khag po red zer ba na/ der 'khod kyi ma sru zhig gis dpe 'jog de 'byor mo 'dug zer/

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/6kho rang lo bcu drug gi steng du dha sa la 'byor ba red/ de ru lo drug lhag la bsdad rjes a ri la yong thub pa byung song / de sngon kho rang grwa pa dkyus ma zhig yin dus grwa pa gzhan dang mnyam du sing ga phor dang tha'e wan/ kha na ta sogs rgyal khab kyi khyim tshang du song nas bca' ba rim gro bsgrubs myong ba red/ khos bshad rgyur/ dus rgyun bca' ba rim gro 'don skabs rang sems 'don pa'i nang 'khor mi thub par sems su nyin gung gi kha lag gang 'dra sprod rgyu yin nam/ dgong kha'i 'bul ba ga tshod 'bul rgyu yin nam snyam pa'i sems byung ngan pa skyes te gzhan la phan thogs pa lta zhog rang sems kyang ye nas 'dul thabs bral/ da dung kho dang mnyam du song ba'i grwa pa kha shas kyis dgong mor grwa chas phud de grong chas gyon nas bud med btsal du 'gro ba'ang yod pa red/ nga rang gis de 'dra'i nyes pa bsags med na'ang / skya min ser min gyis gzhan la mgo g.yog mgo skor gtong ba'i 'tsho ba der rang sems kyis ma bzod pas skya sar babs pa yin/ kho tsho nang bzhin gyi grwa pa ngas kyang byed thub mod/ de 'dra byas na las rgyu 'bras la'ang mi mthun snyam/ lo drug lhag gi sngon nas nga rang gi rngul chu la brten te 'tsho ba rol 'go brtsams pa yin la/ da lta lag 'bab kyang ran po — 192 —

a ri'i mthong thos tha thu /yod pas/ ngas cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i dha sa'i grwa pa gnyis dang jo mo gnyis la zla rer 'tsho ba'i kha snon gyi dngul nyung tsam re skur gyin yod/de yang phyogs gcig nas rang nyid skya sa la babs par ltung bshags byed pa yin zer/7nyin der grogs mo zhig dang mnyam du mi zhig la sgug sdod skabs/mdun phyogs su phyi gling pa'i skyes pa dar ma zhig gis lag g.yas par khyi zhig khrid pa dang lag g.yon par shog ('gyig shog) khug chung chung zhig bzung yod/ de'i nang du khyi skyag re gnyis btus 'dug pa mthong dus/ngas de 'dra dpe srid rgyu ma red snyam nas grogs mor 'dri ma phod/ khyi de tag tag nged gnyis kyi sngon du slebs pa na/ lam 'gram gyi me tog nang la khyi skyag cig btang song / mi des lam seng khyi skyag de khug ma'i nang du blugs/ da ni khug ma'i nang gi de khyi skyag yin par thag chod song / yin na'ang khyi skyag 'thu ba'i rgyu mtshan ha ma go khos khyi skyag btus nas ga re byed gi yod pa red ces dris pa na/ grogs mos der dgos mkho gang yang yod pa ma red/ 'di ltar byed rgyu de sa 'di'i goms srol zhig tu chags yod pa red zer/ skabs der/ nged gnyis las lta rtog byed mkhan gyi mi gzhan su yang mi 'dug

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/8a ri'i bod khyim kha shas su song ba na/ nga'i snang ngor nga tsho dang ha cang mi 'dra ba'i tshor pa zhig byin pa ni kho tsho'i thab tshang che zhing rgyas spros yin pa dang / drod skyid ldan par bzos yod pa de red/ ngas grogs po zhig la rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ kho pas bshad rgyur/ sngon chad yin na a ri nas kyang thab tshang ha cang gu dog la/ phal cher bud ped gcig rang sdod sa lta bu zhig tu bzos 'dug rim bzhin spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang / khrims lugs 'thus tshang / 'tsho ba'i chu tshad je mthor phyin pa dang 'brel/ thab tshang je che je legs su gtong ba nas brtsams te pho mo 'dra mnyam yong thabs byas pa red/ thabs lam de la nus pa'ang yag po thon yod tshod red de/ da lta khyo ga mang shos kyis khyim las byed gi 'dug cing / gnas tshul de 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs rgyun ldan can du gyur 'dug pas/ grogs po rnams kyang thab tshang du yong nas khyim bdag dang mnyam du kha lag bzo ba dang dkar zangs bkru ba sogs kyi srol yang chags 'dug de'i phyir a ri'i nang tshang dag gis 'grul khang las thab tshang la dang dod byas 'dug pa red/ kho tsho'i thab tshang du me tog tshom bu dang / btung ja sna tshogs/ a rag da dung kho h+phe/ sil tog dpe cha dang dus deb la sogs mang po 'dug— 194 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/bdag gis kyang phyir pha yul du log rjes thab tshang la bcos bsgyur thengs shig byed bsam pa yin/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i thab tshang gi rgya khyon chung drags pas/ de ru bud med gcig las phal cher ran po mi 'duga'adi las nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad ltos bcas kyis a ri las zhan pa dang bsam blo'i 'du shes kyang kho tsho las rnying pa tshor thub/ 'o na nga tshos thab tshang gi grub stangs je legs su gtong ba'i bar du sgug sdod dgos sam/ yang na bsam blo'i bag chags rnying pa 'dor ba nas mgo rtsom dgos/ de ni bsam blo nges par du gtong dgos pa zhig red snyam/9go tshul ltar na/ nye lam a ri'i bud med mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyis chung mas nang tshang du byis pa bdag skyong dang khyim 'khos 'du 'god byed pa dang / khyo gas sgo phyi nas las ka byas te khyim mi'i 'tsho thabs sbyor ba'i las ka gnyis rin thang 'dra mnyam dang / de gnyis la gang bzang gang zhan/ gang mchog gang dman/ gang gtso gang phal dbye mi chog par khrims su gtan khel byed kyin yod pa red zer/a ri rgyal khab tu ltos bcas kyis pho mo 'dra mnyam yin na'ang /da lta da dung bud med rnams 'dzin skyong las khungs su bya ba byed mkhan brgya cha'i bcu las zin med zer/ gnas tshul der gsal cha yod pa'i — 195 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/grogs mo zhig gis bshad pa ltar na/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo bud med ni a ma yin pas phru gu skyes rjes byis pa'i snyor skyong thad chu tshod mang po 'phro brlag gtong dgos pas na/ gzhung dang sger gyi las khungs dang khe las sogs kyis rang gi khe phan la dmigs nas bud med las skyes par las gnas sprod par dga' po yod pa red zer/ de bas bud med mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyis byis pa ji ltar skyes na da gzod bud med la 'dra mnyam yong thub pa sogs kyi phyogs su bsam blo dang gros zhib 'don gyin yod pa red zer/nga rang mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs thog khang chen mor lta skor la 'gro skabs/ bud med mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi gros khang nang du spyi mtshan ri mo zhig mthong / yin yang bdag gis de don ci yin ha ma gosne shan pas de ni pho mo'i lus 'brel mtshon pa'i ri mo zhig red/ ri mo de ru spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod phan tshun gcig la gcig brten zhing so sor 'bral du med pa'i pho mo'i 'brel ba de ston gyin 'dug pa red zer/phyogs 'di nas bltas na'ang pho mo 'dra mnyam dang khyim mi 'cham mthun yong bar 'dzam gling thun mong gis gtsigs chen byed pa mthong thub/10nyin zhig a mdo'i grogs po zhig gis mgron bsu byas te nga tsho mi — 196 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/kha shas mnyam du 'khod skabs/ tshang mas pha yul gyi bud med tsho'i las dbang skor kha brda byas/ skyes pa zhig gis nga tsho bod pa la srol rgyun de 'dra'i yag po yod pas bud med kyi khe dbang rtsod dgos don ga la yod /chung dus pha yul du pha dang bu rnams tsha thab steng bsdad rjes a mas kha lag bzos te 'dren pa'i snang tshul de ci 'dra'i skyid pa la ang zer/dang thog ngas de ni ku re yin par 'dod/ rjes sor yang de dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i gtam kha shas gleng byung bas/ ku re min pa gzhi nas tshor te/ khyed kyis a ma'i myong tshor la bsam blo btang e myong /khyed rang gong du bzhugs mkhan rang yin pas zhabs tog sgrub mkhan gyi tshor pa nam yang myong dka' ba red/ khyo gas chung ma'i bde sdug la bsam blo mi gtong ba de ni/ mi dkar pos mi nag po'i bde sdug la bsam blo mi gtong ba dang / bdag pos g.yog po'i bde sdug la do snang mi byed pa/ sger gcod pas mi dmangs kyi bde sdug la kha ya mi byed pa dang gcig mtshungs ma yin nam zhes pa na/ kho rang dogs ma bde ba'i tshul gyis ngas ngo ma khyed rang bud med tsho'i tshad nas bsam blo btang ma myong zer/ ngas lan du/ de da khyed rang bza' thor byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo yin kyang srid ces lab pa yin/ der mthud nas der 'khod kyi grogs mo zhig gis deng skabs kyi bud med gna' rabs kyi bud med dang mi 'dra/ lto rgyab song ba tsam gyis mi — 197 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/chog par/ pho khyo ga rnams la'ang pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs chags dgos pa red zer/ yin yang bod kyi gnas tshul de 'dra ma red zer nas mos dpe zhig bzhag pa red/ mo rang a ri la ma yong sngon bod nas las ka byed pa yin la/ thengs shig las ka'i dgos mkho'i ched du las rogs skyes pa kha shas dang mnyam du dpa' lung la thengs shig song ba yin/ dpa' lung gi khyim tshang zhig tu slebs skabs/las grogs skyes pa rnams la khyim bdag gis tsha thab steng 'bud dgos pa'i brda bstan pa dang / kho mor go kha ru 'dug dgos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ mo rang de ma nyid du rlung langs te thad kar tsha thab steng bud pa na/ sde ba de'i pho mo rnams ha las hon thor song zer/spyir dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kho mo nang bzhin tsham tshom med par 'dra mnyam rtsod mkhan ha cang nyung na'ang / bud med la rang gshis dang rtsis thang yod pa ma red zer na nor 'khrul du 'dug ste/ rgyu mtshan ni skyes ma rnams kyang skyes pa ltar sems phugs su rang dbang can las gzhan dbang can la dga' ba ma red/ de'ang mthar gtugs na nga tsho tshang ma mi yin pa'i phyir red do/ /11nyin der bod kyi rig gnas la gsal cha yod pa'i phyi gling ma zhig — 198 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thu /dang lab gleng byed skabs/ ngas kho mor khyod kyis bltas na nga tsho rjes lus thebs pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang red zer nas dris pa na/ mos nga la/ mi rigs la sngon thon dang rjes lus zer rgyu yod pa ma red zer/de la ngas phyi dngos po dang nang bsam blo gnyis kyi steng nas dpe re drangs te bshad pa yin/ nga tsho'i pha yul du bud med phal mo che'i phru gu sman khang du skye thub gi med/ de gtso bo phyi dngos po'i rjes lus te dpal 'byor cha rkyen zhan pa'i dbang gis red/ bud med kha shas shig gis phru gu bong khang(bong bu 'dogs sa'i khang pa)dang yang na gral dkyil du thal rdul gtor ba'i steng du skye ba red/ de ltar byed don ni nga tsho ltar na/ phru gu skye skabs bud med kyi lus na grib zer ba'i 'jigs su rung ba zhig yod pa dang / de tag tag skyes pa rnams la phog 'gro zer ba red/ de ni nang bsam blo rjes lus yin pa'i rtags red/ nga la bu mo che ba skyes nas bang la bsdad yod dus bdag gi a mas kyang nga'i khyo gar grib phog dogs nas zhed pa red/ 'o na khyod kyis shod dang 'di dag rjes lus kyi mtshon rtags min na gzhan ci red/ kho mos nga'i dri ba de la lan drang mor mi 'debs par/ don dam par rjes lus ngo ma nga red/ khyod kyis rang gi mi rigs la sha tsha bo de 'dra byed pa mthong na nga rang ngo gnong yong zer/ 'gro khar mos bod kyi bud med nang 'di ltar bsam blo gtong shes mkhan yod pa nga rang hang sang song zer/ kho mos — 199 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/skad cha de tshad gang zhig nas bshad pa mi shes na yang / gang ltar ngas bltas na 'u tsho rjes lus yin pa kho mos shugs nas khas blangs song snyam/12nga rang bod mo bu rdzi ma zhig dang mnyam du thengs gnyis tsam la byis pa'i rol rtsed khang zhig tu song ba yin/ de ru yod pa tshang ma slob lo ma ran pa'i lo gcig gnyis tsam gyi byis pa dag red/ rol rtsed khang de gnyer mkhan srid gzhung ma yin par mi sger red zer/ nang du ri mo 'bri sa dang rol mor nyan sa/ kha lag za sa/ btung ja 'thung sa/ mar la shud sa/ yar la 'dzegs sa/ gyang ngor rtse chas sna tshogs sbyor sa/ 'gyig shog gi bcos ma'i sil tog sna tshogs dang /sngo tshod/ da dung za ma g.yo bskol gyi ca lag che chung mang po 'dugabyis pa'i rtse ra de'i nang du nyung mtha' yang byis pa bcu lhag 'dus 'dug na'ang byis pa de rnams phan tshun bar 'dzing res dang rdung res gtan nas mi byed/ nga rang ya mtshar nas/ bod mo bu rdzi ma der dris pa na/ mos nga la gnas lugs ldan pa'i skad cha zhig bshad byung / a ri'i pha ma mang che shos kyis byis par gtan nas gcar rdung mi byed par ma zad/ byis pa'i mthong lam dang thos lam du bza' 'khon yang byed pa ma red/ byis pas mi gzhan gyis 'khon 'dzing dang gcar rdung byed — 200 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thu /pa mthong myong med pas/ kho tshos kyang mi gzhan la 'khon 'dzing dang gcar rdung byed shes gi med pa red zer/ de dngos gnas rang red/der ma zad/ bdag gi bsam par/ byis pas dri tshig gang rung 'dri skabs pha mas rdzun gtam mi lab pa'i thog skabs dang skabs su byis pa'i dri bar dris lan drang mor btab ste/ byis pa'i shes 'dod kyi re ba bskangs nas spro snang la khyad gsod ma byas pas byis pa de rnams mi gshis cung drang mo dang / gdug tsub cung chung ba/ gzhan la rdzun mi lab pa/ phan tshun la gcar rdung mi byed pa sogs su chags song ba yin rgyu red 'dod/ de yang kho tsho'i rig gnas dang pha ma'i slob gso la 'brel ba dam po yod par gdon mi za'o/ /gzhan/ a ri'i byis pa de dag gi 'tsho ba ha cang phun tshogs yin par ma zad/ khyim du byis pas brnyan 'phrin sogs lta skabs/ khyim mis 'grul pa dang skad cung chen pos kha brda 'dra byed skabs kyang byis pas pha mar de ltar byed mi chog pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa red/ gang ltar kyang kho tsho'i byis pa rnams kha chen dbang chen rang red/13grogs po zhig gis ched du nga khrid nas kho rang gi byis pa yod sa'i slob chung slob grwa der lta skor la song / bshad tshul ltar na/ a rir — 201 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/grong khyer dang cung thag ring ba'i gnas dben sa na chags pa'i slob grwa legs shos su brtsi ba red zer/ slob grwa de yang ha cang lhing 'jags yin par ma zad mtha' 'khor du sdong po dang me tog mang po 'dug ma gzhi nged gnyis kyis kho'i byis par slob khrid byed pa zhig blta bsam pa yin mod/ snga mo nas dus chad byas med pas/ slob khang nang du thad kar 'gro dka' ba red/ de bas slob khang gi bar khyams su yud tsam bsdad pa na/ slob ma mang po'i dpe khug khang pa'i bar khyams su spungs 'dug ngas de ci yin ma shes pas grogs por dris pa na/ khos bshad rgyur a ri'i slob chung slob ma yin rung slob khrid mang che shos dmar khrid red/ de bas slob khang la nges gtan yod pa ma red/slob khang dag glog klad dang rdzas 'gyur tshod lta byed sa/ rno sbreng rdung sa dang / ri mo rko 'bag las sa sogs su bzos yod pas/ slob ma rnams res mos kyis slob thun re re la slob khang brje dgos pa red/thengs shig la kho rang khyim bdag gi tshab tu byis pa'i khrims lugs slob khrid la nyan skabs tag tag a ri'i9 11don rkyen byung nas cung ma 'gor ba'i dus la khel/ dge rgan gyis slob ma re rer9 11gi don rkyen la dbye zhib dang 'byung rkyen la zhib 'jug byed du bcug ste slob ma rnams dngos su gyod gzhi de'i nang zhugs nas rang gi blo rig la brten te gnas tshul de'i 'byung rkyen dang dogs gzhi sogs la dpyad pa gtong — 202 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/gi yod pa red zer/ grogs pos a ri'i slob khrid byed stangs 'di la bltas na mi rnams rig pa rno zhing rnam rig mi rgyas thabs med red zer/14thog dang por a ri la slebs pa na grogs po mang po zhig gis 'grem ston khang la blta dgos zer/ nga rang de la dga' snang chen po ma skyes/ rgyu mtshan pha yul du yang 'grem ston khang kha shas su song myong ba'i rkyen yin las che/ wa zhin thon la slebs rjes grogs po dang grogs mo kha shas kyis khrid de 'grem ston khang mang por song ba na/ spro snang ldab 'gyur gyis je cher song / rang byung 'grem ston khang zhig la slebs pa na/ de ru gser dngul zangs lcags dang / g.yu byur mu tig g.yang ṭi la sogs rin po che mthong ma myong ba mang po 'dug de las kyang ha cang blta ri ba ni/ rin po che gser yin na'ang / de las snon ma byas sngon gyi rang mdangs gang 'dra yin pa dang / cung las snon byas rjes dang / yang dngos su thon rdzas su grub rjes kyi mdzes dang mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa re re nas bstan yod par ma zad/ 'grem ston khang du/ rin po che thon yul gyi sa rdo ngo mas gter ri gang de bsdur tshad ltar chung du btang nas 'dra dpe gson nyams ldan pa re bzos yod pa dang / bzo pas gser ji ltar brko ba'i tshul mtshon pa'i — 203 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/'dra par yang sbyar 'dug de min/ rin po che rko byed kyi lag cha dang thag pa/ skas la sogs bshams yod pa red/ des nga tshor bsam blo gtong phyogs gsar pa zhig ngang gis sbyin yong bar ma zad/ rin chen gser yin yang las snon ma byas sngon la ha cang spyir btang dang phal pa yin pa bstan yod/ 'grem ston khang de'i nang du slob phrug mang pos dge rgan la dri ba mang po 'don pa mthong dus/ bdag gi bsam par dge rgan gyis rang gis mi shes bzhin slob mar rdzun lab kyin e yod snyam pa'i dogs pa skyes na'ang a ri'i dge rgan gyis de ltar byed pa ma red zer/15a ri na yod pa'i bod mi rnams mnyam 'dzoms kyi go skabs mang po 'dug kho tsho dus dran srung brtsi dang bsang mchod sogs rig gnas 'dzin skyong gi bya 'gul bsgrub rgyur dga' po yod tshod red/ nyin zhig nga rang ched du rig gnas 'dzin skyong gi dgong tshogs shig la zhugs pa yin/ de'i pa se re la ar sgor bco lnga red/ nga ni rgyang ring gi mgron po yin pa shes rjes pa se'i rin pa yang mi len par tshoms khang gi gar stegs dang ches thag nye sa ru sdod du bcug tshoms khang de ru phal cher mi stong gnyis gsum tsam 'dus 'dug la mang che shos kyis bod chas — 204 —

a ri'i mthong thos than thun/gyon 'dug gzhan da dung phyi rgyal gyi gsar 'god pa dang 'khrab ston pa yang kha shas 'dug ngas phyi rgyal du bod mi mnyam 'dzoms rgya chen po 'di 'dra mthong ba thog dang po yin pas/ bshad mi shes pa'i tshor snang zhig skyes byung /dgong tshogs kyi dbu mdzad grwa pa zhig red/ khong gis phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod mi yongs kyis rang gi rig gnas gang nus kyis 'dzin skyong byed rgyu dang / byis pa rnams kyis phyi gling pa'i bya spyod mi legs par mi sbyang bar rang gi srol rgyun yag po rgyun 'dzin byed dgos tshul sogs kyi skor gtam bshad mang po byas/ bdag gi sems la yang ci ma bden snyam pa'i nges shes skyes/ de nas gzhon nu gnyis kyis rig rtsal le tshan la stangs 'dzin byas pa red/ tshoms khang yongs su thal mo rdeb sgra'i khrod du le tshan thog ma rtsam pa brdzi ba'i 'gran bsdur byas/ pho mo gang rung lnga gar stegs su 'bud pa'i brda brgyab pa na/ skyes pa lnga rang 'gul gyis gar stegs steng du bud/ gzhon nu ma lngas ja dem khyer yong ste 'gran rtsod pa rnams la brdzi khu blugs tshar rjes stangs 'dzin pas rtsam pa brdzi mgo rtsom pa'i brda brgyab pa dang / 'gran rtsod pa rnams de mur rtsam pa brdzi ba'i las la zhugs pa red/ rgyal pham gyi dbye ba phye rjes ang dang por bya dga' gnangs nas lta mkhan spun zla rnams kyis thal mo dang bcas rten 'brel zhus/ de'i rjes stangs 'dzin pas le — 205 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/tshan gnyis pa bod lwa gyon pa'i myur tshad 'gran rgyu yin par bsgrags/yang pho mo gang rung lnga gar stegs steng gdan 'dren zhus pa na/ sngar bzhin skyes pa lnga snga gzhug tu gar stegs steng bud de stangs 'dzin pas brda brgyab pa dang 'brel tshang mas gang nus kyis hur brtson byas te ang dang po 'gran rtsod bgyis/ le tshan gsum pa nas bzung phal cher mjug bsdu ba'i bar du bod gzhas sna tshogs btang ba red/ de bzhin na gzhon pho mo rnams kyis rang gi thun min gyi glu ngag dang gar stabs ngom par lta mkhan gyi dga' bsu chen po thob/ de dag las kyang gleng ri ba zhig ni/ 'jar pan nas yin pa'i skyes pa cung rgan pa zhig gis bod chas bca' dag cig gyon te pi wang 'then zhing nang ma dang stod gzhas 'khrab pa dang / yang a ri'i bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig gis sgra snyan dkrol bzhin a mdo'i bdung len rnal ma zhig blangs song bas nga rang ya mtshar song /a ri'i bod pa rnams kyi rnam dag gi kun slong dang mdzes sdug gi phugs sems/ nyams mtshar ba'i glu gar sogs mthong skabs rang rigs 'di gong 'phel yar rgyas 'gro nges bsam pa'i tshor pa zhig kyang skyes byung / yin na'ang skabs shig nga rang chab gsang la phyin pa na gnas tshul yid phangs pa kha shas shig mthong byung / tshoms khang phyi rol gyi bar khyams su rang rigs byis pa mang po rtsed 'jor g.yeng 'dug — 206 ge

a ri'i mthong thos than thu /cing / kho tsho phan tshun bar la dbyin ji'i skad rkyang rkyang las bod skad gcig kyang rgyag gi mi 'dug de sngon nga rang a ri la ma song sngon dra rgya'i steng a ri nas skyes pa'i byis pa rnams kyis gza' nyi ma'i dus tshod bed spyad de bod yig sbyong gi yod rabs zer ba mthong myong / yin yang snang tshul de mthong skabs zi ling grong khyer du yod pa'i rang rigs kyi byis pa6‘rgya phrug’ dag yid la dbang med du 'khor yong / der ma zad gsang spyod khang gi gtsang sbra'ang dgong tshogs sngon dang bsdur na gad snyigs mang pos khengs 'dug cing / des ni rang dbang med par lha sa'i bar skor dran yong / nga tsho bod pa rnams sa phyogs gang du gnas kyang gtsang sbra la do snang mi byed pa 'di thun mong gi nad rigs shig min nam snyam/2006 05 25nyin grub/

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/h+pha ran si'i bu mo zhig gi lhag bsam/nyin kha shas shig gi sngon la h+pha ran si'i grogs mo zhig nga'i khyim la phebs yong / nged gnyis lo brgyad tsam gyi sngon la phan tshun ngo shes par ma zad/ grogs mo yag shos su gyur yod/ yin yang lo lnga tsam gyi ring la nged gnyis dngos su 'phrad ma byung / 'phrin yig las mo rang dbul phongs kyi rgyal khab kha shas su song nas dbul skyor gyi bya ba byed bzhin yod zer/ da thengs mo rang bod la yong don lha sa nas bod rigs las sgug na gzhon rnams la ched las lag rtsal slob grwa zhig 'debs ched yin zer/ kho mos bshad pa yin na/ de ga'i srid gzhung dang mnyam las byed dgos pas 'gro lugs mang po bsgrubs nas mos dka' las khag po myangs song zer/ ngas mo la 'di ltar sgrub don ci yin zer ba na/ mos na ning mo rang dha sa na yod dus/ bod rigs na gzhon mang po der thon yong / yin yang sa de nas kyang las ka rag dka' ba mthong rjes/ sems la gal te lha sa nas bod rigs na gzhon rnams la lag rtsal sbyang sa zhig btsugs tshe/ rjes ma rang yul nas rang kha sos par ma zad/ me 'khor shar gtong byas rjes kyang las rigs sna tshogs la zhugs pa'i go skabs de gzhan kho na'i lag la mi — 208 —

h+pha ran si'i bu mo ga lha bsam/'chor bar rang la rag nges bsam nas/ ched las lag rtsal slob grwa zhig 'dzugs rgyu yid la dran/ mo rang gtso byas pa'i grogs mo bzhi tsam las ka 'dir zhugs yod zer/ kho tshos thog mar rang gi rgyal khongs nas rogs ram tshogs pa'i las khungs la snyan zhu phul nas ma dngul bsdu grabs byas/ de min rgya gar na kho mo'i grogs po glu pa glu ma kha shas yod pas/ kho tshos thengs 'di'i ma dngul bsdu bar ram 'degs 'khrab ston yang byas zer/ lha sa nas 'brel yod las khungs dang 'gro lugs phal cher bsgrubs tshar rjes/ zi ling du las ka 'di'i rigs bsgrubs myong mkhan gyi mi sna btsal nas nyams myong blangs/ ched las slob grwa de las shing bzo dang 'tshem bzo/ zas bzo/ yul skor sne shan gyi shes bya/ rtsis 'khor/ dbyin ji'i skad dang / h+pha ran si'i skad sogs slob khrid byas te de'i phyogs kyi ched las mi sna skyed sring byed rgyu yin zer/mo rang snga mo nas bod la brtse dung yod pa ngas shes mod/ 'on kyang kho mos dka' tshegs gang mang la mi 'dzem par/ gzhan gyi mi rigs shig la snying khong rus pa'i steng nas sha tsha tsha dang rus dung dung gis don bzang yag po 'di 'dra zhig sgrub pa nga'i yid la'ang shar ma myong /2005 10 20nyin grub/

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/skad yig nyams pa 'u tsho rang nyid lan/1da lo'i dbyar kha'i nyin zhig la nga rang gzhung las khang du sdod skabs/ khul rim pa'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyi bud med las byed pa zhig nga tsho'i gzhung las khang du slebs/ lo du ma'i sngon la kho mos nga tsho'i las khungs su zab sbyong byas myong bas/ ngas mo rang ngo shes pa yin/ de bas de ma thag khyod bde mo yin nam zhes 'tshams 'dri byas pa na/ mos lan du ‘oṃṣā ’zer/ khyod rang zi ling du nam thon pa yin zer dus/ ‘tshosnu’’zer/ las ka ci zhig byed du yong ba yin zhes dris pa na kho mos yang bskyar rgya skad kyis lan btab/ des nga rang la tshor pa ya mtshan zhig byin pa las/ thabs gzhan gang yang med song /2zi ling du bod kyi nang ma khang dang za khang kha shas byung ba dang /nga'i sems par da ni nga tshor khams g.yeng byed sa dang / byis pa rnams la rang mi rigs kyi 'du shes chags sa'i khor yug cig yod song snyam nas dga' spro skyes/ gza' spen pa'i dgong mo zhig la/ nga tsho — 210 —

da yi nyams pa 'u cho rang nyid lan/nang ma spro skyid khang ga ge mo zhig la khams g.yeng du song / btung ja dang kha tog 'ga' blangs tshar rjes rtsis rgyag skabs sgor mo ga tshod red ces dris pa na/ lus la phu med spus dag gyon pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma des rgya skad kyis lan btab/ gang trem la mgron po rnams kyis thal mo rdeb sgra'i khrod/ rig col le tshan dngos su 'go brtsams song /stangs 'dzin pas rgya skad gtso byas thog stangs 'dzin mdzad pa dang /de bzhin du lus la bod lwa gyon zhing ming la bod ming btags pa/mgul la kha btags bsgron pa'i glu pa glu ma dag gis rgya skad gtso byas nas gzhas mang po btang ba red/ dgung mo der bltas tshod kyis lta mkhan mang che shos bod pa red/3yang nyin zhig bod kyi ja khang ga ge mo zhig tu song / der rgyan bzo rgyas spros byas 'dug cing / bod rang gi khyad chos kyang dod po ldan/ bod kyi ja rigs sna tshogs 'dzoms khar/ sbyin bdag dang zhabs zhu pa thams cad bod pa rang red/ sbyin bdag gis kyang kho tsho'i ja khang 'di bod rang gi rig gnas dang goms gshis sogs khyab bsgrags byed sa'i sge'u khung zhig tu 'gyur ba'i 'char gzhi dang bsam tshul rgya chen yod zer ba thos skabs nga rang zhe rab tu dga' song / ja — 211 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/khang de'i mdzes chos bkod pa la myong rol cung tsam byas rjes phyir log grabs byed skabs mig mdun du dpe sgrom gral dag cig mngon/ ngas dpe cha re re lag tu blangs te gsal bor bltas/ yid phangs pa zhig la/ dpe sgrom de'i nang du bod yig gi dpe cha deb gcig kyang mthong ma byung / der yod pa mtha' dag rgya yig gi dpe cha dang dus deb rkyang red/4nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la/ khyim du tshang mas bod skad gtsang ma rgyag dgos pa'i sgrigs shig btsugs yod/ nged tshang du nga rang rgya skad bod skad 'dres ma'i skad cha bshad pa cung tshabs che bas byis pa dang khyo gas rtag tu dag sel byed gi yod/ yin na'ang gzhung las khang du slebs pa na/ las rogs tshang mas rgya skad bod skad 'dres ma bshad pa rgyugs che bas/ rang la bod skad gtsang ma lab pa'i khor yug med pa'i snang ba ster/ gang ltar khyim gyi sgrig lam de'i dbang gis skad cha bshad skabs mnyam 'jog mi byed thabs med byung / de bas las rogs rnams kyis ra ma lug gi skad cha bshad par yang mnyam 'jog mi byed rang byed red/de nyin gzhung las khang du pha yul khri ka nanu yin pa'i bu mo snyan — 212 —

da yi nyams pa 'u tsho rang nyid lan/sgron pa zhig gi skad cha'i nang du rgya skad kyi ming tshig bzhag pa ha cang tshabs che bas/ ngas bsam gzas nas khyod rang snyan sgron pa zhig yin pas skad cha de rigs bshad na rjes phyogs rang gi bcar 'dri'i las kar gnod skyon thebs nges red ces lab pa na/ mos kho tsho'i pha yul du rgyun 'byams su song ba'i rgya skad kyi ming tshig skor zhig bod skad kyis bshad na yul mi tshos 'phya smod byed 'ong zer/ ngas de lta yin na'ang mang tshogs nor bzhin du nga tsho yang kho tsho'i rjes su ded na de ga la 'grig ces bshad pa yin/ dngos gnas pha yul gyi mang tshogs skor zhig gis rgyun 'byams su song ba'i rgya skad kyi ming tshig kha shas shig rgya skad yin min kyang shes gi med pa red/5tag tag lo bcu'i sngon zhig la/ nged khyim mi gsum po byis/ pa'i gling ga ru khams g.yeng byed skabs/ thag mi ring ba'i sa na/ gro tshang nas yong ba'i pho mo rgan pa skor zhig gis spro skyid kha lag za bzhin kha brda 'dra min byed kyin 'dug skabs shig la bu mo g.yang 'dzoms bzang mos/ kho tshos skad cha ci zhig bshad gi 'dug zer/ ngas kho tsho'i kha brda la mnyam 'jog cig byas dus/ rgya skad bod skad 'dres ma ra ma lug gi skad cha yin pa gzhi nas shes/ bu mos kho tsho'i skad cha mo rang la — 213 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/pha yul gro tshang nas yin pa'i slob grogs shig yod pa de'i skad cha dang gcig pa red zer nas gad mo sig sig shor/ skad cha de dngos gnas snyan po mi 'dug skabs der nga'i kha nas da lo bca' bcu 'das rjes 'u cag kyang kho tsho dang gcig par 'gyur nges red ces shor/ de dus su nga tsho'i skad cha'i nang rgya skad sre ba de 'dra'i rgyugs chen po ma red/6da lo dbyar khar zi ling du drug pa'i glu rol 'tshogs pa red/mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyis de'i gnas tshul bkod pa'i le tshan zhig bzos te brnyan 'phrin du bstan/ de nas ring po ma 'gor bar lta mkhan rnams kyis lta tshul mang po bshad pa thos/ 'o da 'grig yod pa ma red/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin du skad dang yi ge'i bya ba byed mkhan rnams kyis kyang 'tsho ba'i nang du ra ma lug gi skad rkyang rkyang bshad gi 'dug mu mthud du 'di ltar song na/ rang gi skad yig nyams par dus yun ring po 'gor dgos rgyu ma red zer ba red/gnas tshul de ngo ma red/ nga tsho'i las khungs su nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod bshad pa'i skad cha dpe zhig gi lam nas bshad na phal cher 'di 'dra red/ka de ringasbraspya du red/da 214 da

sad yi nyams pa 'u cho rang nyid lan/kha de ringatshospyage red/ka khritsospyostokhri7oṃ tshar song ba min nam/kha khyosasmyornye2 nang gi/7rtsoza la ma bltas/ka ngas/thastsadz+ra blta ma thub ya/kha de ring gnam 'bab rgyu yin pa 'dra/ 7stse bzung med ya/'o da drag gi da thengs ngaltojusla1oṃ byed res yin/ nyin gungameyikya nang du bsdad deme0lko byed dgos/ka de ringadhī1sgo byed res khyod yin na/kha yin/ nga tshosakhri1oṃ byed skabasar+sā41 che bas/ nyin gung la'angame0lko byed dgos zer/gong gi kha brda 'di las nga tshos gnad don 'di 'dra zhig mthong thub/ ‘bod skad gsar pa 'di'i nang du phrad ma gtogs ming tshig phal cher rgya skad yin pa red/ ming tshig de dag las kha shas bod du 'gyur med na'ang / mang che shos 'gyur tshar 'dug pa red/ de bas ngas kun slong yag po bcangs nas rang dang 'brel 'dris che ba'i mi rnams la pha skad bshad na bzang rabs sogs kyi skad cha bshad rung kha sna ma snyer ba tsam gyi tshul du song / las rogs shig gis da dung mi rigs tshang ma de ltar nub nas tshar dgos ni red/ dper na mi nyag rgyal rabs lta bu zer nas nga rang lan med du btang / de las kyang — 215 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/tshabs che ba zhig ni/ brnyan 'phrin las khungs gtso byas thog rang gi pha skad kyi glu gzhas la gtsigs chen mi byed par rgyun du rgya glu dang rgya skad kyi glu dbyangs dmangs khrod du khyab spel byed mus yod pa de red/ de'i phyogs la byes kyi spun zla dag gis kyang do snang dang sems khral chen po byed bzhin yod pa red/ de bzhin du deng skabs pha yul zhing grong gi mang tshogs kyis kyang rgya skad bod skad 'dres ma'i skad cha bshad pa shugs che ru 'gro gi 'dugade las gzhan mtsho sngon mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma bde skyid 'tshos slob chen slob ma kha shas kyis rang gi pha skad gtsang ma bshad mkhan la kha snyer sna snyer byed 'ong zer ba'i gnas tshul zhig kyang ‘bod kyi skad yig dra tshigs su bkod 'dug ya nga zhing yid skyo ba'i snang tshul de nad yams bzhin mi 'byams par/ 'u tsho mi re re nas brtsams te bsgyur dgos pa red/ lhag par du slob chen slob ma dag dang rlung brnyan 'phrin gyi dril bsgrags bya ba byed mkhan dang shes yon can rnams kyis rang gi pha skad nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i snang tshul 'dir/ sngon 'gog dang thabs bkod yag po re 'then na 'grig snyam/rgya mi mkhas pa lung dbyin tha'erjoyis rang skad dang gzhan skad kyi po〉〉sonis 'asdir+sha dbyin tha'e/ (7 7tshe 1952—)tha'e wan gyi rtsom mkhan grags can/ brtsams chos〈〈sreg za'i bam — 216 —

sad yig nyams pa 'u cho rang nyid lan/khyad par 'di ltar phye 'dug rang mi rigs kyi pha skad ni bla srog lta bu'i skad yin la/ gzhan mi rigs kyi skad ni yo byad lta bu'i skad red zer/ gzhan da dung phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags kyis/ skad cha dang yi ge ni mi rigs shig gi khyad chos dang mi rigs de mi rigs gzhan dang dbye ba 'byed byed kyi rtags mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ mi rigs gang de gnas pa dang 'phel ba'i brgyud rim khrod/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod mi rnams kyis bsam blo brje res byed pa'i lag cha yin/mi rigs shig mnyam 'dres dang gzhan 'gyur byung yod med de thog mar skad yig gi steng nas mngon yong / mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i bar 'gro 'ong byed pa'i khrod so so'i spyi tshogs go gnas dang 'brel ba ga 'dra zhig yin pa'ang skad yig las mngon gsal du shes yong / de'i phyir/ mi rigs skad yig gi gnas bab dang las dbang gis mi rigs gang de'i gnas stangs dang chab srid go gnas/ mdun lam las dbang bcas mtshon thub/ ces skad dang yi ge ni mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas dang 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i lam kha'i gnad 'gag gi lhu tshigs lta bu yin pa'i gal chen rang bzhin gleng yod pa red/ ngas bsam na 'di ni gtam rma med pa zhig red/ de'i rkyen gyis/ 'u tsho'i bsam blo pa dang do khur can dag gis rang gi skad dang yi ge dang rig gnas rlung khrod kyi mar me bzhin rgud nub tu 'gro bar sems khral chen po byed kyin yod pa red/— 217 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/tha na a ri nas skyes pa'i bod kyi mi rabs gnyis pa dang gsum par pha ma rnams kyis rang gi bu phrug la ngal gso'i dus tshod bed spyad de rang gi skad yig slob tu 'jug tshul rgya yig gi‘‘bod mi'i rig gnas dra rgya’ nang bkod yod/ de yang los yin te/ bod kyi rig gnas zer ba ni ri bo'i gtos dang 'dra ba'i po ti rkyang rkyang la go na mi 'grig par/ gal chen nang gi 'gangs chen ni/ de 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i mi bu skyed sring byed dgos pa de red/ gal srid khyod tsho slob grwa chen mo pa dang dril bsgrags bya ba byed mkhan/ shes yon can sogs kyis 'gan de 'khur ma thub na/ bod kyi rig gnas nyams 'gro bas mi tshad/bod ces pa'ang ming gis stong 'gyur bar the tshom med/ dper na/man ju'i mi rigs lta bu/ des na kun gyis don dag de'i tshabs chen rang bzhin shes dgos tshod red/de min/ grong khyer du sdod pa'i bod mi rnams kyis bod kyi la rgya yod tshul dang bod kyi rig gnas la dga' tshul gyi tshig skam po bshad nas mi 'dug par/ rang gi bu phrug rnams bod skad bod yig gang yang mi shes par rgya mi ma yin la bod mi yang ma yin pa'i rigs phung sum pa zhig tu 'gyur bzhin par thugs mnyam re bzhag ste/ rang gi kha nas bshad pa bzhin ngo ma rang gi rigs la sha tsha ba yin na don dag de la thabs bkod yag po re 'then dgos tshod red/ lar grong khyer gyi byis — 218 —

da yi nyams pa 'u cho rang nyid lan/pa tshor mtshon na/ slob sbyong gi khor yug dang 'tsho ba sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas kyang rong 'brog phyogs kyi slob bu rnams dang bsdur na cha rkyen ha cang yag po red/ de bas grong khyer gyi byis pa dag gis rang gi dga' kha 'khyer phyogs ltar du ched las mang po sbyong bzhin yod/ de ni kho tsho'i yon tan yin pa sus kyang bsnyon du med na'ang / rang gi pha skad dang pha yig rtsa ba nas btang snyoms su bzhag nas gang yang ma shes tshe/ rigs gzhan gyi 'phya smod byed pa phar zhog tha na a myes dang tsha bo tsha mo phan tshun bar la'ang brda 'phrod gi med pa'i gnas tshul 'di zi ling bod khyim phal mo che la yod pa red/ de las kyang / kho tshos rang gi skad dang yi ge dor te khad kyis rigs gzhan du 'gyur bzhin pa de ni shin tu yid phangs dgos pa dang mnyam 'jog dgos pa'i gnas so/ /gzhan mi rigs kyis rang gi skad yig la 'dzin pa'i lta stangs 'u cag dang bsdur na he bag chen po 'dug de sngon nged khyim du bod kyi deng rabs rtsom yig la zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi h+pha ran si'i bud med cig yong / mos bshad rgyur/ kho tsho'i mi rigs ltar na/ rgyal khab gang du 'tsho sdod byas yod kyang / rang mi rigs kyi skad yig nges par sbyang dgos/ de ltar min tshe/ spun zla'i nang khul gyi 'phya smod dang zur za byed yul du 'gyur nges red zer/ sngon thon gyi rgyal khab cig la mtshon na'ang / rang gi skad yig gtso byas thog da gzod mi rigs — 219 —

za ma mo'i sgyid ngas ma char/gzhan gyi skad dang yig rigs la sbyong ba red/ mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos na/ rang gi rig gnas la brten nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba las/ gzhan mi rigs kyi rig gnas la brten nas 'phel rgyas gtong snyam pa ni snang ba tsam mo/ /de bas ha cang nyag phra ba'i dus 'dir 'u cag bod pa re re nas pha skad dang pha yig ji ltar khyab spel dang gong 'phel du gtong bar/ bsam blo nan mo re dang thabs bkod yag po re 'then dgos pas mi tshad ha cang 'phyis drags pa'i tshod du 'dug go snyam/2005(06dze20nyin grub/

nga dang mtsho sngon bod yig sar 'a ra/nga dang mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyun/lo ngo nyi shu tsam gyi sngon la nga rang da lta'i las khungs su las bgos byas/ skabs der ngas mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur zhes pa'i tshags par 'di thog dang por mthong ba yin/ de yang las ka'i dgos mkho'i ched yin na'ang thang mod/ nga tsho'i 'go khrid rgan pa des rtag par mchan la bod yig gsar 'gyur re gnyis btsir yong ste snyan sgron pa tsho'i lag tu bzhag nas klog 'don byed du 'jug gcig nas rang gi chu tshad zhan drags pa dang / gnyis nas gsar 'gyur bsgyur ma dang rong 'brog phyogs kyi dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul thar thor rkyang las bkod med pas bdag gi blta 'dod kyi yi ga rang shugs su 'gags song /dus kyi lo zla rim bzhin 'das la/ nga rang yang lo ngo mang po'i sngon gyi phyi'i mo sgo gtsor 'dzin pa dang nang yon tan btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i bud med mang mang gi mdzes dpyod lta tshul las brgal te/dpe cha dang dus deb sogs klog par dga' bar gyur/ lhag par du nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i ring la mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur ni bdag gis blta 'dod ha cang che ba'i tshags par zhig tu song / de ga tshags par khang gis1999lo nas bzung sngon gyi rnam pa bsgyur te/ bod rang gi — 221 bhe

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bsam blo gsar pa'i myu gu 'khrungs sa'i zhing sa gsar du bsnan te/mkhas brgya mgrin gcig gi bsam blo sger gcod kyi dus las 'gongs te bsam blo rang dbang gi lta ba brjod pa'i sge'u khung zhig 'don sprod byas pa red/ de ni khyed cag tshags par khang la mtshon na/ dus deb gzhan dang tshags par gzhan las/ thod rgal byas pa'i gsar gtod kyi snying stobs shig dang / yang nga dang nga 'dra ba'i lhag sems kyis phyug kyang bsam blos dbul ba'i klog pa po dag la mtshon na/ bsam blo'i rgyags phye 'don sprod gang legs byas pa dang rang skyon ther 'don byed pa'i me long zhig gnang ba dang kun nas mtshungs song / khyed cag gi mdzad rjes 'di la klog mkhan rnams kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba thos la bdag gis kyang rjes su yi rang byed gi yod/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ kho mo ni 'tsho gnas dang thad kar 'brel yod kyi mi chos rtsom yig la dga' ba ma gtogs smra bsam brjod 'das kyi lha chos rtsom yig la dga' po med pa dang / rtsom yig phyi ma de dag las 'jig rten pa'i 'tsho gnas la thad kar phan thogs pa lta zhog de las ldog ste gtam rgyud dang ngag rgyun de dag las bud med rnams gdon dang 'dre dang srin mo dang bdud mo lta bur sgro btags te rtsis thang la mtha' cig tu rdog brdzis byed pas yin/ de yis nga dang bcas pa'i bud med rnams kyi dmar chung gi sems pa'i steng nam yang sos dka' ba'i rma kha bzos 'dug pa red/— 222 —

nga dang mcho sngo bod yi sar 'a ra/de ga tshags par khang gis thog mar mang gtso dang 'dra mnyam rang dbang rtsis thang sogs kyi mi chos rig gnas kyi sa bon thog ma 'debs sa'i khor yug bskrun pa nas bzung / bdag gi sems su nam zhig la rang gis kyang bud med kyi las dbang dang bde sdug thad rang gi lta tshul brjod pa'i rtsom re gnyis 'bri ba'i skal pa re ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i re smon bcangs myong / yin yang dang thog bsam tshul de gzhan la gleng na 'phya smod rang gis nyos yong snyam na/sa da bar du lus pa yin/ gang yin zer na rtsom la 'jug pa ni dngos gnas rang la goms lobs su song yod pa'i khyim las tsag tsig dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba dang /yang bud med la dpyod shes yod pa ma red zer ba'i skad cha de yis tshor shes skyen pa'i bud med dag gi rang rlom dang yid ches la ngang ngam shugs kyis khyad gsod byed kyin yod pas red/ de ga tshags par khang ni de las ldog ste bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i‘‘bud med skra ring blo thung ma dag la rting skul byas te spobs pa stsal/ kha sang de ring bdag gis rtsom thung re gnyis bris pa'ang de dang 'brel ba dam po yod/ des na/de ga'i bod yig gsar 'gyur par 'debs byas nas lo 'khor55lon par snying thag pa nas bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/2006 01 01nyin grub/

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a nab kyi bud med ciga'ajam dbyangs skyid kyis bsgyur/‘‘ha lam sa sgang hril por khyab pa'i 'gal rtsod 'di ni chos lugs bar gyi 'gal rtsod min la/ dpal yon bar gyi 'gal rtsod kyang ma yin/de ni 'gal ba ltag sprod du song ba'i dus rabs gnyis bar gyi 'gal rtsod de/ dus rabs bar ma'i sems khams dang dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bsam blo bar gyi 'gal rtsod dang / sngon thon dang rjes lus bar gyi 'gal rtsod/ dpal yon dang blun rmongs bar gyi 'gal rtsod/dpyod shes dang dmu rgod bar gyi 'gal rtsod/ rang dbang dang gnya' gnon bar gyi 'gal rtsod/ mang gtso dang sger gcod bar gyi 'gal rtsod red a rab kyi bud med 'di'i spu gri lta bu'i skad cha de dag gis nga ni rbad de ha las par btang song /nye lam grogs po zhig gis a rab kyi yi ge dang ya hu dā'i yi ge/dbyin yig sogs kyi dra tshigs mang po'i steng khyab 'dug pa'i phyed gling brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyi rtsod shags le tshan gyi dum tshan zhig kho bor ge 224 —

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med cibaskur son byung bar/ bud med des dbyi si lam gyi chos pa dag la brgal brtag rtsod pa'i 'khor lo bskor te lan med du btang 'dugade ni ngas bltas myong ba'i ches nyams mtshar ba'i brnyan 'phrin nang gi rtsod pa zhig red la/ khong ni ngas mthong myong ba'i ches phul du byung ba'i bud med gras kyi gcig red/pho dbang ring lugs pa'i rgyal khams/chos srid zung 'brel gyi a rab pa'i yul la/ sger gcod kyis dbang bsgyur byed kyi yod par ma zad/ de ni pho dbang ring lugs kyis kha lo sgyur ba'i rgyal khams shig kyang red/ rgya dang sma ra bzhag pa'i mul la'7511'i6byarnams kyis yod tshad la dam bsgrags byed gi yod/yul de ru bud med las rnga mong gi rin thang che zhing / kho mo tshor khe dbang tog tsam med la/ tha na rang gi ngo gdong yang btum dgos kyi 'dug a ri dang nub gling la smyo ham gyis ngo rgol khrom skor byed mkhas pa'i skyes pa de dag gis/ khrims mthun lugs mthun sgos chung ma gsum bzhi re blangs chog kyang / bud med tshos rlangs 'khor gtong ba'ang nag nyes su brtsi na/ gnyen don thad kho tsho dang 'dra ba'i khe dbang ni ga la yod de gar yang med do/ /dbyi si lam rig gnas kyi zhan cha'i skor/ bud med rnams la de — 225 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bas kyang kha grags dbang med/ ‘‘'dzam gling 'dir dbyi si lam gyi chos sgor mi zhugs mkhan thams cad drag po'i dmag 'thab la brten nas mu zi lim du bsgyur dgos zhes 'byung ba'i ku ran gsung rab ni/kho tsho'i blang dor 'jug ldog gi tshad gzhi nyag gcig red/ yul de ru rig gnas de dang chos lugs de la skye bo sus kyang skyon brjod byed mi chog pa red/ drag po'i 'du byed ma btang ba'i chos lugs bsam blo de'i rkyen gyis a rab yul gyi skyes pa tshos ga sa gang gi za khang dang slob grwa/rgan gso khang / tha na gnyen ston byed bzhin pa'i lha khang du'ang rang shi 'gad rdzas kyis 'gad gtor byed pa red/a rab yul gyi rgyu 'bras blo migablo yul las 'das pa zhig ni/ sus kyang drang gtam bshad mi phod pa'i rgyal khams de ru/ bud med rtul phod can zhig byung ba de red/ bud med des a rab kyi phyed gling brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyi le tshan du mul la' rnams dang kha ri kha thug tu rtsod pa byas shing / don dngos dang / bden pa/ gnas lugs ngo ma rnams snying stobs chen pos brjod de/ dbyi si lam gyi rig gnas la sun 'byin dang / ya hu dā dang nub gling rig gnas la mtha' gcig tu phyogs skyor byas pa red/zhag ma gcig gi yun la/ khong nyid a rab yul gyi rgyu 'bras blo mig tu — 226 bhe

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med cigyur song /khong ni da lo rang lo47yin pa'i wa h+pha' sul thanadhizer ba de red/si ri ya nas skyes shing 'tshar ba'i khong nyid kyang dang thog dbyi si lam chos lugs la dad mos byed mkhan zhig yin mod/ phyi phyir byung ba'i don rkyen zhig gis khong rbad de bsgyur pa red/ 1979lo'i nyin zhig la/'jigs skul pa skor zhig ta ma si khur yod pa'i kho tsho'is1khujiji0slob chen nang shor yong ste/ ‘‘sa11'ismo 5sprusmo0'ispyo /’ (a lha ni bla na med pa gong na med pa yin)zhes kha nas ku co 'don zhing lag tu me mda' bzung ste/ kho tsho'i dge rgan chen mo de gnas de nyid du bsad par ma zad/ da dung zhe sdang gis bem po de la me mdas bstud mar brgya lhag brgyab/ don rkyen des khong nyid hon thor song / de bas lha de ni rang gis 'dod pa'i lha de min la/ chos de yang rang gis 'dod pa'i chos de min pa khong gis gzhi nas rtogs shing / sngon chad rang gis ril gyis dang len byas zin pa'i dbyi si lam gyi rig gnas yod tshad la dogs slong byed mgo yang dus de nyid nas brtsams/chos lugs de 'dra gtsug tu bkur ba'i rgyal khab las bros byol byas te/ dpal yon ngo ma zhig 'tshol rgyu'i dam bca' sems la bkod 〈〈bros hār shusnakā sdil re tha/snyi/ de( smulda/ ci mi zhi/nai rnyizlo na~Xso gaphroṃ l+līlha 1959—)'khrungs yu la si ri ya/ brtsams chos

za ma mo'i sgyid ngas ma char/yod pas/ 1989lor khong stangs dpyal dang phru gu tsho lu zi an ci le ru 'byor/ sa de ru khong gis sems khams rig par sbyang ba byas shing /phyis su sems nad gso dpyad kyi las ka gnyer ba red/ khong gis rtag par dra rgya'i steng rtsom yig bris te thal mthar lhung ba'i dbyi si lam pa dag dang rtsod pa byed cing / gnas tshul de phyis su phyed gling brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyis shes rjes/ khong brnyan 'phrin gyi rtsod shags le tshan du gdan 'dren zhus/ khong gis thog mtha' bar gsum du rang dbang gi rin thang mchog tu 'dzin zhing / dbyi si lam chos lugs kyi zhan cha la bag tsha ba med par sdigs mdzub 'dzugs pa red/ ma zad khong nyid kha shugs che zhing ngag sgo yangs pa/ rig pa rno zhing rigs lam gsal ba'i khar/ gnyom phra mo tsam yang mi 'khur bas na/ khong gi mdun sar a rab mkhas pa rnams kyi ngag lce rang shugs su lkugs 'gro ba red/ rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis khong la‘dbyi si lam lha'i rig pa mkhan tsho'i dgra gshed du 'bod kyi 'dugalhag par du da lo'i(2006) zla2pa'i tshes21nyin la/ khong gis phyed gling brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan du e cib kyi dbyi si lam chos pa rnams dang rtsod pa byas pa de ni ngo mtshar ci bas che zhing / bar shar‘‘gsar('gyur brgyud)lam zhib 'jug khangaji gis le tshan de'i dum tshan zhig dra rgya'i steng bkod 'phral grags 'gul chen po byung / skad rigs sna — 228 —

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med citshogs kyi dra tshigs mang pos le tshan de 'dren spyod byas shing / adzuh+phusmo1 1skyogacig pu'i steng le tshan de nyid phab len(koza)byas grangs khri brgya las brgal 'dug la/ spru00spru1'unang khong gi gnas tshul skor gyi yig byang grangs ka khri brgya lhag la slebs 'dug ma zad nyi ma rer ha lam khri bcus 'phar snon 'byung gi yod khar/ de 'brel gyi dpyad gtam yang khri stong mang por slebs shing / de dag khrod mi la las khong la‘ dus rabs gsar pa'i lha mo zhes bsngags brjod byas 'dugale tshan de las a rab yul la re ba yod pa shes thub par ma zad/rigs rgyud mi gcig pa yin na 'dra/ rig gnas rgyab ljongs tha dad pa yin na 'dra/ sger gcod kyi sun gtser tsha nan 'og gnas shing sa cha mi 'dra bar 'tsho ba'i mi tshogs gang zhig yin na'ang / gang de 'gro ba mi zhig yin phyin/ sems bsam pa'i gting nas rang dbang la re 'bod dang / dpal yon la re smon byed nges pa'ang las sla mos rtogs thub/dpal yon bar 'gran rtsod las 'gal rtsod med/wa h+pha' sul than gyis har wur slob chen gyi dge rgan chen mo hun

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/thin thonadugyi lta ba las lhag pa'i lta ba gzhan zhig bton pa 'di lta ste/dpal yon phan tshun bar 'gran rtsod las 'gal rtsod rtsa ba nas med ces pa'o/ /khong ltar na dbyi si lam chos lugs ni dpal yon zhig ma red/gang yin zer na/ chos lugs des mi rnams gdug rtsub dang dmar gsod kyi lam du bkri bas red ces pa'o/ /khong gis/ ku ran gsung rab tu 'dzam gling 'dir dbyi si lam chos lugs la dad mos mi byed mkhan thams cad drag po'i dmag 'thab la brten nas mu zi lim du bsgyur dgos zhes gsal bor bkod 'dug pa dang / yang khong gis/dbyi si lam dang ya hu dā pa gnyis bsdur nas bshad rgyur/ ya hu dā pa rnams kyis dka' sdug chen po gang mang myangs te 'dzam gling gi yul gru kun tu 'khyams myong ba red/ da lta kho tshor 'dzam gling mi mang gi gus bkur thob pa ni/ kho tshos gdug tsub dang dmar gsod la brten nas byung ba ma yin par/ de las ldog ste rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis 'jig rten khams 'dir shes bya yon tan phul ba la brten nas byung ba red/'on kyang mu zi lim gyis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi sku rten shul med rtsa brlag gtong ba la sogs las gzhan ci zhig shes sam zhes so/ /khong gis mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas/ nga tsho sus kyang ya dge rgasni chek+ṣiṃ /thina~X chi ni ram̐thi yā /khasna5/baspyozilhadṛrmi chodzāsnazhwal skyirno khyorā ṅgitā snaswā 〉h+phi lha sngu tādu/gahar wur slob chen gyi — 230 —

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med cihu dā pa zhig gis gzhan gyi chos khang brlags pa mthong ma myong / nga tsho sus kyang ya hu dā pa zhig gis mi gsod pa la brten nas ngo rgol byed pa mthong ma myong / nga tsho sus kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs pa zhig gis dbyi si lam lha khang mer sreg pa dang / mu zi lim gsod pa/ gzhan gyi gzhung tshab khang la rgol ba byed pa'ang mthong ma myong / mu zi lim kho nas so so'i chos lugs kyi phyir du/ gzhan gyi chos khang mer sreg pa dang / mi gsod pa/ gzhan gyi gzhung tshab khang la gtor brlag byed pa red ces so/ /mjug mthar khong gis mu zi lim thams cad la/ 6‘mu zi lim gyis/ kho tshor brtsi bkur byed dgos pa'i re ba phar gzhan la ma bton gong du/ mi'i rigs la legs skyes ci zhig 'bul rgyu yin pa tshur rang la nges par 'dri dgos’ zhes 'bod skul btang 'dugakhong gis dbyi si ral rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi bcar 'dri dang len byed skabs/ dbyi si lam gyi rgyal khams su pho dbang ring lugs pa'i gnya' gnon tshad med myong bzhin pa'i a rab bud med rnams la ni sngar bas lhag bsam zol med kyis/ 6‘ngas dbyi si lam yul gyi bud med re re la bshad 'dod pa ni/ sne 'dren ngo ma ni khyod nyid yin pas/gal te khyod kyis ‘rlangs 'khor’ la kha lo byas te/ nga tsho'i mi rabs gsar pa bde blag ngang dmigs sar ma bskyal tshe/ nga tsho'i mi dmangs — 231 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/la thar lam ye nas yod mi srid ces pa de yin zhes 'bod skul btang 'dugakhyed kyis che srog skyed thub na/ che srog la srung skyob kyang byed thub nges yin/wa h+pha' sul than gyis/ bud med kyi rang bzhin ni drag rtsub dang btsan shed ma yin par/ zhi dul dang dkyel yangs yin zhes nan tan du bshad 'dug khong na re/ ‘dbyi si lam gyi skyes pa tshos pham kha ma gtogs gzhan ci yang ra sprod byas myong med/ kho tshos khyod tsho bas mtha' ru ded rjes/ khyod cag khrid de 'gro sa ni sdug bsngal gyi me 'obs yin pa de bud med re res nges par shes dgos la/ rang mgo rang 'don byed dgos pa'ang bud med re res nges par shes dgos zhes pa dang / ‘‘khyed kyis tshe srog skyed thub na/ tshe srog la srung skyob kyang byed thub nges yin zhes so/ /khong gis gsong bor brjod don/ ‘‘ngas bsgrub 'dod pa ni/nga tsho'i mi mang gi bsam gzhig byed stangs bsgyur rgyu de yin/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho dbyi si lam chos lugs kyi mi gta' ru gyur nas dus rabs14'gor song / mi gta' ru gyur zin pa'i skye bo su zhig yin kyang btson srol gtor te btson khang nas bros thar byed thub thabs med pas — 232 —

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med cin/ phyi logs kyi mi tshang mas kho tsho btson thar byed par rogs skyor byas na 'grig ces so/ /wa h+pha' sul than zhag ma gcig gi yun la 'dzam gling gsar 'gyur brgyud lam khag gi do snang bya yul du gyur/ 〈〈ne'u yog dus bab tshags par〉〉dang / 〈〈lu zi an ci le dus bab tshags par〉〉 bukhosabarnyan 'phrin/ h+pha ran si'i〈〈'dzam gling tshags par〉〉 dbyi si ral gyi rlung 'phrin las khungs sogs las khong gi gnas tshul spel 'dug la/ de dang 'brel nas〈〈wa zhin thon dus bab tshags par〉〉du kha byang la‘rgyal khongs a ri nas yin pa'i a rab kyi bud med dpa' ngar can zhes pa'i ched brjod spel 'dug phyed gling brnyan 'phrin le tshan du khong gis dbyi si lam gyi lha'i rig pa mkhan tshor rtsod pa byas pa de/ skad rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su bsgyur te/ mi khri stong mang pos sbyar byang bris nas gleng mol byas pa dang / de ni nye ba'i char dra rgya'i steng gi gsar 'gyur che gras khrod kyi gcig red/〈〈ne'u yog dus bab tshags par〉〉du bkod don/ wa h+pha' sul than gyi dpa' spobs la nub gling gi rang dbang rgyal khab kyi mi rnams kyis gus smon byed par ma zad/ khong gis mu zi lim nyung shas shig gis lkog tu ma gtogs bshad mi phod pa'i skad cha de dag mngon gsal 'dzem med kyis brnyan 'phrin las bshad pa la/ mu zi lim rgyal — 233 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/khab kyi bcos bsgyur mkhan dag gis kyang bstod ra byed kyi yod pa red/de lta na'ang / khong gis mul la' rlung khams can tsho'i sdang zug kyang bzed dgos byung / 〈〈ni'u yog dus bab tshags par〉〉du bkod don/ 'dzam gling yul gru khag gi dbyi si lam chos pa tshang mas khong la bshung gin 'dug la/ khong gi khyim gyi kha par gyi skad 'jog sar 'jigs skul gtong ba'i skad cha rgyun mi chad de/ dper na/ 'o/khyod da dung shi med dam/ tshe zad ma khyod kyis sgugs sdod ces pa dang /yang la lasasku'aphrin bskur yong ste/ mi zhig gis khyod gsod rgyu red/de nga yin zhes pa lta bu red/ dbyi ran gyi ho me neduyis〈〈bdud kyi snyan ngag gi bstan bcos〉〉kyi rtsom pa po ra zhi tedubasgral rgyu'i bka' lung bsgyur pa ltar/ phyed gling brnyan 'phrin gyi rtsod shags le tshan du pham kha myangs pa'i mul la' tshos kyang khong la chos kyi bka' chad gtong grabs 'duga'on kyang khong la zhed snang gang yang skye yi med pa red/ khong gis〈〈ne+e'u yog dus bab tshags par〉〉la bshad don/ shes yon gyis nga rang bsam blo rjes lus de las thar du bcug cing / mu zi lim mi mang yang dad pa skyon can de las bcings 'grol gtong mkhan zhig med na ga lugs rte grusna /thanā/ dz+nyagadzi rgoyi rmi0/ stu5'i0/lngastu ṣ+ṭha.oṃ2 1902—1989)skyes yul dbyi ran/ dbyi si lam chos 'ig turgyu sa/ragātrī/8shā chi/chiklisbyisdisdi 3ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāt+na ngakau sgo r+sharno prisnroḍā〉thor+shasmi nā sdir+sha rtsom mkhan/ rgya gar gyi mu zi lim dud khyim — 234 —

'dzam bu gling hang sang bar btang ba'i a rab kyi bud med cil 'grig ’zer/ khong gis a rab kyi yi ges dpe cha deb gnyis bris myong / mig sngar dbyin yig gi lam nas dpe cha gsum pa de bris tshar la nye/ de'i kha byang la〈〈bros thar btson ma na re/ lha de bdud ngo ma zhig yin na〉〉zer/ 〈〈ne'u yog dus bab tshags par〉〉du/ dpe cha 'di dpar skrun byas rjes/ ‘‘a rab rgyal khams de phu dkrug mda' dkrug cig byed yong thag chod red’’zer/khong gi a ma dang nu bo sogs da dung si ri ya ru bsdad yod/ kho tshos yul tha lin du sdod pa'i nu mo brgyud nas skad skur ba ma gtogs khong dang thad kar 'brel gtugs byed phod kyi med/ khong gis brnyan 'phrin du dbyi si lam chos lugs la skyon brjod byas rjes/ nu bo gnyis ka si ri ya'i gsang ba'i nyen rtog pas khrid song ste 'dri rtsad byas/ de yin kyang wa h+pha' sul than gyis bshad rgyur/ ‘‘nga rang la zhed snang med/nga ni rang nyid kyi lta ba la yid ches yod/ las 'di ni le dbar stong gi rgyang skyod cig dang 'dra la/ gom pa dang po dang dka' khag ches che ba'i mal le10de nga bgrod tshar zer/bud med 'di yis/ a rab 'jig rten hril po mngon mthor bstad do/ / lha mo skyabs kyis zhu dag byas/2007 04 06nyin grub/— 235 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/rang gi khe dbang rang gis bsrung dgos /gzhung las khang du las grogs tshos sngar rgyun bzhin dal bag lhod g.yeng ngang rang rang gi las ka byed bzhin 'dug bdag gis kyang nyi ma de'i gsar 'gyur sgrig sbyor gyi las kar sta gon gyis dus tshod gcig ngang gis 'das par byas/ glo bur du 'jigs yer ba'i kha par zhig gis nga'i snying khams yang bskyar drag lding thengs shig byed du bcugakhyod kyis rang gi bu mo'i don dag de shes med dam zhes ngo mi shes pa'i rgya mi skyes pa zhig gi kha par 'byor/ bdag gis don deg gang yin gsal bor lab rogs zhes bshad pa na/ khyod slob grwar shog dang shes kyi red zer/ skabs der ngas da gzod kho pa nga'i bu mo'i dge rgan zhig yin pa gzhi nas shes/ nga rang lam seng gzhung las thog khang gi sgo 'gram du spyi spyod rlangs 'khor zhig la bsdad de shar mar slob grwa'i phyogs su phyin pa yin/rlangs 'khor du ngas yang bskyar lo du ma'i sngon gyi chag sgo de dran byung / myur skyob sman khang zhig gi nyal khri'i steng sha nyog rus nyog tu btang ba'i bu mo lo bcu gnyis can zhig nad g.yog ma 'gas bskor nas kha cig gis khrag gis 'tshos pa'i stod gos dang dor ma khe gris 'dra ba — 236 —

rang dbang rang sa bsrung da sa/dang / kha cig gis snying khams kyi 'phar lding dang / dbugs kyi rgyu ba len stangs la brtag dpyad byed pa/ kha cig gis sman pa'i ngag bkod ltar gnam khab rgyag pa sogs myur skyob byed pa mthong ba dang / a ma de ngu skad 'dzer 'dzer gyis re zhig ci bya gtol med du gyur te had 'dug skabs der tag tag nyin gung kha lag gi dus la khel 'dug pas las thog sman pa gcig dang nad g.yog ma 'ga' las mi 'dugamatshams shig la nad g.yog ma zhig gis kha par zhig btang nas kho tsho'i sman pa 'bum rams pa la rmas phog pa'i bu mo'i khrag shed gor thig yin pa'i gnas tshul sogs snyan seng zhu yi 'dug yin na'ang sman pa 'bum rams pa des snang chen byed kyi med pa nad g.yog ma'i bshad sgros las tshor yong / skabs der a ma de thabs zad 'u thug ste nad g.yog ma'i lag gi kha par 'phrog ma blangs kyis sman pa 'bum rams pa der bu mor gshag bcos myur skyob kyi zhu ba nan mo byas kyang / rna lam du ldab ldib kyi skad cha'i sgra zhig dang mnyam du kha par bcad pa'i sgra tsam las ci yang thos ma byung / de bzhin a ma'i mig chu dang bu mo'i zungs khrag gzhi gcig tu 'dres te mig rab rib tu gyur nas sdod skabs/ skyes pa las thog sman pa de myur stabs kyis a ma de'i gam du yong nas lag tu sman tho zhig brdzangs te sgo bsten khang la sman len du mngags/ a ma des mig chu 'byid zhor 'khya ma 'khyor gyis sgo bsten khang gi sman rin — 237 —

za ma mo'i byud ngas ma char/dngul sprod sa'i sge'u khung khar 'byor dus/ stes dbang stabs 'grig gis spun grogs mkhar mo rgyal lags dang phrad/ kho mos 'tshab 'tshub kyis rang la byung ba'i chag sgo rags tsam bshad rjes mo rang sman pa stag lha rgyal lags 'bod par btang ba red/spyir chag sgo de byung nas lo kha shas 'das zin pas nga'i dran pa cung tsam mag mog tu gyur 'dug kyang / de ring gi rna la gzan pa'i kha par des nga rang yang bskyar phyir dran gyi klong la g.yugs/rlangs 'khor las babs rjes nga rang dbugs thengs gcig gis brgyugs nas slob grwar 'byor/ bu mo 'dus pa'i slob grogs re gnyis dge rgan gyi gzhung las khang du langs chad bcad 'dug cing / khyim bdag re gnyis dge rgan gyis yar 'ded mar 'ded byed bzhin 'dugabadag gis bu mor nye zho med pa mthong dus sems pa gzhi nas bde la babs te dbugs ring zhig len zhor gnas tshul rgyus lon byas pa na/dge rgan zhig gis gnas tshul gyi go rim bshad byung / bu mo slob ma gnyis rdung res byas mthar/ rdung res khrod rgyal ba'i bu mo de dge slob tshos bar bshol gyis cog tse'i bar lam nas khrid de/ nga'i bu mo'i gam du slebs pa na kho mos bu mo der tshod tshod du rdog thos gcig brgyab pa red zer/ ngas bu mor gzhan la don med du rdog thos rgyag pa'i rgyu mtshan dris skabs/ bu mos/ slob ma 'ga' bsdongs nas mo'i grogs — 238 —

rang dbang rang sa bsrung da sa/mo der thub tshod byas thog dge rgan yang phyogs zhen gyis khyer nas ya lan yag po ma byas shing / bu mo rdung res byed mkhan de dge slob 'gas bar bshol gyis sgor khrid 'gro skabs/ mo da dung nyes rdung bzed pa'i bu mo de'i steng shor gyi 'dug pa mthong nas/ nga 'tshig pa gting nas zos te rdog tho shugs med cig brgyab pa yin zer/ (gnas tshul de skabs der bu mos bod skad kyis bdag la lab) rdung res byed dus kyi slob thun de ni tag tag rdzas 'gyur slob khrid skabs yin pa red/ de bas rdzas 'gyur dge rgan bud med des nga rang mthong ma thag mig nang sdang sems kyis khengs shing ha cang smad mdog gis/ dge slob mang po'i mdun sa nas nga'i bu mo'i gdong la cer te/ kho mo'i kun spyod la gnad don 'dug ces bstud mar thengs gsum la bskyar zlos byas/ de dus slob ma tshos dge rgan la skyon brjod yi ge bris tshar 'dug la/ langs chad bcad nas kyang ha lam dus tshod gcig yol song zer/ dge rgan de'i snang chung gi rnam 'gyur dang bag med kyi spyod pa der ngas kyang bzod bsran ma thub par/ bu mo'i phyogs nas skad cha 'ga' bshad pa yin/ nga'i bu mo 'di'i slob sbyong de 'dra'i yag po min yang / chung dus nas 'ba' 'bu zhig gsod pa'i gnag sems kyang med thog sprang po dang nyam chung dag mthong dus rang gi lag tu zho shog 'ga' yod na yang phangs med du de tshor sprad 'jog 'di 'dra'i byis — 239 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/pa zhig gi kun spyod la gnad don 'dug zer na/ dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod gzhan la gnod sems kyis khengs pa'i mi bu dag la ji ltar zer/mos de ring spo thog tu gzhan la rdog thos gcig brgyab pa de mo rang nor 'dug pa gzhir bzhag yin na'ang / rdung res byed rkyen yang mo rang gi don du ma yin par rang gi blo ngor drang bden skyong ba'i ched red/don dag de tsam gyis mi zhig gi kun spyod la khyad gsod byas na slob ma'i phyis 'byung gi mi tshe'i mdun lam la ngan shan thebs nges snyam/ bdag gi sems par dge rgan zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ gnas lugs brtsis nas skabs thog gang byung gi gnad don bshad pa las/ don med don bzo dang don chung don chen du sgro btags nas slob ma'i rtsis thang la rdog brdzis byas na mi 'grig snyam zhes dbugs thengs gcig gis rgya skad da ma dig gis brjod tshar ba na/ lo na cung rgas shing / gdong la shel mig gyon pa'i skyes pa dge rgan zhig yar langs yong nas/ bdag gi gdong la mdzub mos nan gyis btsugs te/ khyed dge rgan rnam pas mthong ba 'di red/ mos rang gi bu mo nor bzhin du skyon brjod mi byed par/ da dung 'u tsho dge rgan rnams la skyon 'dogs brnyas smod byed kyi 'dug ces rdzig rdzig byed cing / kho tshos gcig rgyab gnyis langs kyis de red de red zer nas phan tshun yin 'degs byed pa'i nyams 'gyur de mthong skabs/ bdag gis chung dus yul mi rnams kyi ge 240 —

rang dbang rang gis bsrung dgos/kha nas ‘rgya mi glang 'debs yin zer ba'i skad cha de yid la tur re shar la/ sems su mi gsum kha mtshungs na/ ra ma rgyal mo khyi ru gtong zer ba cis ma bden snyam ste/ dbang med du dngangs 'dar zhig brgyab/tag tag skabs der bu mos/ a ma nga tsho'i dge rgan rnams la kha yag ngo dga' byed pa las gnas lugs dang skad cha drang mor bshad na gtan nas dga' gi ma red/ kho tsho tshang ma mi ya mtshan can dag dag yin zhes pa'i skad cha de'ang yid la shar byung / dge rgan skyes pa des tshang ma'i gshog 'og la rlung brgyab par brten/ rdzas 'gyur dge rgan bud med de zhe sdang chen pos sgo khrog se brgyab ste slob gtso la zhu gtug byed du bud song / sems su de ring ngas mi reg stag gi mche bar reg mi 'byar 'brong gi rwa rtser 'byar snyam bzhin zhed snang gis khengs yong /yin na'ang dkar nag gi dbye ba zhig ci nas kyang 'byed dgos bsams te bdag gi gdong la mdzub mo 'dzugs mkhan gyi skyes pa dge rgan de sar 'khor nas/ phan tshun skad su mtho dang gdangs su drag gis gnas lugs rtsod res byas pa yin/ skabs der bu mo skrag thag chod de ngu bzhin/ a ma da khyod kha rog sdod/ kho tshos nga la khog nag bcangs te skyin pa len gi red zer nas dngangs skrag tsha pos nga'i kha btsan gyis bkag de nas ngas bu mo'i 'dod blo ltar skad cha bshad mtshams bzhag gang tsam song ba na/ rtsod gleng nang ma zhugs pa'i dge rgan — 241 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/skyes pa gzhan zhig gis gdong la 'dzum dmul te bdag la rkub stegs shig bzhag nas steng la sdod pa'i brda bstan/tag tag nyin bcu tsam gyi rjes su rdung res byed mkhan gtso bo de gnyis dang nga'i bu mo bcas la chad pa drag po bcad/ ngas de ni bdag gis dge rgan la gnas lugs brtsad pa'i mjug 'bras min nam 'dod/ ma zad/ slob gtsos dge slob mang po 'dus sa nas dang thog bu mor chag sgo byung skabs slob grwa dang dge rgan gyis mi shugs chen po bton tshul dang / da lta khyod kyis nga tsho dge rgan rnams kyi rngul chu sa la bsres song zhes pa'i skad cha'ang bshad song / de'i rjes bu mo dang rol mo'i dge rgan bar don gzhan gyi steng rtsod pa cung tsam byung mthar/kho pas kyang dang thog bu mor chag sgo byung skabs/ slob grwa'i dge rgan yongs kyis kho mor sman rin zhal 'debs byin tshul sogs kyi gtam chen po brjod/ skad cha de bu mos thos rjes ya mtshar nas lam seng mo'i a pha la kha par btang ste gnas tshul dris/nga'i bu mor rlangs 'khor chag sgo byung ba'i nyi ma de ni lo bdun tsam gyi sngon te2000lo'i zla9pa'i tshes20nyin gyi nyin gung yin/ skabs der slob mgo brtsams nas nyin nyi shu tsam las song med/ nyin nyi shu las res gza' spen nyi 'ga' phris pa na phal cher shul du nyin bcu kha tsam las lhag med/ slob grwas sman rin la zhal 'debs ster rgyu phar — 242 ge

rang gi khe dbang rang gis bsrung dgos/zhog nga tshor dngul ha cang mkho ba'i skabs yin pa tshor bzhin du/tha na dpe rin dang slob yon skar gang yang phyir ma bslogs/ chag sgo byung skabs slob gtso gzhon pa sogs dge rgan kha shas kyis slo ba grwa'i tshab tu bu mor khams 'dri'i me tog chun po zhig khyer yong ba las rogs skyor gzhan gang yang ma byas/de lta na'ang drin chen la drin log dang g.yang la la rdo kha'i dpe ltar mi 'gyur slad/ nga'i yid kyi me long du nyar ba'i don dag phran tshags re 'ga' brjod dgos byung / bu mo sman khang du sdod skabs mo'i slob chung dang slob 'bring sogs kyi slob grogs kha shas kyis rang la 'dzoms tshod du 'tshams 'dri'i legs skyes sil tog rdog re dang me tog rkang re/ da dung bu mo'i lus khams bde thang yo/nga ba'i smon lam du/slob ma so so rang gis bltabs pa'i shog bu'i khrung khrung gcig tu sbrel ba khyer yong ba'i don zhig kyang 'dug byis blo dwangs mas phyug pa'i skyes de dag ni skabs thog der bu mo ha cang dga' ba'i legs skyes yin/yin na'ang de dag ni/ slob bu so so rang steng gi brtse ba mtshon pa las slob grwa dang dge rgan la 'brel ba gang yang med/ don dngos su chag sgo 'byung yu/la tan tan bu mo'i da lta'i slob grwa dang thag mi ring ba'i sa yin pas na slob grwar 'brel ba spu tsam med pa zhig ye nas min/ ma zad/ bu mo'i nyen 'gog bde srung gi dngul nyi shu tsam de yang slo/ba — 213 —

za ma mo'i sgyid ga gangs ma char/grwa'i bka' ltar dus yun 'char can nang sprod gi yo/da/ dang thog bu mo'i mos skyon ha cang lce bas sman rin 'bor chen mkho ba dang yang chag sgo bzo mkhan gyi las khungs kyis sman rin dus ltar sprod par yang yang nar 'gyangs byas rkyen/ nga tshor dngul gyi lag thogs byung song bas /grogs po re gnyis kyi gsal 'debs ltar nyen 'gog las khungs la 'brel yo/da gnas tshul blo 'dri byas pa na/ nyen 'gog las khungs kyis bu mo'i don rkyen der 'gan 'khur mkhan gsum pa zhig byung 'dug phyir/kho tshos nyen 'gog dngul sprod mi dgos zhes lan bslogs song / de ba'in dka' sdug mang por 'phrad kyang dang thog bu mo'i rmas lci drags pas sems pa blong blong bor gyur te/ slob yon phyir 'then dang slob grwar 'gan khur yod med sogs la bsam blo 'khor ma thub par btang snyoms su bzhag de yang mthar gtugs na/ 'u cag la dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod khrims lugs kyi 'du shes zhan pa dang / yang dgos med kyi khog rgya yangs mo zhig lhun gyis grub yod pas lan pa red/ yin na'ang kho tsho'i bya spyod dang gshis ka rnam 'gyur sogs ni ha lam nga tsho dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du song 'dug pa red/dang thog chag sgo de byung ma thag bu mo'i lus steng gi rma kha che 'i/nga rmas phog sa'ang tag tag lag ngar dang rkub la khel 'dug phyir/nyi ma mi nyung ba zhig la nyin mtshan dbyer med du dus tshod skar ma 'ga' — 214 —

rang gi khe dbang rang gis bsrung dgos re'i bar nas/ bu mo nad khri las yar 'gyogs ma ra sgu la dang ma/nyeng 'phu ra sogs byed dgos pas // snyor tshegs ha cang lce/ de bas grogs po dang nang mi lnga drug tsam gyis nyin mtshan res mos su bsrung dbos byung /thog dang por bu mo'i rma kha'i sman brjes pa'i nyin mo der nu bo nged gnyis kyis nad g.yo/ga byed res la khel/ de ni bu mo gasbyog bcos byas rjes kyi nyin a nga bdun pa red/ nu bo phyi la sman 'ig len du so nga mtshams / sman pa dang nad g.yo ga 'ga' yo nga nas rub rub kyis bu rno/'i sman brje ba'i las brtsams/ nga ya nga bu mo'i nad khri'i nye sar btud skabs bsam yu la las 'das pa'i rma kha des/ nga'i snyi nga /khar gri yis bsnun pa lta bu'i na zug skyes/ dus der ngas da gzod khyim mis nga la bu mo'i rma kha'i gnas tshul dngos gas nga 'dug pa ga'i nas shes /skad cig mar lus skrom thor ba ltar nga rang lhab lha ba tu khur/ ngas tshor pa de btsan gyis byang khog tu bcug ste mig mchi mas brlan ba'in mu mthud du sman par ram 'degs kyis/ sman brjes tshar du bcugand g.yog ma re gnyis kyis bu mo'i rma kha red pa'i dri ngan der pha phu zer nas kha sna btum bzhi/na snga rting du nad khang gi sgor bud/ gnas tshul de mthong rjes ngas bsam zhig tshugs te snas dbugs ring 'ig brngubs pa na/ bu mo'i rma kha red yo/da pa tshor/ yin kyang de ni myur skyo ba ṭ+wā/na khang 'ig si/ sman pa dang nad g.yo/ga chos thog dang por bsnams pa 'ig sku no

za ma mo'i skyid ga gangs ma char/ga la yin 'dod/ de ltar bu mo'i rma kha drag skyed yo/nga min gyi sems khral dang sman pa'i rnam 'gyur la zhe sdang gis ngu shum byed skabs/ nga'i nu bo 'byor nas sngar rgyun ba'in bdag la sems/ gso byas/thengs shig ngas sman khang du bu mor nad g.yo/ga byed skabs/ nga ha cang thang chad drags narībe nyal khri stong pa zhig yo/da pa de'i steng tog tsam 'phres nas sdod skabs nad g.yog 'go gtso des mthong ba dang /mos de ltar mi chog pa'i skad cha bshad zhor/ kho tsho thun mong la rnam 'gyur thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa de bstan yong / nga'i nu bos zer na kho la'ang thengs 'gar de ltar byas myong zer/ de bas ngas gzhi nas ma bzod par nad g.yo/ga 'go gtso der kha rtsod brgyab pa yin/spyir mi zhig gi sems pa sdug gis gtses skabs don med du gzhan la kha rtsod byed pa'i bsam pa rgyud la skye dka' mod/ kho mo gtsos nad g.yog ma kha shas kyi rnam 'gyur der ngas dngos gnas bzod bsran ma thub/rjes sod gsar 'gyur brgyud lam gyis bu mo'i don rkyen de khyab bsgrags byas pa dang bstun spyi chogs steng yang grags 'gul chung chung zhig bslangs shing / yang nged bza' zla gnyis kyi las khungs gang yin shes rjes su/ kho tsho'i rnam 'gyur la lam seng 'gyur ba byung /de ba'i/na sman khang du bsdad nas lo gcig song ba'i mtshams shig la bu mo'i rma kha sos mthar gzhi nas gshag bcos thengs gnyis pa byed —— 2‘16 da
