rang dbang rang sa bsrung da sa/thub song / rma kha sos pa bzang zhing myur ba sman pa rnams kyi bsam yul las 'das 'dug bdag gi bsam par de ni dang thog bu mor chag sgo byung ma thag sman pa bka' drin can stag lha rgyal lags kyi ngag bkod ltar bu mor gshag bcos byas pa'i 'bras bu dang / yang sman khang gi sman bcos zhor la bod kyi sman sna rtsa chen bsten pa'i rkyen sogs yin par 'dod/ bu mo'i gshag bcos thengs gsum pa de lo du ma'i rjes la bsgug dgos zer bas/ rang 'gul gyis sman khang las phyir bud pa yin/ tag tag bu mo sman khang nas phyir bud de cung ma 'gor ba'i nyin zhig la/ 'grim 'grul spyi bde las khungs nas 'gan khur thag bcad kyi yi ge len par skad btang song / ngag bkod ltar nged bza' zla gnyis de ga las khungs su 'byor skabs/ chag sgo bzo mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor kha lo pa de'ang bar khyams kyi rkub stegs shig gi steng bsdad 'dug nged gnyis gzhung las khang der 'dzul ba na/ rgya mi skyes pa zhig si/sa khyo ga'i lag tu shog lho 'ga' sprad byung / 'gan khur khrun thag bcad pa'i yi ge'i steng nga'i bu mor 'gan khur gtso bo dang pha rol por 'gan khur phal pa yod ces bris 'dug drang snyoms min pa'i 'gan khur thag bcad de mthong skabs/ bdag gis khyim mi spun mched tshos lo gcig lhag gi ring la sems pa sdug gis gtses shing lus po dka' bas mnan pa'i nyin zhag re re dang / bu mos bzod glags ge 247 —

za ma mo'i sbyid ngas ma char/ —med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'o dod khrod/ a ma/ a khu lha yis nga mi skyob pa ci red zer bzhin na zug khrod dus tshod skar cha re re btsan gyis 'da' bar byas pa'i snang tshul/ kho mo'i sems khong dang lus steng la bzhag pa'i rma shul/ da dung lo gcig lhag ring la slob sbyong 'gor 'gyangs byas pa sogs yid la 'khor yong zhing / nga'i ya chung hril por 'khyag rom blugs pa ltar grang shur shur du gyur/ rgyu stobs che ba'i kung si des snga mo nas gsug brdzangs te kho tsho nyos 'dug pa tshor bas zhe sdang dang 'khon sems gnyis skyes kyis skad chen pos ngus pa yin/ khyo gas nga'i rgyab la byil byil gtong zhor rang gis de ltar ma byed/ sdes nga tshor 'phya smod byed nges red zer/ gtam der dngos gnas bden lugs 'dug na'ang ngas de ma nyid du mig chu'i bzhur rgyun ma chod par ngu shum byed bzhin sgo 'gram du langs bsdad de mu mthud du rgya mi des ci bshad la mnyam 'jog byas pa yin/ khyo ga rgya mi de'i cog tse'i kha sprod du 'grengs bsdad de/ ngas don dag 'di 'di ltar mi bskyur kho thag yin/ grong khyer dang zhing chen la gtug rgyu yin/ de ru lam med na pe cing du gtug rgyu yin zhes bshad pa na/ rgya mi skyes pa des/ 'di gong rim gyis thag bcad pa red/ nga la bshad kyang phan thogs med zer nas don de snang med du btang ba mthong skabs/ drang bden dang rgyu 'bras zer ba zhig khyon nas med pa tshor zhing / skabs der nga'i lus — 248 —

rang dbang rang sa bsrung da sa/sems gnyis phreng thag chad pa'i mu tig bzhin thor song / rjes sor ngas yid skyo ba'i don de phyir dran byed thengs rer/ khyo ga'i mdangs shor ba'i gdong nyams de yid la yang yang shar yong /drang snyoms ma yin pa'i thag bcad der yid 'thad gtan nas med pas/ nga tshos zi ling gi khrims rtsod pa grags chen zhig btsal 'tshol byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ de bzhin khrims rtsod las khungs re gnyis la blo 'dri dang bsam tshul bton mthar/ khrims rtsod las khungs ga ge mo zhig gi khrims rtsod pa zhig gis don rkyen der gdeng tshod yod tshul bstan/ yin na'ang khrims rtsod pa skad grags ji ltar che na gla yon yang de ltar mang po gtong dgos/ skabs der nged tshang gi cha rkyen ltar na/ bu mor chag sgo bzo mkhan las khungs des mi 'dod bzhin du gnas skabs su sman rin sprad zin pa min tshe/ sman rin de 'dra mang po ni sprod dka' ba'i tshod yin/ yin na'ang thag gcod drang gzhag ma yin pa der rgol slad/ nged bza' zla gnyis kyis bsam blo yang skor bskyar skor btang mthar/ khyim tshang bstim dgos rung khrims rtsod pa de gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i sems thag bcad nas gan rgya bzhagade nas nga tshos gyod gzhi de zi ling grong khyer 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang la gtugs pa dang / mjug mthar bu mo lo gcig ring sman khang du bsdad pa'i sman rin sgor khri bcu gnyis tsam dang / khyim tshang — 249 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/gis bu mo sman khang du sdod skabs bkol ba'i sgor khri gnyis lhagakhrims rtsod pa'i gla yon sgor khri bzhi lhag da dung gshag bcos thengs gsum par mkho ba'i sman rin nyung tsam yang lon song / da lta bsam na'ang / spyi dmangs phal pa zhig gi tshod kyis gyod gzhi der‘rgyal kha’chung chung zhig blangs song 'dod/ gal te dang thog gi 'grim 'grul spyi bde las khungs kyi thag gcod ltar bskyur te khrims khang du gtugs bsher ma byas pa yin tshe/ 'gro song gzhan lta zhog bu mo sman khang du bsdad pa'i sman rin gyi sum cha'i gnyis kyang rang gis sprod dgos shag shag red/bdag gi bsam par gyod gzhi der6‘rgyal kha rag pa ni las dbang gi bkod sgrig tsam ma yin par/ rang nyid kyis khrims lugs ltar rang gi khe dbang bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu red/ des na/ nga tshor mkho ngo ma ni/ mi rang nyid srung skyob thub pa'i shes bya yon tan zhig dang /gnas lugs rtsod pa'i spobs pa zhig de las gzhan/ deng gi dus 'dir gal la thug tshe dngul lor mang po zhig kyang med mi rung snyam/2007(03(25nyin grub/— 250 —

mju byang /mjug byang /kang rang ni grong gseb kyi dud khyim phal pa zhig tu skyes shing / srol rgyun gyi khor yug stug po'i khrod 'tshar ba'i bud med cig yin/ a phas bu mo tsho skra ring yang blo thung zer/ a mas mo lus blangs na gcar rdung nyo dgos zer/ lo na phra ba'i dus su/ pho mchog mo dman gyi lta ba la yid 'thad gtan nas med na'ang /srol rgyun gyi chu shugs drag po'i mdun/ nyam chung ba'i kho mos mo lus blangs par 'khang ra tsam byed rgyu las/ srol rgyun 'di bzlog pa'i spobs pa zhig ga la yod/khor yug de ru nga rang yang a ma nang bzhin las sdug po byed mkhan dang zas ngan ngon za mkhan rang yin pa red/dus kyi lo zla khad kyis 'das nas/ na so cung rgyas skabs a ma'i re ltos bzhin slob grwa chung 'bring 'grims/ dge thon slob grwa nas ma thon sngon la stes dbang stabs 'grig gis mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin las khungs su yong thub pa byung //de ni grong gseb kyi bu mo zhig la mtshon na/ mi tshe yi dkyogs mtshams shig yin mod/ skabs der mi tshe la re snyeg chen po bcangs shes med/khabarnyan 'phrin dang brtsams sgrung sogs su 'bri bzhengs byas pa'i snang brnyan dag las/ bud med ni skyes pa las g.yo sgyu che zhing / gdug tsub che ba/— 251 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/'dod chags kyis myos shing / phrag dog gis gtses pa/ dpyod shes dang rang gshis zer ba zhig ye nas med par bsam med kyi byis pa rgan pa lta bu red/ snang brnyan de 'tsho ba dngos dang rgyang thag ha cang ring gshis/ bdag la brjod dka' ba'i tshor pa khyad par ba zhig byin/ yin na'ang 'tsho ba dang brtsams chos kyi he bag de 'dra che ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin gtan nas ha ma go bar yid som nyir tshud de yun ring 'gor/ nyin zhig glo bur du/ de ni 'khrab khrid pa dang rtsom pa po rnams skyes pa pho yin pa'i rkyen ma yin nam snyam byung la/ dogs gzhi de rkyen byas nas nga rang bud med kyi las dbang dang bde sdug la bsam gzhig byed pa'i byang thang chen mo der 'jug 'go brtsams/de ltar bsam zhing bsam zhing / srol rgyun gyi ngag rgyun dang lha sgrung du bud med rnams gdon dang 'dre dang bdud du ngos 'dzin cing / rang snang gang shar dang / gzugs med grib bzo yi bya byed de dag ni/ bud med kyi rtsis thang la rdog brdzis byed pa'i rkyen du tshor/ de yang srol rgyun gang zhig thog mar gsar gtod byed mkhan ni skyes pa yin rung / mthar srol rgyun gyi lam phran der 'jug mkhan bud med yin pa red/ ji skad du/ h+pha ran si'i bud med rtsom mkhan si mon te 'bo war na re/ lha bzhengs mkhan skyes pa yin kyang / phyag 'tshal mkhan bud med yin zer ba red/ rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis da lta de bsgyur bcos byed mkhan yang srol rgyun de las khe bzang rag mkhan gyi skyes pa tsho ma yin par/ gyong gun nyo mkhan gyi bud med rang nyid yin pa shes/gnas tshul de la dmigs nas/ bdag gis lo 'di dag gi ring la nus tshod — 252 —

mju byang /kyis 'brel yod dpe cha blta klog dang gnad don la bsam gzhig gtong ba'i dus mtshungs su/ bud med nyam thag rnams kyi skyid sdug dang las dbang skor/ kho mo tsho rang nyid dang bsam tshul brje res/ grong khyer gyi rang rigs bud med dang skyes pa'i bya spyod dang sems khams la brtag dpyad dang / bud med dag dka' sdug gis 'tsho ba dang skyes pa rnams bag lhod kyis rol ba'i rgyu rkyen la dbye zhib btang dang gtong gi yod cing / de dag ni bdag gi brtsams chos kyi rgyu cha dang brjod bya'i don gyi snying po'ang yin no/ /ga bsam gzhig gi go rim ring mo zhig sngon du 'gro dgos pa chos nyid yin na'ang / rtsom 'bri'i las la dngos su zhugs pa ni stes dbang trem yin/ na ning ston kar bdag gi snying nye ba'i a ma lags 'das rjes/ sems pa sdug gis mnar te nyi ma'ang 'khyol dka' bar gyur/ skabs der nga ni dmigs yul med pa'i 'grul bzhud pa zhig dang mtshungs par/ dra tshigs gang rung du 'khyams te rtsom yig blta klog dang sbrags/ rang gis kyang rgya yig gi lam nas rtsom thung re gnyis 'bri khul gyis zin bris nang bkod de nyi ma 'khyol thabs dang skyo snang sangs thabs byas pa yin/nyin zhig nga'i rgya yig gi zin bris su rgya mi shes yon can yus cedulags kyis cho rjo yusagā (lkorke 19kau—)krung go'i dā gzhon rtsom sdukhan t+yāng / srid don dpyad brjod mkhan/ brtsams sa〈〈rdzun gtam ga pa〉〉dang〈〈ba na rgyal la phul ba mya ngan zhu ga〉〉 gas 'dug

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bris pa'i 'bar ma rgyal khab kyi mdzangs ma ang san su'u ciduyi gnas tshul zhig bkod pa'i gsham du/ dra grogs shig gis nang don phal cher 'di 'dra ba'i sbyar byang zhig bris 'dug ste/ rang gi bud med rnams nang log tu 'tshong dang 'bro gi yod pa'i gnas tshul snang med du bskyur te/ gzhan rigs kyi skad grags can gyi bud med la do snang byed pa 'di/ so so'i nyam chung bud med rnams gleng rin med song ba yin nam zhes pa dang / de'i mjug tu rtsom de yod sa'i dra gnas ming byang dang bcas pa gsal bor bkod 'dug de ni ngas bod kyi bud med nang log tu 'tshong ba'i gnas tshul yig thog nas mthong ba thog ma yin/ rtsom yig de bklags kyin bklags kyin sems pa gzer zug gis khengs pa dang 'brel/ chung dus pha yul du bu mo rnams la nang tshang du 'dra mnyam med par 'khang ra'i skad cha zlo ba dag yid la 'khor yong / rang nyid kyang bud med cig yin pas kho mo tsho'i las dbang gi skyo gar de mthong nas sdod blos ma bzod par/ lam seng rtsom yig de bod yig tu bsgyur rjes rang tshod kyi dpyad gtam thung ngu zhig bris pa dang mnyam du mtsho sngon bod yig tshags par las khungs su bskur pa yin/ ma bsam sa nas de ga las khungs kyi rtsom sgrig pas rtsom yig de tshags par steng bkod thog gdeng 'jog kyang mi dman pa zhig gnangs 'dug de ni nga rang la mtshon na bud med kyi las dbang skor gyi rtsom yig thog ma yin la/ dngos su rtsom 'bri'i las la zhugs pa'i gom pa dang po'ang yin/rtags ljab/angabadh+rinā sna wi hā〈/〈sloyam̐mi ḍā zlid ༈ ram̐nārke m+biṣ+ṭṛsmidūlha sgri sna byelhar ma/ 1991lor no pel zhi bde'i gzengs — 254 —

mju byang /ngartsom pa po phal pa zhig byed 'dod na'ang / thog mar skad yig gi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig dang / rtsom rtsal ran po zhig da dung bsam blo rags rim zhig dgos pa ni gzhir bzhag red/ yin na'ang bdag ni de las ldog ste/ chung dus slob gso'i skal pa phra zhing / gzhon nu'i dus su 'jig rten gyi bud med phal pa'i rin thang lta tshul las brgal ma thub par/ dus tshod mang mang zhig phyi lus por dang zhen dang nang brtse dung 'tshol snyeg gi slad du btang tshar/ na gzhon dus su rang tshod kyis dpe deb blta klog gi sbyong ba phra mo tsam byas na'ang / rmang gzhi zhan drags pas/ rgyud la yon tan chen po 'byor ma thub/ de bas/ bdag rtsom 'bri'i las la zhugs ma thag pa'i skabs su/ lus sems gnyis dka' tshegs dang ngal dub kyis gtses shing / las ka 'di rang nyid goms lobs su song ba'i khyim las tsag tsig dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba tshor/ phyir 'dang re brgyab na/ nga ni sems shugs dang dungs zhen kho nas lam bu der btsan gyis zhugs pa red/ bod spyi tshogs su bud med kyi khe dbang la yin dgag dang khyad gsod rkyang byed pa dang /de la ya lan dang the jus byed mkhan med cing / tha na bud med rang nyid kyi na zug 'don mkhan zhig kyang dkon pa'i tshod red/ gnas tshul der dmigs nas/bdag ni nan sems drag pos kun nas bslangs shing / shes bya'i rmang gzhi zhan pa shes na yang / mu mthud du lkugs pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin ma thub par/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis spyi tshogs 'di'i rgyu 'bras kyi blo mig dang bden drang gi rgya ma byed khul byas pa yin/ ngas de ltar lus sems gnyis 'tshol snyeg gi g.yog la — 255 —

za ma mo'i skyid ngas ma char/bkug na'ang / de ni gzhan dbang du shor ba'i g.yog rgyug cig ma yin par/rang dbang gis 'dems pa'i g.yog rgyug cig yin pas na/ dka' sdug dang skyo snang yod tshad bde skyid du sgom gi yod/rang tshod kyi skad cor zhig brgyab pa 'di yang / skyes pa rnams dgra ru 'dzin 'dod pa min la/ pho mo'i bar phra ma 'jug 'dod pa ni de bas kyang min/nga rang bud med cig yin pas na/ bud med kyi sems khams dang skyid sdug la 'dris cha dang rgyus mnga' dod po yod cing / kho mo tsho'i ya chung sems kyi gting rim la nyar ba'i na zug de dag drang po gzhung bsrang gis phyir phyung ba dang / bud med kyang rang dbang la dga' zhing gzhan dbang la sdang ba sogs skyes pa dang gcig mtshungs yin pa'i gnas lugs tsam drangs pa yin/ca'adir kho mos nges par du gleng dgos pa zhig ni/ thag ring go la'i rgyab tu 'tsho sdod byas yod pa'i grogs mchog bstan 'dzin dge legs lags yin/ rgyu mtshan lo bcu tsam gyi ring la nga tshos 'phrin yig gi lam nas phan tshun 'brel 'dris byas pa de yang / bdag la rtsom 'bri'i rmang gzhi ran po zhig chags pa'i grogs su gyur yod las che/ lhag par du khong gi lhag bsam zol med kyi skul slong dang yid ches kyis nga la mi mngon pa'i sems shugs chen po sbyin/ mi zhig la mtshon na gzhan gyi yid ches dang brtsi 'jog gi rin thang ni 'jal thabs bral ba zhig red/de bas 'dir khong la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/de min/ bdag gi mi tshe'i zla bo lha mo skyabs kyis kho mo'i rtsom yig gi skyon — 256 —

mju byang /dang mi 'dang sa rnams skabs skabs su drang po thad brjod kyi rogs ram gang drag dang rgyab skyor lhod med byas pa dang 'brel bdag gi rtsom 'bri'i las kar phan cha chen po thob byung snyam pas bka' drin che zhu rgyu dang / rigs kyi bu mo g.yang 'dzoms bzang mos yid ches dang sems shugs byin pa'ang yid kyi yol go ru nyar dang nyar yod/gzhan/ sku zhabs khri sems dpa' lags dang sku zhabs gcod pa klu rgyal lags/ sku zhabs glegs shing rdo rje tshe ring lags/ grogs mo dbal bza' nor 'dzin dbang mo lags/ da dung deb chung 'di par skrun thad rgyab skyor byed mkhan gyi spun zla yongs la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ dpe cha 'di 'grem spel byas pa dang bstun/ bod spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs mi legs pa dag la 'gyur ba phra mo tsam byung na ni/ rogs skyor mkhan gyi spun zla'i lhag bsam chud zos dang ngal ba 'bras med du ma song ba dang / nga rang gis gzhung las phan chad dang khyim las tshun chad kyi ngal gso'i dus tshod phra mo re bed spyad de/ dpon skad 'brug sgra ldir ldir dang / byis skad lu gu 'ba' 'ba'i khrod/ sems pa seg rdar rgyag rgyag dang / lus po ko ba nyed nyed byas par yang 'gyod snang spu rtse tsam med do/ /ci ste de 'dra yin na'ang / rang gi rig gnas yon tshad ha cang zhan drags pas na/deb chung 'di la mi 'dang sa dang ma 'khyongs sa/ nor ba dang 'khrul ba mang po yod nges pas khyed klog mkhan spun zla kun gyis thugs dkyel yangs mos bzod gsol re gnang rogs/zhes ra rdza 'jam dbyangs skyid kyis/2006 12 18nyin grub/— 257 —

bla dpo chogs/za ma mo'i skyid sdug gangs ma char/rtsom pa po/ ra rdza 'jams dbyangs skyid/dpo tshogasacas 'god pa/ me lce/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ gcod pa klu rgyal/mdun zhogasarjes ris pa/ tshe ring dbang mo/datse sgrun/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe spun khang /'grems spel/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /par 'debs/lan gru zhin hwa par khang /deb tshad/ ho smis880྾ho smis12301(32dpar zhog 8 625yig grangs/ khri18par thengs/ 2008lo'i zla3par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2008lo'i zla3par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1sde2000dpe rtags/1ci2sa978—7—5421—1294—1rin gong / sgor18 00par dbang 'di gar yod pas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad pog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)
